#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# export.sh — Repository context dump for LLM consumption
#
# Location: <repository root>/export.sh
#
# Usage:  bash export.sh
#         time bash export.sh
#
# Behaviour:
#   • Resolves its own location; works regardless of the caller's directory.
#   • Silently exits if no Git repository is found at that location.
#   • Dumps only Git-tracked files to docs/llm/dump.txt, excluding docs/llm/**
#     and this script itself — its source appears exactly once, in the
#     self-documentation section.                                       (F-25)
#   • Emits rich per-file metadata (name, path, size, permissions,
#     modification time, owner, inode, MIME type, SHA-256, last commit).
#   • Includes a file-tree view of all included files.
#   • Builds the dump in a temporary file using plain redirection, renames it
#     into place atomically, and only then echoes the finished dump to the
#     console — a reader can never observe a partially written dump.txt, and
#     stderr diagnostics go to the console, never into the dump.        (F-27)
# =============================================================================

set -euo pipefail
IFS=$'\n\t'

# Deterministic, locale-independent output: sort(1) collation, prefix grouping
# in the fallback tree renderer, and byte-oriented text handling must not vary
# from machine to machine. C collation also matches Git's own byte ordering.
export LC_ALL=C

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 0. Resolve the script's own location — immune to the caller's directory
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
SCRIPT_PATH="$(readlink -f "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")"
SCRIPT_DIRECTORY="$(dirname "$SCRIPT_PATH")"
SCRIPT_NAME="$(basename "$SCRIPT_PATH")"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Validate: must be inside a working Git repository
#    (F-29: '&>' already covers both streams; the trailing '2>&1' is gone)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ! git -C "$SCRIPT_DIRECTORY" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree &>/dev/null; then
    exit 0
fi
if ! git -C "$SCRIPT_DIRECTORY" status --porcelain &>/dev/null; then
    exit 0
fi
REPOSITORY_ROOT="$(git -C "$SCRIPT_DIRECTORY" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || exit 0

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Constants & derived paths
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
EXCLUDED_DIRECTORY="docs/llm"

# Files excluded in addition to EXCLUDED_DIRECTORY. A bare name (no slash) is
# excluded wherever it appears; a name containing a slash is an exact
# repository-relative path. The script always excludes itself — by whatever
# name it currently has — so a rename can never reintroduce the double
# emission of F-25. The JavaScript-era 'yarn.lock' entry is gone.  (F-25, F-32)
EXCLUDED_FILES=("$SCRIPT_NAME")
EXCLUDED_FILES_DISPLAY="$(printf '%s, ' "${EXCLUDED_FILES[@]}")"
EXCLUDED_FILES_DISPLAY="${EXCLUDED_FILES_DISPLAY%, }"

OUTPUT_DIRECTORY="${REPOSITORY_ROOT}/${EXCLUDED_DIRECTORY}"
OUTPUT_FILE="${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/dump.txt"

# GNU date first, BSD-style fallback second — keeps the portability posture
# consistent with the stat(1) fallbacks used below.
iso_timestamp() {
    date --iso-8601=seconds 2>/dev/null || date '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z'
}

TIMESTAMP="$(iso_timestamp)"
GIT_BRANCH="$(git -C "$REPOSITORY_ROOT" rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo 'unknown')"
GIT_COMMIT="$(git -C "$REPOSITORY_ROOT" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo 'unknown')"
GIT_COMMIT_SHORT="$(git -C "$REPOSITORY_ROOT" rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo 'unknown')"
GIT_COMMIT_MESSAGE="$(git -C "$REPOSITORY_ROOT" log -1 --pretty=format:'%s' 2>/dev/null || echo 'unknown')"
GIT_COMMIT_DATE="$(git -C "$REPOSITORY_ROOT" log -1 --pretty=format:'%ci' 2>/dev/null || echo 'unknown')"
GIT_REMOTE="$(git -C "$REPOSITORY_ROOT" remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null || echo 'none')"
GIT_STATUS_SUMMARY="$(git -C "$REPOSITORY_ROOT" status --short 2>/dev/null | head -20 || echo '')"

HOSTNAME_VALUE="$(hostname -f 2>/dev/null || hostname 2>/dev/null || echo 'unknown')"
USER_VALUE="$(id -un 2>/dev/null || echo 'unknown')"
OPERATING_SYSTEM_VALUE="$(uname -srm 2>/dev/null || echo 'unknown')"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Collect tracked files (staged/committed only), minus exclusions.
#    Untracked and ignored files are never dumped.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
mapfile -t RAW_TRACKED_FILES < <(
    git -C "$REPOSITORY_ROOT" ls-files --cached -z 2>/dev/null \
    | tr '\0' '\n' \
    | sort -u
)

INCLUDED_FILES=()
for candidate_file in "${RAW_TRACKED_FILES[@]}"; do
    [[ -z "$candidate_file" ]] && continue
    # Skip the entire excluded directory tree.
    [[ "$candidate_file" == "${EXCLUDED_DIRECTORY}/"* ]] && continue
    # Skip any individually-excluded file.
    candidate_excluded=0
    for excluded_entry in "${EXCLUDED_FILES[@]}"; do
        if [[ "$excluded_entry" == */* ]]; then
            [[ "$candidate_file" == "$excluded_entry" ]] && { candidate_excluded=1; break; }
        else
            [[ "$candidate_file" == "$excluded_entry" || "$candidate_file" == */"$excluded_entry" ]] && { candidate_excluded=1; break; }
        fi
    done
    (( candidate_excluded )) && continue
    INCLUDED_FILES+=("$candidate_file")
done

FILE_COUNT="${#INCLUDED_FILES[@]}"
if (( FILE_COUNT == 1 )); then                                        # (F-33)
    FILE_COUNT_NOUN="file"
else
    FILE_COUNT_NOUN="files"
fi

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Helper: human-readable file size — awk instead of bc, which was an
#    unchecked dependency that killed the whole dump under 'set -e' on any
#    machine without it. awk is already required by file_sha256.        (F-30)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
human_size() {
    local bytes="$1"
    if (( bytes < 1024 )); then
        printf '%d B' "$bytes"
        return 0
    fi
    awk -v bytes="$bytes" 'BEGIN {
        unit_count = split("KiB MiB GiB TiB PiB", units, " ")
        value = bytes
        unit_index = 0
        while (value >= 1024 && unit_index < unit_count) {
            value = value / 1024
            unit_index = unit_index + 1
        }
        printf "%.1f %s", value, units[unit_index]
    }'
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Helper: SHA-256 of a file (portable across Linux distros and macOS)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
file_sha256() {
    local path="$1"
    if command -v sha256sum &>/dev/null; then
        sha256sum "$path" | awk '{print $1}'
    elif command -v shasum &>/dev/null; then
        shasum -a 256 "$path" | awk '{print $1}'
    else
        echo 'unavailable'
    fi
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Helper: MIME type (best effort, no error on missing tool)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
file_mime() {
    local path="$1"
    if command -v file &>/dev/null; then
        file --brief --mime-type "$path" 2>/dev/null || echo 'unknown'
    else
        echo 'unknown'
    fi
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Helper: binary detection. The previous version keyed everything on
#    file(1); on a machine without it, EVERY file was misclassified as
#    binary and the dump contained no content at all. Now the MIME type is
#    the primary signal and a NUL-byte sniff of the first 8 KiB decides
#    whenever file(1) is missing or inconclusive.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
is_binary_file() {
    local path="$1"
    local mime_type
    if command -v file &>/dev/null; then
        mime_type="$(file --brief --mime-type "$path" 2>/dev/null || echo 'unknown')"
        case "$mime_type" in
            text/*|image/svg+xml|application/json|application/xml|application/x-yaml|application/yaml|application/javascript|application/x-shellscript|application/x-empty|inode/x-empty)
                return 1
                ;;
            image/*|audio/*|video/*|font/*|application/octet-stream|application/zip|application/gzip|application/x-tar|application/pdf)
                return 0
                ;;
        esac
    fi
    local nul_byte_count
    nul_byte_count="$(head -c 8192 "$path" 2>/dev/null | tr -dc '\0' | wc -c)"
    (( nul_byte_count > 0 ))
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. File tree — tree(1) when available (charset pinned so LC_ALL=C cannot
#    degrade the connectors to ASCII), otherwise a correct pure-bash renderer:
#    └── for the last entry at a level, ├── otherwise, with │ continuation
#    lines only where an ancestor has further siblings.                 (F-31)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
build_file_tree() {
    if (( FILE_COUNT == 0 )); then
        printf '.\n(no files included)\n'
        return 0
    fi
    if command -v tree &>/dev/null; then
        printf '%s\n' "${INCLUDED_FILES[@]}" \
        | tree --fromfile -a --noreport --charset=UTF-8 2>/dev/null \
        || render_tree_fallback
    else
        render_tree_fallback
    fi
}

render_tree_fallback() {
    printf '.\n'
    render_tree_level "" ""
}

# Recursive renderer over the sorted INCLUDED_FILES list. The children of a
# directory are the unique next path components; because the list is sorted
# with C collation, entries sharing a component are adjacent, so consecutive
# deduplication is sufficient.
render_tree_level() {
    local parent_path="$1"
    local prefix="$2"

    local -a child_names=()
    local previous_child=""
    local entry remainder child_name
    for entry in "${INCLUDED_FILES[@]}"; do
        if [[ -n "$parent_path" ]]; then
            [[ "$entry" == "${parent_path}/"* ]] || continue
            remainder="${entry#"${parent_path}"/}"
        else
            remainder="$entry"
        fi
        child_name="${remainder%%/*}"
        if [[ "$child_name" != "$previous_child" ]]; then
            child_names+=("$child_name")
            previous_child="$child_name"
        fi
    done

    local child_count="${#child_names[@]}"
    local child_index child_path connector descendant_prefix child_is_directory
    for (( child_index = 0; child_index < child_count; child_index++ )); do
        child_name="${child_names[$child_index]}"
        if (( child_index == child_count - 1 )); then
            connector='└── '
            descendant_prefix="${prefix}    "
        else
            connector='├── '
            descendant_prefix="${prefix}│   "
        fi
        if [[ -n "$parent_path" ]]; then
            child_path="${parent_path}/${child_name}"
        else
            child_path="$child_name"
        fi
        child_is_directory=0
        for entry in "${INCLUDED_FILES[@]}"; do
            if [[ "$entry" == "${child_path}/"* ]]; then
                child_is_directory=1
                break
            fi
        done
        if (( child_is_directory )); then
            printf '%s%s%s/\n' "$prefix" "$connector" "$child_name"
            render_tree_level "$child_path" "$descendant_prefix"
        else
            printf '%s%s%s\n' "$prefix" "$connector" "$child_name"
        fi
    done
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Per-file metadata and content blocks — shared by the self-documentation
#    section and the main loop, so the two can never drift apart.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
print_file_metadata() {
    local absolute_path="$1"
    local relative_path="$2"
    local file_size="$3"
    local sha256_value="$4"

    local modified_time permissions owner inode hard_links mime_type last_commit
    modified_time="$(stat --format='%y' "$absolute_path" 2>/dev/null \
                     || stat -f '%Sm' -t '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %z' "$absolute_path" 2>/dev/null \
                     || echo 'unavailable')"
    permissions="$(stat --format='%A' "$absolute_path" 2>/dev/null \
                   || stat -f '%Sp' "$absolute_path" 2>/dev/null \
                   || echo 'unavailable')"
    owner="$(stat --format='%U:%G' "$absolute_path" 2>/dev/null \
             || stat -f '%Su:%Sg' "$absolute_path" 2>/dev/null \
             || echo 'unavailable')"
    inode="$(stat --format='%i' "$absolute_path" 2>/dev/null \
             || stat -f '%i' "$absolute_path" 2>/dev/null \
             || echo 'unavailable')"
    hard_links="$(stat --format='%h' "$absolute_path" 2>/dev/null \
                  || stat -f '%l' "$absolute_path" 2>/dev/null \
                  || echo 'unavailable')"
    mime_type="$(file_mime "$absolute_path")"
    last_commit="$(git -C "$REPOSITORY_ROOT" log -1 --pretty=format:'%h %ai %s' -- "$relative_path" 2>/dev/null || echo 'unavailable')"
    # A file that is staged but has never been committed produces empty git
    # output rather than an error; say so instead of printing a blank field.
    if [[ -z "$last_commit" ]]; then
        last_commit='(not yet committed)'
    fi

    printf '\n--- METADATA ---\n'
    printf '  %-22s %s\n' "File name:"       "$(basename "$relative_path")"
    printf '  %-22s %s\n' "Relative path:"   "$relative_path"
    printf '  %-22s %s\n' "Absolute path:"   "$absolute_path"
    printf '  %-22s %s\n' "Size:"            "$(human_size "$file_size") (${file_size} bytes)"
    printf '  %-22s %s\n' "Last modified:"   "$modified_time"
    printf '  %-22s %s\n' "Permissions:"     "$permissions"
    printf '  %-22s %s\n' "Owner:"           "$owner"
    printf '  %-22s %s\n' "Inode:"           "$inode"
    printf '  %-22s %s\n' "Hard links:"      "$hard_links"
    printf '  %-22s %s\n' "MIME type:"       "$mime_type"
    printf '  %-22s %s\n' "SHA-256:"         "$sha256_value"
    printf '  %-22s %s\n' "Last git commit:" "$last_commit"
    printf '\n--- CONTENT ---\n'
}

print_file_content() {
    local absolute_path="$1"
    local file_size="$2"
    local sha256_value="$3"

    if is_binary_file "$absolute_path"; then
        printf '[Binary file — content omitted. Size: %s, SHA-256: %s]\n' \
            "$(human_size "$file_size")" "$sha256_value"
        return 0
    fi

    cat "$absolute_path"
    # Append a newline only when the file is non-empty and does not already
    # end with one. The previous version compared "$(tail -c1 ...)" against
    # $'\n' — but command substitution strips trailing newlines, so the test
    # always passed and every newline-terminated file gained a spurious blank
    # line. Counting newlines in the final byte avoids that trap.
    if [[ -s "$absolute_path" ]] && (( $(tail -c 1 "$absolute_path" | wc -l) == 0 )); then
        printf '\n'
    fi
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Assemble the complete dump on stdout
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
generate_dump() {
    cat <<BANNER
################################################################################
#                                                                              #
#   REPOSITORY CONTEXT DUMP                                                    #
#   Generated for LLM consumption — do not edit manually                       #
#                                                                              #
################################################################################

DUMP METADATA
═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  Generated at   : ${TIMESTAMP}
  Generator      : ${SCRIPT_NAME}
  Host           : ${HOSTNAME_VALUE}
  User           : ${USER_VALUE}
  OS             : ${OPERATING_SYSTEM_VALUE}

REPOSITORY METADATA
═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  Repository root: ${REPOSITORY_ROOT}
  Branch         : ${GIT_BRANCH}
  Commit (full)  : ${GIT_COMMIT}
  Commit (short) : ${GIT_COMMIT_SHORT}
  Commit date    : ${GIT_COMMIT_DATE}
  Commit message : ${GIT_COMMIT_MESSAGE}
  Remote origin  : ${GIT_REMOTE}
  Files included : ${FILE_COUNT}
  Excluded path  : ${EXCLUDED_DIRECTORY}/
  Excluded files : ${EXCLUDED_FILES_DISPLAY}

GIT WORKING TREE STATUS (first 20 lines)
═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
BANNER

    if [[ -n "$GIT_STATUS_SUMMARY" ]]; then
        printf '%s\n' "$GIT_STATUS_SUMMARY"
    else
        echo "  (clean — no uncommitted changes)"
    fi

    # ── Self-documentation: this script, exactly once ──────────────────────
    cat <<SELF_HEADER

################################################################################
# FILE: ${SCRIPT_NAME}  [THIS SCRIPT — included for full context]
################################################################################
SELF_HEADER

    local script_relative_path script_size script_sha256
    script_relative_path="$(realpath --relative-to="$REPOSITORY_ROOT" "$SCRIPT_PATH" 2>/dev/null || echo "$SCRIPT_PATH")"
    script_size="$(wc -c < "$SCRIPT_PATH")"
    script_sha256="$(file_sha256 "$SCRIPT_PATH")"
    print_file_metadata "$SCRIPT_PATH" "$script_relative_path" "$script_size" "$script_sha256"
    print_file_content  "$SCRIPT_PATH" "$script_size" "$script_sha256"

    # ── File tree ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # (F-28) The header no longer prints its own '.' root — tree(1) and the
    # fallback each print exactly one.
    cat <<TREE_HEADER

################################################################################
# FILE TREE  (${FILE_COUNT} included ${FILE_COUNT_NOUN})
################################################################################
TREE_HEADER

    build_file_tree
    echo ""

    # ── Per-file content dump ───────────────────────────────────────────────
    local total_bytes=0
    local relative_path absolute_path file_size sha256_value
    for relative_path in "${INCLUDED_FILES[@]}"; do
        absolute_path="${REPOSITORY_ROOT}/${relative_path}"

        # Skip files that no longer exist on disk (deleted but still indexed).
        [[ -f "$absolute_path" ]] || continue

        file_size="$(wc -c < "$absolute_path" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
        total_bytes=$(( total_bytes + file_size ))
        sha256_value="$(file_sha256 "$absolute_path")"

        printf '\n'
        printf '################################################################################\n'
        printf '# FILE: %s\n' "$relative_path"
        printf '################################################################################\n'
        print_file_metadata "$absolute_path" "$relative_path" "$file_size" "$sha256_value"
        print_file_content  "$absolute_path" "$file_size" "$sha256_value"
    done

    cat <<FOOTER

################################################################################
# DUMP SUMMARY
################################################################################
  Files dumped   : ${FILE_COUNT}
  Total size     : $(human_size "$total_bytes") (${total_bytes} bytes)
  Output file    : ${OUTPUT_FILE}
  Completed at   : $(iso_timestamp)
################################################################################
# END OF DUMP
################################################################################
FOOTER
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 11. Write atomically, then echo.                                      (F-27)
#     Plain redirection means every byte is on disk when generate_dump
#     returns; rename() then publishes the finished file in a single step;
#     only afterwards is the result printed — from the final file itself, so
#     the console shows exactly what a reader of dump.txt sees. The previous
#     'exec > >(tee ...)' could reach the rename (and exit) while tee was
#     still draining, letting a reader observe a truncated dump, and its
#     '2>&1' folded stray stderr diagnostics into the dump itself.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
mkdir -p "$OUTPUT_DIRECTORY"

TEMPORARY_FILE="$(mktemp "${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/.dump.XXXXXX")"
trap 'rm -f "$TEMPORARY_FILE"' EXIT

generate_dump > "$TEMPORARY_FILE"

# mktemp creates the file 0600; the dump is not a secret, so restore the
# conventional 0644 the previous tee-based version produced via the umask.
chmod 644 "$TEMPORARY_FILE"
mv -f "$TEMPORARY_FILE" "$OUTPUT_FILE"
trap - EXIT

cat "$OUTPUT_FILE"

################################################################################
# FILE TREE  (98 included files)
################################################################################

  Last modified:         2026-11-15 14:43:44.000000000 -0500
  Permissions:           -rw-r--r--
  Owner:                 kushal:kushal
  Inode:                 75501383
  Hard links:            1
  MIME type:             text/plain
  SHA-256:               6b9aa78da86f4378064059539d5a571b4d3005647ed16776934719189cbee698
  Last git commit:       6c251f2 2026-11-15 14:56:29 -0500 add claude response

--- CONTENT ---
name: Build and Test

on:
  push:
    branches: ['**']
  pull_request:
    branches: ['**']

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT: true
  DOTNET_NOLOGO: true

jobs:
  test:
    name: ${{ matrix.os }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest, macos-latest]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v6
        with:
          dotnet-version: '11.0.x'
          dotnet-quality: 'ga'

      - run: dotnet --info

      - run: dotnet restore

      - run: dotnet build --no-restore --configuration Release

      - run: dotnet test --no-build --configuration Release

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        if: always()
        with:
          name: test-results-${{ matrix.os }}
          path: '**/TestResults/**'
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 7

  release:
    name: Rolling Release
    needs: test
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && contains(fromJSON('["refs/heads/main", "refs/heads/master", "refs/heads/develop"]'), github.ref)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v6
        with:
          dotnet-version: '11.0.x'
          dotnet-quality: 'ga'

      - name: Publish self-contained binaries
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          version="$(date -u +'%Y.%m.%d').${GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER}"
          echo "REL_VERSION=$version" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

          for runtime in linux-x64 win-x64 osx-arm64 osx-x64; do
            for project in MyImapDownloader MyEmailSearch; do
              dotnet publish "$project/$project.csproj" -c Release -r "$runtime" \
                --self-contained true \
                -p:PublishSingleFile=true \
                -p:IncludeNativeLibrariesForSelfExtract=true \
                -p:Version="$version" \
                -o "dist/$project-$runtime"
              (cd "dist/$project-$runtime" && zip -qr "../../$project-$runtime-$version.zip" .)
            done
          done

      - name: Create release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          {
            echo "### Automated Rolling Release"
            echo "- **Version:** \`$REL_VERSION\`"
            echo "- **Commit:** \`$GITHUB_SHA\`"
            echo "- **Build Date:** $(date -u +'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') UTC"
            echo ""
            echo "Self-contained build. No .NET runtime installation is required on the target machine."
          } > release-notes.md
          gh release create "rolling-build-$REL_VERSION" ./*.zip \
            --title "Rolling Release: $REL_VERSION" \
            --notes-file release-notes.md \
            --target "$GITHUB_SHA" \
            --latest

using MyEmailSearch.Indexing;

namespace MyEmailSearch.Tests;

public class ArchiveScannerTests
{
    [Test]
    public async Task FindEmails_ReturnsOnlyEmlFilesRecursively()
    {
        using var temp = new TempDirectory();
        var first = Sample.WriteEmail(temp.Path, "work", "INBOX", "one");
        var second = Sample.WriteEmail(temp.Path, "home", "Sent", "two");
        await File.WriteAllTextAsync(first + ".meta.json", "{}");
        await File.WriteAllTextAsync(Path.Combine(temp.Path, "index.v1.db"), "x");

        var found = ArchiveScanner.FindEmails(temp.Path).Order().ToList();

        await Assert.That(found.Count).IsEqualTo(2);
        await Assert.That(found.Contains(first)).IsTrue();
        await Assert.That(found.Contains(second)).IsTrue();
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task FindEmails_MissingArchiveIsEmpty()
    {
        using var temp = new TempDirectory();

        var found = ArchiveScanner.FindEmails(Path.Combine(temp.Path, "missing")).ToList();

        await Assert.That(found.Count).IsEqualTo(0);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task AccountAndFolder_ComeFromTheRelativePath()
    {
        var archive = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "archive");
        var file = Path.Combine(archive, "work", "INBOX", "cur", "one.eml");

        await Assert.That(ArchiveScanner.AccountOf(file, archive)).IsEqualTo("work");
        await Assert.That(ArchiveScanner.FolderOf(file, archive)).IsEqualTo("INBOX");
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task AccountAndFolder_AreNullForShallowPaths()
    {
        var archive = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "archive");

        await Assert.That(ArchiveScanner.AccountOf(Path.Combine(archive, "one.eml"), archive)).IsNull();
        await Assert.That(ArchiveScanner.FolderOf(Path.Combine(archive, "work", "one.eml"), archive)).IsNull();
    }
}

using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;

using MyEmailSearch.Indexing;

namespace MyEmailSearch.Tests;

public class EmailParserTests : IDisposable
{
    private readonly TempDirectory _temp = new();
    private readonly EmailParser _parser = new(NullLogger<EmailParser>.Instance, TimeProvider.System);

    public void Dispose() => _temp.Dispose();

    private string Write(string name, string content)
    {
        var directory = Path.Combine(_temp.Path, "work", "INBOX", "cur");
        Directory.CreateDirectory(directory);
        var path = Path.Combine(directory, name);
        File.WriteAllText(path, content);
        return path;
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task ParseAsync_ExtractsHeadersAndLocation()
    {
        var path = Write("one.eml", Sample.Email("one@example.com", "Quarterly report", "The   kafka\r\ncluster is healthy."));

        var document = await _parser.ParseAsync(path, _temp.Path, includeFullBody: true);

        await Assert.That(document).IsNotNull();
        await Assert.That(document!.MessageId).IsEqualTo("one@example.com");
        await Assert.That(document.FilePath).IsEqualTo(path);
        await Assert.That(document.FromAddress).IsEqualTo("alice@example.com");
        await Assert.That(document.FromName).IsEqualTo("Alice");
        await Assert.That(document.ToAddresses.Count).IsEqualTo(2);
        await Assert.That(document.ToAddresses[0]).IsEqualTo("bob@example.com");
        await Assert.That(document.ToAddresses[1]).IsEqualTo("carol@example.com");
        await Assert.That(document.CcAddresses[0]).IsEqualTo("dave@example.com");
        await Assert.That(document.Subject).IsEqualTo("Quarterly report");
        await Assert.That(document.DateSentUnix).IsEqualTo(1735036200L);
        await Assert.That(document.Account).IsEqualTo("work");
        await Assert.That(document.Folder).IsEqualTo("INBOX");
        await Assert.That(document.HasAttachments).IsFalse();
        await Assert.That(document.BodyText).IsEqualTo("The kafka cluster is healthy.");
        await Assert.That(document.BodyPreview).IsEqualTo("The kafka cluster is healthy.");
        await Assert.That(document.LastModifiedTicks).IsEqualTo(File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc(path).Ticks);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task ParseAsync_OmitsFullBodyUnlessRequestedAndTruncatesPreview()
    {
        var path = Write("long.eml", Sample.Email("long@example.com", "Long", new string('a', 600)));

        var document = await _parser.ParseAsync(path, _temp.Path, includeFullBody: false);

        await Assert.That(document).IsNotNull();
        await Assert.That(document!.BodyText).IsNull();
        await Assert.That(document.BodyPreview).IsEqualTo(new string('a', 500) + "...");
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task ParseAsync_WithoutMessageIdFallsBackToFileName()
    {
        var path = Write("1702900000.fallback.host.eml", Sample.Email(null, "No id", "Body"));

        var document = await _parser.ParseAsync(path, _temp.Path, includeFullBody: false);

        await Assert.That(document).IsNotNull();
        await Assert.That(document!.MessageId).IsEqualTo("1702900000.fallback.host");
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task ParseAsync_HtmlOnlyMessageIsReducedToText()
    {
        var path = Write("html.eml",
            "Message-ID: <html@example.com>\r\nFrom: alice@example.com\r\nSubject: Html\r\n" +
            "MIME-Version: 1.0\r\nContent-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8\r\n\r\n" +
            "<html><head><style>p { color: red; }</style></head><body><p>Fish &amp; chips</p><script>alert(1)</script></body></html>\r\n");

        var document = await _parser.ParseAsync(path, _temp.Path, includeFullBody: true);

        await Assert.That(document).IsNotNull();
        await Assert.That(document!.BodyText).IsEqualTo("Fish & chips");
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task ParseAsync_ListsAttachmentNames()
    {
        var path = Write("attachment.eml",
            "Message-ID: <att@example.com>\r\nFrom: alice@example.com\r\nSubject: Files\r\nMIME-Version: 1.0\r\n" +
            "Content-Type: multipart/mixed; boundary=\"sep\"\r\n\r\n" +
            "--sep\r\nContent-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8\r\n\r\nSee attached.\r\n" +
            "--sep\r\nContent-Type: application/pdf; name=\"report.pdf\"\r\n" +
            "Content-Disposition: attachment; filename=\"report.pdf\"\r\nContent-Transfer-Encoding: base64\r\n\r\nJVBERg==\r\n" +
            "--sep--\r\n");

        var document = await _parser.ParseAsync(path, _temp.Path, includeFullBody: true);

        await Assert.That(document).IsNotNull();
        await Assert.That(document!.HasAttachments).IsTrue();
        await Assert.That(document.AttachmentNames.Count).IsEqualTo(1);
        await Assert.That(document.AttachmentNames[0]).IsEqualTo("report.pdf");
        await Assert.That(document.BodyText).IsEqualTo("See attached.");
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task ParseAsync_MissingFileReturnsNull()
    {
        var document = await _parser.ParseAsync(Path.Combine(_temp.Path, "missing.eml"), _temp.Path, includeFullBody: false);

        await Assert.That(document).IsNull();
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task HtmlToText_DropsMarkupAndDecodesEntities()
    {
        var text = EmailParser.HtmlToText("<div>Tom &amp; Jerry&nbsp;&lt;3</div><STYLE>x{}</STYLE>");

        await Assert.That(text.Replace(' ', ' ').Trim()).IsEqualTo("Tom & Jerry <3");
    }
}

using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;

using MyEmailSearch.Data;
using MyEmailSearch.Indexing;

namespace MyEmailSearch.Tests;

public class IndexManagerTests : IAsyncDisposable
{
    private readonly TempDirectory _temp = new();
    private SearchDatabase? _database;

    public async ValueTask DisposeAsync()
    {
        if (_database is not null)
        {
            await _database.DisposeAsync();
        }

        _temp.Dispose();
    }

    private string Archive => Path.Combine(_temp.Path, "archive");

    private async Task<IndexManager> CreateAsync()
    {
        _database = await SearchDatabase.OpenAsync(Path.Combine(_temp.Path, "search.db"));
        return new IndexManager(
            _database,
            new EmailParser(NullLogger<EmailParser>.Instance, TimeProvider.System),
            NullLogger<IndexManager>.Instance,
            TimeProvider.System);
    }

    private sealed class RecordingProgress : IProgress<IndexingProgress>
    {
        public List<IndexingProgress> Reports { get; } = [];

        public void Report(IndexingProgress value) => Reports.Add(value);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task IndexAsync_IndexesEveryEmailAndRecordsTimestamp()
    {
        Sample.WriteEmail(Archive, "work", "INBOX", "one");
        Sample.WriteEmail(Archive, "home", "Sent", "two");
        var manager = await CreateAsync();
        var progress = new RecordingProgress();

        var result = await manager.IndexAsync(Archive, includeContent: true, progress);

        await Assert.That(result.Indexed).IsEqualTo(2);
        await Assert.That(result.Skipped).IsEqualTo(0);
        await Assert.That(result.Errors).IsEqualTo(0);
        await Assert.That(await _database!.GetEmailCountAsync()).IsEqualTo(2L);
        await Assert.That(await _database.CountAsync(new SearchQuery { Account = "home", Folder = "Sent" })).IsEqualTo(1);
        await Assert.That(await _database.GetMetadataAsync(SearchDatabase.LastIndexedKey)).IsNotNull();
        await Assert.That(progress.Reports.Count).IsEqualTo(2);
        await Assert.That(progress.Reports[1].Processed).IsEqualTo(2);
        await Assert.That(progress.Reports[1].Percentage).IsEqualTo(100d);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task IndexAsync_SkipsUnchangedFilesAndReindexesModifiedOnes()
    {
        var unchanged = Sample.WriteEmail(Archive, "work", "INBOX", "one");
        var modified = Sample.WriteEmail(Archive, "work", "INBOX", "two", subject: "Before");
        var manager = await CreateAsync();
        await manager.IndexAsync(Archive, includeContent: false);

        File.WriteAllText(modified, Sample.Email("two@example.com", "After", "Body"));
        File.SetLastWriteTimeUtc(modified, File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc(unchanged).AddMinutes(5));
        Sample.WriteEmail(Archive, "work", "INBOX", "three");
        var result = await manager.IndexAsync(Archive, includeContent: false);

        await Assert.That(result.Indexed).IsEqualTo(2);
        await Assert.That(result.Skipped).IsEqualTo(1);
        await Assert.That(await _database!.GetEmailCountAsync()).IsEqualTo(3L);
        await Assert.That(await _database.CountAsync(new SearchQuery { Subject = "After" })).IsEqualTo(1);
        await Assert.That(await _database.CountAsync(new SearchQuery { Subject = "Before" })).IsEqualTo(0);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task IndexAsync_ContentIsSearchableOnlyWhenRequested()
    {
        Sample.WriteEmail(Archive, "work", "INBOX", "one", body: "The kafka cluster is healthy.");
        var manager = await CreateAsync();

        await manager.IndexAsync(Archive, includeContent: false);
        var withoutContent = await _database!.CountAsync(new SearchQuery { ContentTerms = "kafka" });
        await manager.RebuildAsync(Archive, includeContent: true);
        var withContent = await _database.CountAsync(new SearchQuery { ContentTerms = "kafka" });

        await Assert.That(withoutContent).IsEqualTo(0);
        await Assert.That(withContent).IsEqualTo(1);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task IndexAsync_CountsUnreadableEmailsAsErrorsAndContinues()
    {
        Sample.WriteEmail(Archive, "work", "INBOX", "good");
        File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(Archive, "work", "INBOX", "cur", "empty.eml"), "");
        var manager = await CreateAsync();

        var result = await manager.IndexAsync(Archive, includeContent: false);

        await Assert.That(result.Indexed + result.Errors).IsEqualTo(2);
        await Assert.That(result.Indexed).IsGreaterThanOrEqualTo(1);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task IndexAsync_MissingArchiveIndexesNothing()
    {
        var manager = await CreateAsync();

        var result = await manager.IndexAsync(Path.Combine(_temp.Path, "missing"), includeContent: false);

        await Assert.That(result.Indexed).IsEqualTo(0);
        await Assert.That(result.Errors).IsEqualTo(0);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task IndexAsync_HandlesMoreThanOneBatch()
    {
        for (var i = 0; i < 230; i++)
        {
            Sample.WriteEmail(Archive, "work", "INBOX", $"message{i}");
        }

        var manager = await CreateAsync();

        var result = await manager.IndexAsync(Archive, includeContent: false);

        await Assert.That(result.Indexed).IsEqualTo(230);
        await Assert.That(await _database!.GetEmailCountAsync()).IsEqualTo(230L);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task IndexAsync_CancelledTokenStopsBeforeIndexing()
    {
        Sample.WriteEmail(Archive, "work", "INBOX", "one");
        var manager = await CreateAsync();
        using var cancellation = new CancellationTokenSource();
        cancellation.Cancel();

        var act = async () => await manager.IndexAsync(Archive, includeContent: false, ct: cancellation.Token);

        await Assert.ThrowsAsync<OperationCanceledException>(act);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task RebuildAsync_DropsRowsForFilesThatNoLongerMatch()
    {
        var path = Sample.WriteEmail(Archive, "work", "INBOX", "one");
        var manager = await CreateAsync();
        await manager.IndexAsync(Archive, includeContent: false);
        await _database!.UpsertAsync([Sample.Document("/stale/path.eml")]);

        var result = await manager.RebuildAsync(Archive, includeContent: false);

        var known = await _database.GetKnownFilesAsync();
        await Assert.That(result.Indexed).IsEqualTo(1);
        await Assert.That(known.Count).IsEqualTo(1);
        await Assert.That(known.ContainsKey(path)).IsTrue();
    }
}

using MyEmailSearch.Search;

namespace MyEmailSearch.Tests;

public class QueryParserTests
{
    private static DateTimeOffset LocalDay(int year, int month, int day) =>
        new(new DateTime(year, month, day, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Local));

    [Test]
    [Arguments("")]
    [Arguments("   ")]
    public async Task Parse_EmptyInputYieldsEmptyQuery(string? input)
    {
        var query = QueryParser.Parse(input);

        await Assert.That(query.ContentTerms).IsNull();
        await Assert.That(query.FromAddress).IsNull();
        await Assert.That(query.Take).IsEqualTo(100);
        await Assert.That(query.Skip).IsEqualTo(0);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task Parse_PlainTextBecomesContentTerms()
    {
        var query = QueryParser.Parse("  kafka cluster  ");

        await Assert.That(query.ContentTerms).IsEqualTo("kafka cluster");
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task Parse_ExtractsEveryField()
    {
        var query = QueryParser.Parse(
            "from:alice@example.com to:bob@example.com subject:report account:work folder:INBOX kafka");

        await Assert.That(query.FromAddress).IsEqualTo("alice@example.com");
        await Assert.That(query.ToAddress).IsEqualTo("bob@example.com");
        await Assert.That(query.Subject).IsEqualTo("report");
        await Assert.That(query.Account).IsEqualTo("work");
        await Assert.That(query.Folder).IsEqualTo("INBOX");
        await Assert.That(query.ContentTerms).IsEqualTo("kafka");
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task Parse_FieldNamesAreCaseInsensitive()
    {
        var query = QueryParser.Parse("FROM:Alice@Example.com");

        await Assert.That(query.FromAddress).IsEqualTo("Alice@Example.com");
        await Assert.That(query.ContentTerms).IsNull();
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task Parse_QuotedValuesMayContainSpacesAndColons()
    {
        var query = QueryParser.Parse("subject:\"from:x project update\" folder:\"Sent Items\" budget");

        await Assert.That(query.Subject).IsEqualTo("from:x project update");
        await Assert.That(query.Folder).IsEqualTo("Sent Items");
        await Assert.That(query.FromAddress).IsNull();
        await Assert.That(query.ContentTerms).IsEqualTo("budget");
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task Parse_FieldPrefixInsideAWordIsContent()
    {
        var query = QueryParser.Parse("photo:xyz");

        await Assert.That(query.ToAddress).IsNull();
        await Assert.That(query.ContentTerms).IsEqualTo("photo:xyz");
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task Parse_RepeatedFieldKeepsFirstAndLeavesRestAsContent()
    {
        var query = QueryParser.Parse("from:a@example.com from:b@example.com");

        await Assert.That(query.FromAddress).IsEqualTo("a@example.com");
        await Assert.That(query.ContentTerms).IsEqualTo("from:b@example.com");
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task Parse_SingleDateStartsAtLocalMidnight()
    {
        var query = QueryParser.Parse("date:2025-01-01 invoice");

        await Assert.That(query.DateFrom).IsEqualTo(LocalDay(2025, 1, 1));
        await Assert.That(query.DateTo).IsNull();
        await Assert.That(query.ContentTerms).IsEqualTo("invoice");
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task Parse_DateRangeIncludesWholeEndDay()
    {
        var query = QueryParser.Parse("date:2025-01-01..2025-06-30");

        await Assert.That(query.DateFrom).IsEqualTo(LocalDay(2025, 1, 1));
        await Assert.That(query.DateTo).IsEqualTo(LocalDay(2025, 6, 30).AddDays(1).AddTicks(-1));
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task Parse_AfterAndBeforeBoundTheRange()
    {
        var query = QueryParser.Parse("after:2024-03-01 before:2024-03-31 trip");

        await Assert.That(query.DateFrom).IsEqualTo(LocalDay(2024, 3, 1));
        await Assert.That(query.DateTo).IsEqualTo(LocalDay(2024, 3, 31).AddDays(1).AddTicks(-1));
        await Assert.That(query.ContentTerms).IsEqualTo("trip");
    }

    [Test]
    [Arguments("after:notadate")]
    [Arguments("before:2024-13-45")]
    [Arguments("date:2024-01-01..oops")]
    public async Task Parse_InvalidDatesStayInContent(string input)
    {
        var query = QueryParser.Parse(input);

        await Assert.That(query.DateFrom).IsNull();
        await Assert.That(query.DateTo).IsNull();
        await Assert.That(query.ContentTerms).IsEqualTo(input);
    }
}

using System.Text.Json;

using MyEmailSearch.Commands;
using MyEmailSearch.Data;

namespace MyEmailSearch.Tests;

public class ResultFormatterTests
{
    private static SearchResultSet Results() => new()
    {
        Results =
        [
            new SearchResult
            {
                Email = Sample.Document("/mail/1.eml", subject: "Say \"hi\"", body: "line one"),
                Snippet = "line one\nline two",
                MatchedTerms = ["line"]
            }
        ],
        TotalCount = 3,
        Take = 1,
        QueryTime = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(12)
    };

    private static string Format(SearchResultSet results, string format)
    {
        var writer = new StringWriter { NewLine = "\n" };
        ResultFormatter.Write(writer, results, format);
        return writer.ToString();
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task Table_ListsResultsWithSnippetAndTotals()
    {
        var output = Format(Results(), "table");

        await Assert.That(output).Contains("Found 3 results (12ms):");
        await Assert.That(output).Contains("alice@example.com");
        await Assert.That(output).Contains("Say \"hi\"");
        await Assert.That(output).Contains("             line one line two");
        await Assert.That(output).Contains("Showing 1 of 3 results");
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task Table_UnknownFormatFallsBackToTable()
    {
        await Assert.That(Format(Results(), "other")).Contains("Showing 1 of 3 results");
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task Table_WithoutResultsSaysSo()
    {
        await Assert.That(Format(new SearchResultSet(), "table")).IsEqualTo("No results found.\n");
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task Csv_QuotesEveryFieldAndEscapesQuotes()
    {
        var lines = Format(Results(), "CSV").Split('\n', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);

        await Assert.That(lines.Length).IsEqualTo(2);
        await Assert.That(lines[0]).IsEqualTo("MessageId,From,Subject,Date,Folder,Account,FilePath");
        await Assert.That(lines[1]).IsEqualTo(
            "\"/mail/1.eml@example.com\",\"alice@example.com\",\"Say \"\"hi\"\"\",\"2023-11-14 22:13:20\",\"INBOX\",\"work\",\"/mail/1.eml\"");
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task Json_KeepsTheEstablishedShape()
    {
        using var document = JsonDocument.Parse(Format(Results(), "json"));
        var root = document.RootElement;
        var first = root.GetProperty("Results")[0];
        var email = first.GetProperty("Email");

        await Assert.That(root.GetProperty("TotalCount").GetInt32()).IsEqualTo(3);
        await Assert.That(root.GetProperty("Skip").GetInt32()).IsEqualTo(0);
        await Assert.That(root.GetProperty("Take").GetInt32()).IsEqualTo(1);
        await Assert.That(root.GetProperty("HasMore").GetBoolean()).IsTrue();
        await Assert.That(root.TryGetProperty("QueryTime", out _)).IsTrue();
        await Assert.That(first.GetProperty("Snippet").GetString()).IsEqualTo("line one\nline two");
        await Assert.That(first.GetProperty("MatchedTerms")[0].GetString()).IsEqualTo("line");
        await Assert.That(first.TryGetProperty("Score", out _)).IsTrue();
        await Assert.That(email.GetProperty("MessageId").GetString()).IsEqualTo("/mail/1.eml@example.com");
        await Assert.That(email.GetProperty("FilePath").GetString()).IsEqualTo("/mail/1.eml");
        await Assert.That(email.GetProperty("FromAddress").GetString()).IsEqualTo("alice@example.com");
        await Assert.That(email.GetProperty("ToAddressesJson").GetString()).IsEqualTo("[\"bob@example.com\"]");
        await Assert.That(email.GetProperty("ToAddresses")[0].GetString()).IsEqualTo("bob@example.com");
        await Assert.That(email.GetProperty("DateSentUnix").GetInt64()).IsEqualTo(1_700_000_000L);
        await Assert.That(email.TryGetProperty("DateSent", out _)).IsTrue();
        await Assert.That(email.GetProperty("Folder").GetString()).IsEqualTo("INBOX");
        await Assert.That(email.GetProperty("Account").GetString()).IsEqualTo("work");
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task Truncate_ShortensWithEllipsis()
    {
        await Assert.That(ResultFormatter.Truncate("abcdefghij", 8)).IsEqualTo("abcde...");
        await Assert.That(ResultFormatter.Truncate("abc", 8)).IsEqualTo("abc");
    }
}

using System.CommandLine;
using System.Text.Json;

namespace MyEmailSearch.Tests;

public class SearchCliTests : IDisposable
{
    private readonly TempDirectory _temp = new();
    private readonly List<string> _opened = [];

    public void Dispose() => _temp.Dispose();

    private string Archive => Path.Combine(_temp.Path, "archive");

    private string Database => Path.Combine(_temp.Path, "index", "search.db");

    private async Task<(int ExitCode, string Output, string Error)> RunAsync(string input, params string[] args)
    {
        var output = new StringWriter();
        var error = new StringWriter();
        var invocation = new InvocationConfiguration
        {
            Output = output,
            Error = error,
            ProcessTerminationTimeout = null
        };

        string[] arguments = [.. args, "--archive", Archive, "--database", Database];
        var exitCode = await SearchCli.Create(new StringReader(input), _opened.Add)
            .Parse(arguments)
            .InvokeAsync(invocation);
        return (exitCode, output.ToString(), error.ToString());
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task Status_WithoutIndexExplainsHowToCreateOne()
    {
        var (exitCode, output, _) = await RunAsync("", "status");

        await Assert.That(exitCode).IsEqualTo(0);
        await Assert.That(output).Contains("No index exists yet");
        await Assert.That(File.Exists(Database)).IsFalse();
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task Search_WithoutIndexFails()
    {
        var (exitCode, _, error) = await RunAsync("", "search", "kafka");

        await Assert.That(exitCode).IsEqualTo(1);
        await Assert.That(error).Contains("No index exists");
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task IndexThenSearch_FindsArchivedEmailAsJson()
    {
        var path = Sample.WriteEmail(Archive, "work", "INBOX", "one", body: "The kafka cluster is healthy.");

        var (indexExit, indexOutput, _) = await RunAsync("", "index", "--content");
        var (searchExit, searchOutput, _) = await RunAsync("", "search", "from:alice@example.com kafka", "--format", "json");
        var (statusExit, statusOutput, _) = await RunAsync("", "status");

        using var document = JsonDocument.Parse(searchOutput);
        await Assert.That(indexExit).IsEqualTo(0);
        await Assert.That(indexOutput).Contains("New emails indexed: 1");
        await Assert.That(searchExit).IsEqualTo(0);
        await Assert.That(document.RootElement.GetProperty("TotalCount").GetInt32()).IsEqualTo(1);
        await Assert.That(document.RootElement.GetProperty("Results")[0].GetProperty("Email").GetProperty("FilePath").GetString())
            .IsEqualTo(path);
        await Assert.That(statusExit).IsEqualTo(0);
        await Assert.That(statusOutput).Contains("Total emails indexed: 1");
        await Assert.That(statusOutput).Contains("Database health:      OK");
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task Search_RejectsUnknownFormat()
    {
        Sample.WriteEmail(Archive, "work", "INBOX", "one");
        await RunAsync("", "index");

        var (exitCode, _, _) = await RunAsync("", "search", "kafka", "--format", "xml");

        await Assert.That(exitCode).IsNotEqualTo(0);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task Search_OpenLaunchesTheChosenEmail()
    {
        var path = Sample.WriteEmail(Archive, "work", "INBOX", "one");
        await RunAsync("", "index");

        var (exitCode, output, _) = await RunAsync("1\n", "search", "account:work", "--open");

        await Assert.That(exitCode).IsEqualTo(0);
        await Assert.That(output).Contains("Opening:");
        await Assert.That(_opened.Count).IsEqualTo(1);
        await Assert.That(_opened[0]).IsEqualTo(path);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task Rebuild_WithoutConfirmationDoesNothing()
    {
        Sample.WriteEmail(Archive, "work", "INBOX", "one");

        var (exitCode, output, _) = await RunAsync("n\n", "rebuild");

        await Assert.That(exitCode).IsEqualTo(0);
        await Assert.That(output).Contains("Cancelled.");
        await Assert.That(File.Exists(Database)).IsFalse();
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task Rebuild_WithYesReindexesEverything()
    {
        Sample.WriteEmail(Archive, "work", "INBOX", "one");
        await RunAsync("", "index");
        Sample.WriteEmail(Archive, "work", "INBOX", "two");

        var (exitCode, output, _) = await RunAsync("", "rebuild", "--yes");

        await Assert.That(exitCode).IsEqualTo(0);
        await Assert.That(output).Contains("Indexed: 2");
    }
}

using Microsoft.Data.Sqlite;

using MyEmailSearch.Data;

namespace MyEmailSearch.Tests;

public class SearchDatabaseTests : IAsyncDisposable
{
    private const string LegacySchema = """
        PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL;
        PRAGMA synchronous = NORMAL;
        PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;

        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS emails (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            message_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            file_path TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
            from_address TEXT,
            from_name TEXT,
            to_addresses TEXT,
            cc_addresses TEXT,
            bcc_addresses TEXT,
            subject TEXT,
            date_sent_unix INTEGER,
            date_received_unix INTEGER,
            folder TEXT,
            account TEXT,
            has_attachments INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
            attachment_names TEXT,
            body_preview TEXT,
            body_text TEXT,
            indexed_at_unix INTEGER NOT NULL,
            last_modified_ticks INTEGER DEFAULT 0
        );

        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_emails_from ON emails(from_address);
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_emails_date ON emails(date_sent_unix);
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_emails_folder ON emails(folder);
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_emails_account ON emails(account);
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_emails_message_id ON emails(message_id);

        CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS emails_fts USING fts5(
            subject,
            body_text,
            from_address,
            to_addresses,
            content='emails',
            content_rowid='id',
            tokenize='porter unicode61'
        );

        CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS emails_ai AFTER INSERT ON emails BEGIN
            INSERT INTO emails_fts(rowid, subject, body_text, from_address, to_addresses)
            VALUES (new.id, new.subject, new.body_text, new.from_address, new.to_addresses);
        END;

        CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS emails_ad AFTER DELETE ON emails BEGIN
            INSERT INTO emails_fts(emails_fts, rowid, subject, body_text, from_address, to_addresses)
            VALUES ('delete', old.id, old.subject, old.body_text, old.from_address, old.to_addresses);
        END;

        CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS emails_au AFTER UPDATE ON emails BEGIN
            INSERT INTO emails_fts(emails_fts, rowid, subject, body_text, from_address, to_addresses)
            VALUES ('delete', old.id, old.subject, old.body_text, old.from_address, old.to_addresses);
            INSERT INTO emails_fts(rowid, subject, body_text, from_address, to_addresses)
            VALUES (new.id, new.subject, new.body_text, new.from_address, new.to_addresses);
        END;

        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS index_metadata (
            key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            value TEXT NOT NULL
        );

        INSERT INTO emails (message_id, file_path, from_address, subject, body_text, indexed_at_unix, last_modified_ticks)
        VALUES ('legacy@example.com', '/mail/work/INBOX/cur/legacy.eml', 'Alice@Example.com', 'Legacy invoice', 'kafka migration notes', 1700000000, 638000000000000000);
        INSERT INTO index_metadata (key, value) VALUES ('last_indexed_time', '1700000000');
        """;

    private readonly TempDirectory _temp = new();
    private SearchDatabase? _database;

    public async ValueTask DisposeAsync()
    {
        if (_database is not null)
        {
            await _database.DisposeAsync();
        }

        _temp.Dispose();
    }

    private string DatabasePath => Path.Combine(_temp.Path, "nested", "search.db");

    private async Task<SearchDatabase> OpenAsync() => _database = await SearchDatabase.OpenAsync(DatabasePath);

    [Test]
    public async Task OpenAsync_CreatesDatabaseAndParentDirectory()
    {
        var database = await OpenAsync();

        await Assert.That(File.Exists(DatabasePath)).IsTrue();
        await Assert.That(database.SizeBytes).IsGreaterThan(0L);
        await Assert.That(await database.IsHealthyAsync()).IsTrue();
        await Assert.That(await database.GetEmailCountAsync()).IsEqualTo(0L);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task UpsertAsync_InsertsAndRoundTripsAllFields()
    {
        var database = await OpenAsync();
        var document = new EmailDocument
        {
            MessageId = "full@example.com",
            FilePath = "/mail/a.eml",
            FromAddress = "alice@example.com",
            FromName = "Alice",
            ToAddressesJson = "[\"bob@example.com\"]",
            CcAddressesJson = "[\"carol@example.com\"]",
            BccAddressesJson = "[\"dave@example.com\"]",
            Subject = "Hello",
            DateSentUnix = 1_700_000_000,
            DateReceivedUnix = 1_700_000_001,
            Folder = "INBOX",
            Account = "work",
            HasAttachments = true,
            AttachmentNamesJson = "[\"report.pdf\"]",
            BodyPreview = "preview",
            BodyText = "full body",
            IndexedAtUnix = 1_700_000_100,
            LastModifiedTicks = 42
        };

        await database.UpsertAsync([document]);
        var stored = (await database.QueryAsync(new SearchQuery())).Single();

        await Assert.That(stored.Id).IsGreaterThan(0L);
        await Assert.That(stored.MessageId).IsEqualTo("full@example.com");
        await Assert.That(stored.FilePath).IsEqualTo("/mail/a.eml");
        await Assert.That(stored.FromAddress).IsEqualTo("alice@example.com");
        await Assert.That(stored.FromName).IsEqualTo("Alice");
        await Assert.That(stored.ToAddresses[0]).IsEqualTo("bob@example.com");
        await Assert.That(stored.CcAddresses[0]).IsEqualTo("carol@example.com");
        await Assert.That(stored.BccAddresses[0]).IsEqualTo("dave@example.com");
        await Assert.That(stored.Subject).IsEqualTo("Hello");
        await Assert.That(stored.DateSentUnix).IsEqualTo(1_700_000_000L);
        await Assert.That(stored.DateReceivedUnix).IsEqualTo(1_700_000_001L);
        await Assert.That(stored.Folder).IsEqualTo("INBOX");
        await Assert.That(stored.Account).IsEqualTo("work");
        await Assert.That(stored.HasAttachments).IsTrue();
        await Assert.That(stored.AttachmentNames[0]).IsEqualTo("report.pdf");
        await Assert.That(stored.BodyPreview).IsEqualTo("preview");
        await Assert.That(stored.BodyText).IsEqualTo("full body");
        await Assert.That(stored.IndexedAtUnix).IsEqualTo(1_700_000_100L);
        await Assert.That(stored.LastModifiedTicks).IsEqualTo(42L);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task UpsertAsync_StoresMissingValuesAsNull()
    {
        var database = await OpenAsync();

        await database.UpsertAsync([Sample.Document("/mail/a.eml", from: null, subject: null, to: null, dateSentUnix: null, account: null, folder: null)]);
        var stored = (await database.QueryAsync(new SearchQuery())).Single();

        await Assert.That(stored.FromAddress).IsNull();
        await Assert.That(stored.Subject).IsNull();
        await Assert.That(stored.DateSentUnix).IsNull();
        await Assert.That(stored.ToAddresses.Count).IsEqualTo(0);
        await Assert.That(stored.HasAttachments).IsFalse();
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task UpsertAsync_SameFilePathUpdatesRowAndFullTextIndex()
    {
        var database = await OpenAsync();
        await database.UpsertAsync([Sample.Document("/mail/a.eml", subject: "Original", body: "alpha")]);

        await database.UpsertAsync([Sample.Document("/mail/a.eml", subject: "Updated", body: "beta", lastModifiedTicks: 2)]);

        await Assert.That(await database.GetEmailCountAsync()).IsEqualTo(1L);
        await Assert.That(await database.CountAsync(new SearchQuery { ContentTerms = "alpha" })).IsEqualTo(0);
        await Assert.That(await database.CountAsync(new SearchQuery { ContentTerms = "beta" })).IsEqualTo(1);
        await Assert.That((await database.GetKnownFilesAsync())["/mail/a.eml"]).IsEqualTo(2L);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task UpsertAsync_EmptyBatchIsANoOp()
    {
        var database = await OpenAsync();

        await database.UpsertAsync([]);

        await Assert.That(await database.GetEmailCountAsync()).IsEqualTo(0L);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task Query_FullTextMatchesSubjectBodySenderAndStems()
    {
        var database = await OpenAsync();
        await database.UpsertAsync(
        [
            Sample.Document("/mail/1.eml", subject: "Important meeting", body: "agenda attached"),
            Sample.Document("/mail/2.eml", subject: "Casual chat", body: "we were running late"),
            Sample.Document("/mail/3.eml", subject: "Other", body: "nothing", from: "zed@kafka.example")
        ]);

        await Assert.That(await database.CountAsync(new SearchQuery { ContentTerms = "meeting" })).IsEqualTo(1);
        await Assert.That(await database.CountAsync(new SearchQuery { ContentTerms = "run" })).IsEqualTo(1);
        await Assert.That(await database.CountAsync(new SearchQuery { ContentTerms = "kafka" })).IsEqualTo(1);
        await Assert.That(await database.CountAsync(new SearchQuery { ContentTerms = "agen*" })).IsEqualTo(1);
        await Assert.That(await database.CountAsync(new SearchQuery { ContentTerms = "absent" })).IsEqualTo(0);
    }

    [Test]
    [Arguments("say \"hello\"")]
    [Arguments("a AND (b OR")]
    [Arguments("subject:x NEAR/2 y")]
    [Arguments("it's -negated ^caret")]
    public async Task Query_TreatsFullTextSyntaxAsLiteralText(string terms)
    {
        var database = await OpenAsync();
        await database.UpsertAsync([Sample.Document("/mail/1.eml", body: "plain words")]);

        var count = await database.CountAsync(new SearchQuery { ContentTerms = terms });

        await Assert.That(count).IsEqualTo(0);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task Query_FiltersBySenderExactlyIgnoringCaseOrByWildcard()
    {
        var database = await OpenAsync();
        await database.UpsertAsync(
        [
            Sample.Document("/mail/1.eml", from: "Alice@Example.com"),
            Sample.Document("/mail/2.eml", from: "bob@example.com"),
            Sample.Document("/mail/3.eml", from: "carol@other.org")
        ]);

        await Assert.That(await database.CountAsync(new SearchQuery { FromAddress = "alice@example.com" })).IsEqualTo(1);
        await Assert.That(await database.CountAsync(new SearchQuery { FromAddress = "*@example.com" })).IsEqualTo(2);
        await Assert.That(await database.CountAsync(new SearchQuery { FromAddress = "alice" })).IsEqualTo(0);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task Query_FiltersByRecipientSubjectAccountFolderAndDate()
    {
        var database = await OpenAsync();
        await database.UpsertAsync(
        [
            Sample.Document("/mail/1.eml", subject: "Budget 2025", to: "[\"bob@example.com\"]", account: "work", folder: "INBOX", dateSentUnix: 1000),
            Sample.Document("/mail/2.eml", subject: "Holiday", to: "[\"carol@example.com\"]", account: "home", folder: "Sent", dateSentUnix: 2000)
        ]);

        await Assert.That(await database.CountAsync(new SearchQuery { ToAddress = "carol@" })).IsEqualTo(1);
        await Assert.That(await database.CountAsync(new SearchQuery { Subject = "budget" })).IsEqualTo(1);
        await Assert.That(await database.CountAsync(new SearchQuery { Account = "home" })).IsEqualTo(1);
        await Assert.That(await database.CountAsync(new SearchQuery { Folder = "INBOX" })).IsEqualTo(1);
        await Assert.That(await database.CountAsync(new SearchQuery { DateFrom = DateTimeOffset.FromUnixTimeSeconds(1500) })).IsEqualTo(1);
        await Assert.That(await database.CountAsync(new SearchQuery { DateTo = DateTimeOffset.FromUnixTimeSeconds(1500) })).IsEqualTo(1);
        await Assert.That(await database.CountAsync(new SearchQuery { Account = "work", Folder = "Sent" })).IsEqualTo(0);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task Query_PagesNewestFirstWhileCountIgnoresPaging()
    {
        var database = await OpenAsync();
        await database.UpsertAsync(
            Enumerable.Range(1, 5).Select(i => Sample.Document($"/mail/{i}.eml", dateSentUnix: i * 100)).ToList());

        var page = await database.QueryAsync(new SearchQuery { Take = 2, Skip = 1 });

        await Assert.That(page.Count).IsEqualTo(2);
        await Assert.That(page[0].FilePath).IsEqualTo("/mail/4.eml");
        await Assert.That(page[1].FilePath).IsEqualTo("/mail/3.eml");
        await Assert.That(await database.CountAsync(new SearchQuery { Take = 2, Skip = 1 })).IsEqualTo(5);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task Metadata_RoundTripsAndOverwrites()
    {
        var database = await OpenAsync();

        await database.SetMetadataAsync("key", "one");
        await database.SetMetadataAsync("key", "two");

        await Assert.That(await database.GetMetadataAsync("key")).IsEqualTo("two");
        await Assert.That(await database.GetMetadataAsync("missing")).IsNull();
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task ResetAsync_DiscardsEverythingAndStaysUsable()
    {
        var database = await OpenAsync();
        await database.UpsertAsync([Sample.Document("/mail/1.eml", body: "alpha")]);
        await database.SetMetadataAsync("key", "value");

        await database.ResetAsync();
        await database.UpsertAsync([Sample.Document("/mail/2.eml", body: "beta")]);

        await Assert.That(await database.GetEmailCountAsync()).IsEqualTo(1L);
        await Assert.That(await database.GetMetadataAsync("key")).IsNull();
        await Assert.That(await database.CountAsync(new SearchQuery { ContentTerms = "alpha" })).IsEqualTo(0);
        await Assert.That(await database.CountAsync(new SearchQuery { ContentTerms = "beta" })).IsEqualTo(1);
        await Assert.That(await database.IsHealthyAsync()).IsTrue();
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task OpenAsync_ReusesIndexBuiltByEarlierVersionsWithoutRebuild()
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(DatabasePath)!);
        await using (var connection = new SqliteConnection($"Data Source={DatabasePath};Pooling=False"))
        {
            await connection.OpenAsync();
            await using var command = connection.CreateCommand();
            command.CommandText = LegacySchema;
            await command.ExecuteNonQueryAsync();
        }

        var database = await OpenAsync();
        await database.UpsertAsync([Sample.Document("/mail/new.eml", from: "bob@example.com", body: "fresh content")]);

        var known = await database.GetKnownFilesAsync();
        await Assert.That(known["/mail/work/INBOX/cur/legacy.eml"]).IsEqualTo(638000000000000000L);
        await Assert.That(await database.GetMetadataAsync(SearchDatabase.LastIndexedKey)).IsEqualTo("1700000000");
        await Assert.That(await database.CountAsync(new SearchQuery { ContentTerms = "kafka" })).IsEqualTo(1);
        await Assert.That(await database.CountAsync(new SearchQuery { FromAddress = "alice@example.com" })).IsEqualTo(1);
        await Assert.That(await database.CountAsync(new SearchQuery { ContentTerms = "fresh" })).IsEqualTo(1);
        await Assert.That(await database.GetEmailCountAsync()).IsEqualTo(2L);
    }
}

using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;

using MyEmailSearch.Data;
using MyEmailSearch.Search;

namespace MyEmailSearch.Tests;

public class SearchEngineTests : IAsyncDisposable
{
    private readonly TempDirectory _temp = new();
    private SearchDatabase? _database;

    public async ValueTask DisposeAsync()
    {
        if (_database is not null)
        {
            await _database.DisposeAsync();
        }

        _temp.Dispose();
    }

    private async Task<SearchEngine> CreateAsync(params EmailDocument[] documents)
    {
        _database = await SearchDatabase.OpenAsync(Path.Combine(_temp.Path, "search.db"));
        await _database.UpsertAsync(documents);
        return new SearchEngine(_database, NullLogger<SearchEngine>.Instance);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task SearchAsync_BlankQueryReturnsNothing()
    {
        var engine = await CreateAsync(Sample.Document("/mail/1.eml"));

        var results = await engine.SearchAsync("   ", limit: 10, offset: 5);

        await Assert.That(results.TotalCount).IsEqualTo(0);
        await Assert.That(results.Results.Count).IsEqualTo(0);
        await Assert.That(results.Take).IsEqualTo(10);
        await Assert.That(results.Skip).IsEqualTo(5);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task SearchAsync_CombinesFieldFiltersWithFullText()
    {
        var engine = await CreateAsync(
            Sample.Document("/mail/1.eml", from: "alice@example.com", subject: "Report", body: "kafka outage review"),
            Sample.Document("/mail/2.eml", from: "bob@example.com", subject: "Report", body: "kafka upgrade"),
            Sample.Document("/mail/3.eml", from: "alice@example.com", subject: "Lunch", body: "sandwiches"));

        var results = await engine.SearchAsync("from:alice@example.com kafka");

        await Assert.That(results.TotalCount).IsEqualTo(1);
        await Assert.That(results.Results[0].Email.FilePath).IsEqualTo("/mail/1.eml");
        await Assert.That(results.Results[0].Snippet).IsEqualTo("kafka outage review");
        await Assert.That(results.Results[0].MatchedTerms.Count).IsEqualTo(1);
        await Assert.That(results.Results[0].MatchedTerms[0]).IsEqualTo("kafka");
        await Assert.That(results.HasMore).IsFalse();
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task SearchAsync_ReportsTotalBeyondThePage()
    {
        var engine = await CreateAsync(
            Enumerable.Range(1, 5).Select(i => Sample.Document($"/mail/{i}.eml", dateSentUnix: i)).ToArray());

        var results = await engine.SearchAsync("account:work", limit: 2);

        await Assert.That(results.Results.Count).IsEqualTo(2);
        await Assert.That(results.TotalCount).IsEqualTo(5);
        await Assert.That(results.HasMore).IsTrue();
        await Assert.That(results.Results[0].Email.FilePath).IsEqualTo("/mail/5.eml");
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task SearchAsync_WithoutContentTermsUsesPreviewAsSnippet()
    {
        var engine = await CreateAsync(Sample.Document("/mail/1.eml", body: "preview text"));

        var results = await engine.SearchAsync("folder:INBOX");

        await Assert.That(results.Results[0].Snippet).IsEqualTo("preview text");
        await Assert.That(results.Results[0].MatchedTerms.Count).IsEqualTo(0);
    }
}

using MyEmailSearch.Configuration;

using MyImapDownloader.Core.Paths;

namespace MyEmailSearch.Tests;

public class SearchPathsTests
{
    private static readonly string Home = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "home");
    private static readonly string Documents = Path.Combine(Home, "MyDocuments");

    private static XdgDirectories Xdg(string? archive = null, string? dataHome = null) => new(
        name => name switch
        {
            SearchPaths.ArchiveVariable => archive,
            "XDG_DATA_HOME" => dataHome,
            _ => null
        },
        Home);

    [Test]
    public async Task DefaultDatabase_LivesUnderDataHome()
    {
        await Assert.That(SearchPaths.DefaultDatabase(Xdg()))
            .IsEqualTo(Path.Combine(Home, ".local", "share", "myemailsearch", "search.db"));
        await Assert.That(SearchPaths.DefaultDatabase(Xdg(dataHome: "/data")))
            .IsEqualTo(Path.Combine("/data", "myemailsearch", "search.db"));
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task DefaultArchive_PrefersExistingEnvironmentPath()
    {
        var archive = SearchPaths.DefaultArchive(Xdg(archive: "/custom", dataHome: "/data"), Documents, _ => true);

        await Assert.That(archive).IsEqualTo("/custom");
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task DefaultArchive_SkipsCandidatesThatDoNotExist()
    {
        var documentsMail = Path.Combine(Home, "Documents", "mail");

        var archive = SearchPaths.DefaultArchive(
            Xdg(archive: "/custom", dataHome: "/data"), Documents, path => path == documentsMail);

        await Assert.That(archive).IsEqualTo(documentsMail);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task DefaultArchive_FallsBackToDataHome()
    {
        await Assert.That(SearchPaths.DefaultArchive(Xdg(), Documents, _ => false))
            .IsEqualTo(Path.Combine(Home, ".local", "share", "myimapdownloader"));
        await Assert.That(SearchPaths.DefaultArchive(Xdg(dataHome: "/data"), Documents, _ => false))
            .IsEqualTo(Path.Combine("/data", "myimapdownloader"));
    }
}

################################################################################

using MyEmailSearch.Data;

namespace MyEmailSearch.Tests;

public class SearchSqlTests
{
    [Test]
    [Arguments("")]
    [Arguments("   ")]
    [Arguments("*")]
    public async Task FtsMatch_WithoutTermsIsNull(string? terms)
    {
        await Assert.That(SearchSql.FtsMatch(terms)).IsNull();
    }

    [Test]
    [Arguments("kafka", "\"kafka\"")]
    [Arguments("  hello world  ", "\"hello world\"")]
    [Arguments("kaf*", "\"kaf\"*")]
    [Arguments("say \"hi\"", "\"say \"\"hi\"\"\"")]
    [Arguments("a OR b", "\"a OR b\"")]
    [Arguments("col:value", "\"col:value\"")]
    public async Task FtsMatch_QuotesTermsAsOnePhrase(string terms, string expected)
    {
        await Assert.That(SearchSql.FtsMatch(terms)).IsEqualTo(expected);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task Select_WithoutContentOrdersByDate()
    {
        var statement = SearchSql.Select(new SearchQuery { Account = "work", Take = 5, Skip = 10 });

        await Assert.That(statement.Text).Contains("WHERE emails.account = @account");
        await Assert.That(statement.Text).Contains("ORDER BY emails.date_sent_unix DESC");
        await Assert.That(statement.Text).DoesNotContain("emails_fts");
        await Assert.That(statement.Parameters.Count).IsEqualTo(3);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task Select_WithContentJoinsFullTextIndexAndRanks()
    {
        var statement = SearchSql.Select(new SearchQuery { ContentTerms = "kafka" });

        await Assert.That(statement.Text).Contains("emails_fts MATCH @ftsQuery");
        await Assert.That(statement.Text).Contains("ORDER BY bm25(emails_fts)");
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task Count_HasNoPagingParameters()
    {
        var statement = SearchSql.Count(new SearchQuery { Subject = "report" });

        await Assert.That(statement.Text).IsEqualTo("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM emails WHERE emails.subject LIKE @subject;");
        await Assert.That(statement.Parameters.Count).IsEqualTo(1);
    }
}

using MyEmailSearch.Search;

namespace MyEmailSearch.Tests;

public class SnippetGeneratorTests
{
    [Test]
    [Arguments("")]
    [Arguments("   ")]
    public async Task Generate_WithoutBodyReturnsNull(string? body)
    {
        await Assert.That(SnippetGenerator.Generate(body, "kafka")).IsNull();
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task Generate_ShortBodyIsReturnedWhole()
    {
        await Assert.That(SnippetGenerator.Generate("The kafka cluster is healthy.", "kafka"))
            .IsEqualTo("The kafka cluster is healthy.");
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task Generate_WithoutTermsTruncatesAtWordBoundary()
    {
        var body = string.Join(' ', Enumerable.Repeat("word", 100));

        var snippet = SnippetGenerator.Generate(body, null);

        await Assert.That(snippet).IsNotNull();
        await Assert.That(snippet!.EndsWith("word...")).IsTrue();
        await Assert.That(snippet.Length).IsLessThanOrEqualTo(203);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task Generate_CentersOnFirstMatchIgnoringCase()
    {
        var body = string.Join(' ', Enumerable.Repeat("filler", 60)) + " KAFKA outage " +
            string.Join(' ', Enumerable.Repeat("trailer", 60));

        var snippet = SnippetGenerator.Generate(body, "missing kafka") ?? "";

        await Assert.That(snippet).Contains("KAFKA outage");
        await Assert.That(snippet.StartsWith("...")).IsTrue();
        await Assert.That(snippet.EndsWith("...")).IsTrue();
        await Assert.That(snippet.Length).IsLessThanOrEqualTo(220);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task Generate_UnmatchedTermsFallBackToLeadingText()
    {
        var body = string.Join(' ', Enumerable.Repeat("word", 100));

        var snippet = SnippetGenerator.Generate(body, "absent");

        await Assert.That(snippet).IsNotNull();
        await Assert.That(snippet!.StartsWith("word word")).IsTrue();
    }
}

using System.Text;

using MyEmailSearch.Data;

namespace MyEmailSearch.Tests;

public sealed class TempDirectory : IDisposable
{
    public TempDirectory()
    {
        Path = System.IO.Path.Combine(System.IO.Path.GetTempPath(), $"search_tests_{Guid.NewGuid():N}");
        Directory.CreateDirectory(Path);
    }

    public string Path { get; }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        try
        {
            Directory.Delete(Path, recursive: true);
        }
        catch (Exception exception) when (exception is IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException)
        {
        }
    }
}

public static class Sample
{
    public static EmailDocument Document(
        string filePath,
        string? from = "alice@example.com",
        string? subject = "Quarterly report",
        string? body = null,
        string? to = "[\"bob@example.com\"]",
        long? dateSentUnix = 1_700_000_000,
        string? account = "work",
        string? folder = "INBOX",
        long lastModifiedTicks = 1) => new()
        {
            MessageId = filePath + "@example.com",
            FilePath = filePath,
            FromAddress = from,
            FromName = "Alice",
            ToAddressesJson = to,
            Subject = subject,
            DateSentUnix = dateSentUnix,
            Folder = folder,
            Account = account,
            BodyPreview = body,
            BodyText = body,
            IndexedAtUnix = 1_700_000_100,
            LastModifiedTicks = lastModifiedTicks
        };

    public static string WriteEmail(
        string archivePath,
        string account,
        string folder,
        string name,
        string subject = "Quarterly report",
        string body = "The kafka cluster is healthy.",
        string from = "Alice <alice@example.com>")
    {
        var directory = Path.Combine(archivePath, account, folder, "cur");
        Directory.CreateDirectory(directory);
        var path = Path.Combine(directory, name + ".eml");
        File.WriteAllText(path, Email(name + "@example.com", subject, body, from), Encoding.ASCII);
        return path;
    }

    public static string Email(string? messageId, string subject, string body, string from = "Alice <alice@example.com>")
    {
        var builder = new StringBuilder();
        if (messageId is not null)
        {
            builder.Append($"Message-ID: <{messageId}>\r\n");
        }

        builder.Append($"From: {from}\r\n");
        builder.Append("To: Bob <bob@example.com>, carol@example.com\r\n");
        builder.Append("Cc: dave@example.com\r\n");
        builder.Append($"Subject: {subject}\r\n");
        builder.Append("Date: Tue, 24 Dec 2024 10:30:00 +0000\r\n");
        builder.Append("MIME-Version: 1.0\r\n");
        builder.Append("Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8\r\n");
        builder.Append("\r\n");
        builder.Append(body).Append("\r\n");
        return builder.ToString();
    }
}

using System.Diagnostics;

using MyEmailSearch.Indexing;

namespace MyEmailSearch.Commands;

public sealed class ConsoleProgress(TextWriter output) : IProgress<IndexingProgress>
{
    private static readonly TimeSpan Interval = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(100);
    private const int LineWidth = 100;

    private long _lastReport;

    public void Report(IndexingProgress value)
    {
        if (value.Processed < value.Total && Stopwatch.GetElapsedTime(_lastReport) < Interval)
        {
            return;
        }

        _lastReport = Stopwatch.GetTimestamp();
        var line = $"\rProcessing: {value.Processed:N0}/{value.Total:N0} ({value.Percentage:F1}%) - {value.CurrentFile}";
        output.Write(line.PadRight(LineWidth)[..LineWidth]);
    }
}
