using System.CommandLine;

namespace MyEmailSearch.Commands;

public static class IndexCommand
{
    public static Command Create(GlobalOptions global)
    {
        var full = new Option<bool>("--full", "-f") { Description = "Force full re-index (ignore incremental state)" };
        var content = new Option<bool>("--content") { Description = "Index email body content for full-text search" };

        var command = new Command("index", "Build or update the search index") { full, content };

        command.SetAction(async (parseResult, ct) =>
        {
            var settings = global.Resolve(parseResult);
            var output = parseResult.InvocationConfiguration.Output;
            var rebuild = parseResult.GetValue(full);
            var includeContent = parseResult.GetValue(content);

            output.WriteLine($"Indexing emails from: {settings.ArchivePath}");
            output.WriteLine($"Database location:    {settings.DatabasePath}");
            output.WriteLine($"Mode:                 {(rebuild ? "Full rebuild" : "Incremental")}");
            output.WriteLine($"Index content:        {(includeContent ? "Yes" : "No")}");
            output.WriteLine();

            await using var context = await SearchContext.OpenAsync(settings, ct);
            var progress = new ConsoleProgress(output);
            var result = rebuild
                ? await context.Indexer.RebuildAsync(settings.ArchivePath, includeContent, progress, ct)
                : await context.Indexer.IndexAsync(settings.ArchivePath, includeContent, progress, ct);

            output.WriteLine();
            output.WriteLine();
            output.WriteLine("Indexing complete:");
            output.WriteLine($"  New emails indexed: {result.Indexed:N0}");
            output.WriteLine($"  Skipped (existing): {result.Skipped:N0}");
            output.WriteLine($"  Errors:             {result.Errors:N0}");
            output.WriteLine($"  Duration:           {result.Duration}");
        });

        return command;
    }
}

using System.CommandLine;

namespace MyEmailSearch.Commands;

public static class RebuildCommand
{
    public static Command Create(GlobalOptions global, TextReader input)
    {
        var yes = new Option<bool>("--yes", "-y") { Description = "Skip confirmation prompt" };
        var content = new Option<bool>("--content") { Description = "Also index email body content" };

        var command = new Command("rebuild", "Rebuild the entire search index from scratch") { yes, content };

        command.SetAction(async (parseResult, ct) =>
        {
            var settings = global.Resolve(parseResult);
            var output = parseResult.InvocationConfiguration.Output;

            if (!parseResult.GetValue(yes))
            {
                output.Write("This will delete and rebuild the entire index. Continue? [y/N]: ");
                if (!string.Equals(input.ReadLine()?.Trim(), "y", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    output.WriteLine("Cancelled.");
                    return;
                }
            }

            output.WriteLine("Rebuilding index...");
            output.WriteLine($"Archive path: {settings.ArchivePath}");
            output.WriteLine($"Database path: {settings.DatabasePath}");
            output.WriteLine();

            await using var context = await SearchContext.OpenAsync(settings, ct);
            var result = await context.Indexer.RebuildAsync(
                settings.ArchivePath, parseResult.GetValue(content), new ConsoleProgress(output), ct);

            output.WriteLine();
            output.WriteLine();
            output.WriteLine("Rebuild complete:");
            output.WriteLine($"  Indexed: {result.Indexed:N0}");
            output.WriteLine($"  Errors:  {result.Errors:N0}");
            output.WriteLine($"  Time:    {result.Duration}");
        });

        return command;
    }
}

using System.Text.Json;

using MyEmailSearch.Data;

namespace MyEmailSearch.Commands;

public static class ResultFormatter
{
    public static readonly string[] Formats = ["table", "json", "csv"];

    public static void Write(TextWriter output, SearchResultSet results, string format)
    {
        switch (format.ToLowerInvariant())
        {
            case "json":
                output.WriteLine(JsonSerializer.Serialize(results, SearchOutputJsonContext.Default.SearchResultSet));
                break;
            case "csv":
                WriteCsv(output, results);
                break;
            default:
                WriteTable(output, results);
                break;
        }
    }

    public static string Truncate(string value, int maxLength) =>
        value.Length <= maxLength ? value : value[..(maxLength - 3)] + "...";

    private static void WriteTable(TextWriter output, SearchResultSet results)
    {
        if (results.TotalCount == 0)
        {
            output.WriteLine("No results found.");
            return;
        }

        output.WriteLine($"Found {results.TotalCount} results ({results.QueryTime.TotalMilliseconds:F0}ms):");
        output.WriteLine();
        output.WriteLine($"{"Date",-12} {"From",-30} {"Subject",-50}");
        output.WriteLine(new string('-', 94));

        foreach (var result in results.Results)
        {
            var date = result.Email.DateSent?.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd") ?? "Unknown";
            var from = Truncate(result.Email.FromAddress ?? "Unknown", 28);
            var subject = Truncate(result.Email.Subject ?? "(no subject)", 48);
            output.WriteLine($"{date,-12} {from,-30} {subject,-50}");

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(result.Snippet))
            {
                output.WriteLine($"             {Truncate(result.Snippet.Replace("\n", " ").Replace("\r", ""), 80)}");
            }
        }

        output.WriteLine();
        output.WriteLine($"Showing {results.Results.Count} of {results.TotalCount} results");
    }

    private static void WriteCsv(TextWriter output, SearchResultSet results)
    {
        output.WriteLine("MessageId,From,Subject,Date,Folder,Account,FilePath");
        foreach (var email in results.Results.Select(result => result.Email))
        {
            output.WriteLine(string.Join(
                ',',
                Quote(email.MessageId),
                Quote(email.FromAddress),
                Quote(email.Subject),
                Quote(email.DateSent?.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss")),
                Quote(email.Folder),
                Quote(email.Account),
                Quote(email.FilePath)));
        }
    }

    private static string Quote(string? value) => $"\"{value?.Replace("\"", "\"\"")}\"";
}

using System.CommandLine;
using System.Diagnostics;

using MyEmailSearch.Data;

namespace MyEmailSearch.Commands;

public static class SearchCommand
{
    private const int MaxChoices = 20;

    public static Command Create(GlobalOptions global, TextReader input, Action<string> open)
    {
        var query = new Argument<string>("query")
        {
            Description = "Search query (e.g., 'from:alice@example.com subject:report kafka')"
        };
        var limit = new Option<int>("--limit", "-l")
        {
            Description = "Maximum number of results to return",
            DefaultValueFactory = _ => 100
        };
        var format = new Option<string>("--format", "-f")
        {
            Description = "Output format: table, json, or csv",
            DefaultValueFactory = _ => "table"
        };
        format.AcceptOnlyFromAmong(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase, ResultFormatter.Formats);
        var interactive = new Option<bool>("--open", "-o")
        {
            Description = "Interactively select and open an email in your default application"
        };

        var command = new Command("search", "Search emails in the archive") { query, limit, format, interactive };

        command.SetAction(async (parseResult, ct) =>
        {
            var settings = global.Resolve(parseResult);
            var output = parseResult.InvocationConfiguration.Output;
            var error = parseResult.InvocationConfiguration.Error;
            var text = parseResult.GetRequiredValue(query);

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
            {
                error.WriteLine("Error: Search query cannot be empty");
                return 1;
            }

            if (!File.Exists(settings.DatabasePath))
            {
                error.WriteLine($"Error: No index exists at {settings.DatabasePath}");
                error.WriteLine("Run 'myemailsearch index' first to create the index.");
                return 1;
            }

            await using var context = await SearchContext.OpenAsync(settings, ct);
            var results = await context.Engine.SearchAsync(text, parseResult.GetValue(limit), 0, ct);

            try
            {
                if (parseResult.GetValue(interactive) && results.Results.Count > 0)
                {
                    Choose(results, input, output, error, open);
                }
                else
                {
                    ResultFormatter.Write(output, results, parseResult.GetRequiredValue(format));
                }
            }
            catch (IOException exception) when (settings.Verbose)
            {
                error.WriteLine($"Output error: {exception.Message}");
            }
            catch (IOException)
            {
            }

            return 0;
        });

        return command;
    }

    public static void OpenWithDefaultApplication(string path)
    {
        using var process = Process.Start(new ProcessStartInfo(path) { UseShellExecute = true });
    }

    private static void Choose(
        SearchResultSet results,
        TextReader input,
        TextWriter output,
        TextWriter error,
        Action<string> open)
    {
        var shown = Math.Min(results.Results.Count, MaxChoices);

        output.WriteLine($"Found {results.TotalCount} results ({results.QueryTime.TotalMilliseconds:F0}ms):");
        output.WriteLine();

        for (var i = 0; i < shown; i++)
        {
            var email = results.Results[i].Email;
            var date = email.DateSent?.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd") ?? "Unknown";
            var from = ResultFormatter.Truncate(email.FromAddress ?? "Unknown", 25);
            var subject = ResultFormatter.Truncate(email.Subject ?? "(no subject)", 45);
            output.WriteLine($"[{i + 1,2}] {date}  {from,-25}  {subject}");
        }

        if (results.TotalCount > shown)
        {
            output.WriteLine($"... and {results.TotalCount - shown} more (use --limit to see more)");
        }

        output.WriteLine();
        output.Write($"Open which result? (1-{shown}, or q to quit): ");

        var answer = input.ReadLine()?.Trim();
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(answer) || answer.Equals("q", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            output.WriteLine("Cancelled.");
            return;
        }

        if (!int.TryParse(answer, out var selection) || selection < 1 || selection > shown)
        {
            error.WriteLine($"Invalid selection. Please enter a number between 1 and {shown}.");
            return;
        }

        var path = results.Results[selection - 1].Email.FilePath;
        if (!File.Exists(path))
        {
            error.WriteLine($"Error: Email file not found: {path}");
            return;
        }

        output.WriteLine($"Opening: {path}");
        try
        {
            open(path);
        }
        catch (Exception exception) when (exception is not OperationCanceledException)
        {
            error.WriteLine($"Error opening file: {exception.Message}");
        }
    }
}

using System.CommandLine;

using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

using MyEmailSearch.Configuration;
using MyEmailSearch.Data;
using MyEmailSearch.Indexing;
using MyEmailSearch.Search;

namespace MyEmailSearch.Commands;

public sealed record SearchSettings(string ArchivePath, string DatabasePath, bool Verbose);

public sealed class GlobalOptions
{
    public Option<string?> Archive { get; } = new("--archive", "-a")
    {
        Description = "Path to the email archive directory",
        Recursive = true
    };

    public Option<string?> Database { get; } = new("--database", "-d")
    {
        Description = "Path to the search database file",
        Recursive = true
    };

    public Option<bool> Verbose { get; } = new("--verbose", "-v")
    {
        Description = "Enable verbose output",
        Recursive = true
    };

    public void AddTo(Command command)
    {
        command.Add(Archive);
        command.Add(Database);
        command.Add(Verbose);
    }

    public SearchSettings Resolve(ParseResult parseResult) => new(
        parseResult.GetValue(Archive) ?? SearchPaths.DefaultArchive(),
        parseResult.GetValue(Database) ?? SearchPaths.DefaultDatabase(),
        parseResult.GetValue(Verbose));
}

public sealed class SearchContext : IAsyncDisposable
{
    private readonly ILoggerFactory _loggers;

    private SearchContext(ILoggerFactory loggers, SearchDatabase database)
    {
        _loggers = loggers;
        Database = database;
        Engine = new SearchEngine(database, loggers.CreateLogger<SearchEngine>());
        Indexer = new IndexManager(
            database,
            new EmailParser(loggers.CreateLogger<EmailParser>(), TimeProvider.System),
            loggers.CreateLogger<IndexManager>(),
            TimeProvider.System);
    }

    public SearchDatabase Database { get; }

    public SearchEngine Engine { get; }

    public IndexManager Indexer { get; }

    public static async Task<SearchContext> OpenAsync(SearchSettings settings, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var loggers = LoggerFactory.Create(logging =>
        {
            logging.AddConsole(console => console.LogToStandardErrorThreshold = LogLevel.Trace);
            logging.SetMinimumLevel(settings.Verbose ? LogLevel.Debug : LogLevel.Information);
        });

        try
        {
            return new SearchContext(loggers, await SearchDatabase.OpenAsync(settings.DatabasePath, ct));
        }
        catch
        {
            loggers.Dispose();
            throw;
        }
    }

    public async ValueTask DisposeAsync()
    {
        await Database.DisposeAsync();
        _loggers.Dispose();
    }
}

using System.CommandLine;
using System.Globalization;

using Microsoft.Data.Sqlite;

using MyEmailSearch.Data;

namespace MyEmailSearch.Commands;

public static class StatusCommand
{
    private static readonly string[] Units = ["B", "KB", "MB", "GB", "TB"];

    public static Command Create(GlobalOptions global)
    {
        var command = new Command("status", "Show index status and statistics");

        command.SetAction(async (parseResult, ct) =>
        {
            var settings = global.Resolve(parseResult);
            var output = parseResult.InvocationConfiguration.Output;

            output.WriteLine("MyEmailSearch - Index Status");
            output.WriteLine(new string('=', 40));
            output.WriteLine();
            output.WriteLine($"Archive path:  {settings.ArchivePath}");
            output.WriteLine($"Database path: {settings.DatabasePath}");
            output.WriteLine();

            if (!File.Exists(settings.DatabasePath))
            {
                output.WriteLine("Status: No index exists yet");
                output.WriteLine("Run 'myemailsearch index' to create the index");
                return;
            }

            try
            {
                await using var context = await SearchContext.OpenAsync(settings, ct);
                var database = context.Database;
                var lastIndexed = await database.GetMetadataAsync(SearchDatabase.LastIndexedKey, ct);

                output.WriteLine($"Total emails indexed: {await database.GetEmailCountAsync(ct):N0}");
                output.WriteLine($"Index size:           {FormatBytes(database.SizeBytes)}");
                output.WriteLine($"Last indexed:         {FormatTimestamp(lastIndexed)}");
                output.WriteLine($"Database health:      {(await database.IsHealthyAsync(ct) ? "OK" : "ERROR")}");
            }
            catch (SqliteException exception)
            {
                output.WriteLine($"Error reading database: {exception.Message}");
            }
        });

        return command;
    }

    public static string FormatBytes(long bytes)
    {
        var size = (double)bytes;
        var unit = 0;
        while (size >= 1024 && unit < Units.Length - 1)
        {
            size /= 1024;
            unit++;
        }

        return $"{size:F2} {Units[unit]}";
    }

    private static string FormatTimestamp(string? unixSeconds) =>
        long.TryParse(unixSeconds, NumberStyles.Integer, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var seconds)
            ? DateTimeOffset.FromUnixTimeSeconds(seconds).ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss")
            : "Never";
}

using MyImapDownloader.Core.Paths;

namespace MyEmailSearch.Configuration;

public static class SearchPaths
{
    public const string ArchiveVariable = "MYIMAPDOWNLOADER_ARCHIVE";

    private const string DownloaderDirectory = "myimapdownloader";
    private const string SearchDirectory = "myemailsearch";

    public static string DefaultArchive() => DefaultArchive(
        XdgDirectories.Current,
        Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.MyDocuments),
        Directory.Exists);

    public static string DefaultArchive(XdgDirectories xdg, string documents, Func<string, bool> exists)
    {
        IEnumerable<string?> candidates =
        [
            xdg.Variable(ArchiveVariable),
            xdg.DataHomeOverride is { } dataHome ? Path.Combine(dataHome, DownloaderDirectory) : null,
            Path.Combine(xdg.Home, ".local", "share", DownloaderDirectory),
            Path.Combine(xdg.Home, "Documents", "mail"),
            Path.Combine(xdg.Home, "mail"),
            Path.Combine(documents, "mail")
        ];

        return candidates.OfType<string>().FirstOrDefault(exists)
            ?? Path.Combine(xdg.DataHome, DownloaderDirectory);
    }

    public static string DefaultDatabase() => DefaultDatabase(XdgDirectories.Current);

    public static string DefaultDatabase(XdgDirectories xdg) =>
        Path.Combine(xdg.DataHome, SearchDirectory, "search.db");
}

using System.Text.Json;

namespace MyEmailSearch.Data;

public sealed class EmailDocument
{
    public long Id { get; set; }
    public required string MessageId { get; init; }
    public required string FilePath { get; init; }
    public string? FromAddress { get; init; }
    public string? FromName { get; init; }
    public string? ToAddressesJson { get; init; }
    public string? CcAddressesJson { get; init; }
    public string? BccAddressesJson { get; init; }
    public string? Subject { get; init; }
    public long? DateSentUnix { get; init; }
    public long? DateReceivedUnix { get; init; }
    public string? Folder { get; init; }
    public string? Account { get; init; }
    public bool HasAttachments { get; init; }
    public string? AttachmentNamesJson { get; init; }
    public string? BodyPreview { get; init; }
    public string? BodyText { get; init; }
    public long IndexedAtUnix { get; init; }
    public long LastModifiedTicks { get; init; }

    public DateTimeOffset? DateSent => DateSentUnix.HasValue
        ? DateTimeOffset.FromUnixTimeSeconds(DateSentUnix.Value)
        : null;

    public DateTimeOffset? DateReceived => DateReceivedUnix.HasValue
        ? DateTimeOffset.FromUnixTimeSeconds(DateReceivedUnix.Value)
        : null;

    public IReadOnlyList<string> ToAddresses => ParseJsonArray(ToAddressesJson);
    public IReadOnlyList<string> CcAddresses => ParseJsonArray(CcAddressesJson);
    public IReadOnlyList<string> BccAddresses => ParseJsonArray(BccAddressesJson);
    public IReadOnlyList<string> AttachmentNames => ParseJsonArray(AttachmentNamesJson);

    private static IReadOnlyList<string> ParseJsonArray(string? json)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(json)) return [];
        try
        {
            return JsonSerializer.Deserialize(json, EmailDocumentJsonContext.Default.ListString) ?? [];
        }
        catch
        {
            return [];
        }
    }

    public static string ToJsonArray(IEnumerable<string?> items)
    {
        var list = items.OfType<string>().ToList();
        return list.Count > 0 ? JsonSerializer.Serialize(list, EmailDocumentJsonContext.Default.ListString) : "";
    }
}

using Microsoft.Data.Sqlite;

using MyImapDownloader.Core.Storage;

namespace MyEmailSearch.Data;

public sealed class SearchDatabase : IAsyncDisposable
{
    public const string LastIndexedKey = "last_indexed_time";

    private const string Schema = """
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS emails (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            message_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            file_path TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
            from_address TEXT,
            from_name TEXT,
            to_addresses TEXT,
            cc_addresses TEXT,
            bcc_addresses TEXT,
            subject TEXT,
            date_sent_unix INTEGER,
            date_received_unix INTEGER,
            folder TEXT,
            account TEXT,
            has_attachments INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
            attachment_names TEXT,
            body_preview TEXT,
            body_text TEXT,
            indexed_at_unix INTEGER NOT NULL,
            last_modified_ticks INTEGER DEFAULT 0
        );

        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_emails_from ON emails(from_address);
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_emails_from_nocase ON emails(from_address COLLATE NOCASE);
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_emails_date ON emails(date_sent_unix);
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_emails_folder ON emails(folder);
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_emails_account ON emails(account);
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_emails_message_id ON emails(message_id);

        CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS emails_fts USING fts5(
            subject,
            body_text,
            from_address,
            to_addresses,
            content='emails',
            content_rowid='id',
            tokenize='porter unicode61'
        );

        CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS emails_ai AFTER INSERT ON emails BEGIN
            INSERT INTO emails_fts(rowid, subject, body_text, from_address, to_addresses)
            VALUES (new.id, new.subject, new.body_text, new.from_address, new.to_addresses);
        END;

        CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS emails_ad AFTER DELETE ON emails BEGIN
            INSERT INTO emails_fts(emails_fts, rowid, subject, body_text, from_address, to_addresses)
            VALUES ('delete', old.id, old.subject, old.body_text, old.from_address, old.to_addresses);
        END;

        CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS emails_au AFTER UPDATE ON emails BEGIN
            INSERT INTO emails_fts(emails_fts, rowid, subject, body_text, from_address, to_addresses)
            VALUES ('delete', old.id, old.subject, old.body_text, old.from_address, old.to_addresses);
            INSERT INTO emails_fts(rowid, subject, body_text, from_address, to_addresses)
            VALUES (new.id, new.subject, new.body_text, new.from_address, new.to_addresses);
        END;

        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS index_metadata (
            key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            value TEXT NOT NULL
        );
        """;

    private const string Upsert = """
        INSERT INTO emails (
            message_id, file_path, from_address, from_name, to_addresses, cc_addresses, bcc_addresses,
            subject, date_sent_unix, date_received_unix, folder, account, has_attachments,
            attachment_names, body_preview, body_text, indexed_at_unix, last_modified_ticks
        ) VALUES (
            @messageId, @filePath, @fromAddress, @fromName, @toAddresses, @ccAddresses, @bccAddresses,
            @subject, @dateSentUnix, @dateReceivedUnix, @folder, @account, @hasAttachments,
            @attachmentNames, @bodyPreview, @bodyText, @indexedAtUnix, @lastModifiedTicks
        )
        ON CONFLICT(file_path) DO UPDATE SET
            message_id = excluded.message_id,
            from_address = excluded.from_address,
            from_name = excluded.from_name,
            to_addresses = excluded.to_addresses,
            cc_addresses = excluded.cc_addresses,
            bcc_addresses = excluded.bcc_addresses,
            subject = excluded.subject,
            date_sent_unix = excluded.date_sent_unix,
            date_received_unix = excluded.date_received_unix,
            folder = excluded.folder,
            account = excluded.account,
            has_attachments = excluded.has_attachments,
            attachment_names = excluded.attachment_names,
            body_preview = excluded.body_preview,
            body_text = excluded.body_text,
            indexed_at_unix = excluded.indexed_at_unix,
            last_modified_ticks = excluded.last_modified_ticks;
        """;

    private readonly SqliteConnection _connection;
    private readonly string _path;

    private SearchDatabase(SqliteConnection connection, string path)
    {
        _connection = connection;
        _path = path;
    }

    public static async Task<SearchDatabase> OpenAsync(string path, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        if (Path.GetDirectoryName(path) is { Length: > 0 } directory)
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(directory);
        }

        var connection = await SqliteDatabase.OpenAsync(path, ct);
        try
        {
            await connection.ExecuteAsync(Schema, ct);
            return new SearchDatabase(connection, path);
        }
        catch
        {
            await connection.DisposeAsync();
            throw;
        }
    }

    public long SizeBytes => new FileInfo(_path) is { Exists: true } file ? file.Length : 0;

    public async Task<List<EmailDocument>> QueryAsync(SearchQuery query, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var statement = SearchSql.Select(query);
        await using var command = _connection.Prepare(statement.Text, statement.Parameters);
        await using var reader = await command.ExecuteReaderAsync(ct);

        List<EmailDocument> results = [];
        while (await reader.ReadAsync(ct))
        {
            results.Add(Map(reader));
        }

        return results;
    }

    public async Task<int> CountAsync(SearchQuery query, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var statement = SearchSql.Count(query);
        return Convert.ToInt32(await _connection.ScalarAsync(statement.Text, ct, statement.Parameters));
    }

    public async Task<long> GetEmailCountAsync(CancellationToken ct = default) =>
        Convert.ToInt64(await _connection.ScalarAsync("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM emails;", ct));

    public async Task<bool> IsHealthyAsync(CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        try
        {
            var tables = await _connection.ScalarAsync(
                "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE name IN ('emails', 'emails_fts', 'index_metadata');", ct);
            return Convert.ToInt32(tables) == 3;
        }
        catch (SqliteException)
        {
            return false;
        }
    }

    public async Task<string?> GetMetadataAsync(string key, CancellationToken ct = default) =>
        await _connection.ScalarAsync("SELECT value FROM index_metadata WHERE key = @key;", ct, [("@key", key)])
            as string;

    public Task SetMetadataAsync(string key, string value, CancellationToken ct = default) =>
        _connection.ExecuteAsync(
            """
            INSERT INTO index_metadata (key, value) VALUES (@key, @value)
            ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value = excluded.value;
            """,
            ct,
            [("@key", key), ("@value", value)]);

    public async Task UpsertAsync(IReadOnlyCollection<EmailDocument> emails, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        if (emails.Count == 0)
        {
            return;
        }

        await using var transaction = await _connection.BeginTransactionAsync(ct);
        foreach (var email in emails)
        {
            await _connection.ExecuteAsync(Upsert, ct, Bind(email));
        }

        await transaction.CommitAsync(ct);
    }

    public async Task<Dictionary<string, long>> GetKnownFilesAsync(CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        await using var command = _connection.Prepare("SELECT file_path, last_modified_ticks FROM emails;");
        await using var reader = await command.ExecuteReaderAsync(ct);

        Dictionary<string, long> known = new(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        while (await reader.ReadAsync(ct))
        {
            known[reader.GetString(0)] = reader.IsDBNull(1) ? 0 : reader.GetInt64(1);
        }

        return known;
    }

    public async Task ResetAsync(CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        await _connection.ExecuteAsync(
            """
            DROP TABLE IF EXISTS emails_fts;
            DROP TABLE IF EXISTS emails;
            DROP TABLE IF EXISTS index_metadata;
            """,
            ct);
        await _connection.ExecuteAsync("VACUUM;", ct);
        await _connection.ExecuteAsync(Schema, ct);
    }

    public ValueTask DisposeAsync() => _connection.DisposeAsync();

    private static (string Name, object? Value)[] Bind(EmailDocument email) =>
    [
        ("@messageId", email.MessageId),
        ("@filePath", email.FilePath),
        ("@fromAddress", email.FromAddress),
        ("@fromName", email.FromName),
        ("@toAddresses", email.ToAddressesJson),
        ("@ccAddresses", email.CcAddressesJson),
        ("@bccAddresses", email.BccAddressesJson),
        ("@subject", email.Subject),
        ("@dateSentUnix", email.DateSentUnix),
        ("@dateReceivedUnix", email.DateReceivedUnix),
        ("@folder", email.Folder),
        ("@account", email.Account),
        ("@hasAttachments", email.HasAttachments ? 1 : 0),
        ("@attachmentNames", email.AttachmentNamesJson),
        ("@bodyPreview", email.BodyPreview),
        ("@bodyText", email.BodyText),
        ("@indexedAtUnix", email.IndexedAtUnix),
        ("@lastModifiedTicks", email.LastModifiedTicks)
    ];

    private static EmailDocument Map(SqliteDataReader reader) => new()
    {
        Id = reader.GetInt64(0),
        MessageId = reader.GetString(1),
        FilePath = reader.GetString(2),
        FromAddress = Text(reader, 3),
        FromName = Text(reader, 4),
        ToAddressesJson = Text(reader, 5),
        CcAddressesJson = Text(reader, 6),
        BccAddressesJson = Text(reader, 7),
        Subject = Text(reader, 8),
        DateSentUnix = Integer(reader, 9),
        DateReceivedUnix = Integer(reader, 10),
        Folder = Text(reader, 11),
        Account = Text(reader, 12),
        HasAttachments = Integer(reader, 13) == 1,
        AttachmentNamesJson = Text(reader, 14),
        BodyPreview = Text(reader, 15),
        BodyText = Text(reader, 16),
        IndexedAtUnix = reader.GetInt64(17),
        LastModifiedTicks = Integer(reader, 18) ?? 0
    };

    private static string? Text(SqliteDataReader reader, int ordinal) =>
        reader.IsDBNull(ordinal) ? null : reader.GetString(ordinal);

    private static long? Integer(SqliteDataReader reader, int ordinal) =>
        reader.IsDBNull(ordinal) ? null : reader.GetInt64(ordinal);
}

namespace MyEmailSearch.Data;

/// <summary>
/// Represents a single search result with optional snippet.
/// </summary>
public sealed record SearchResult
{
    public required EmailDocument Email { get; init; }
    public string? Snippet { get; init; }
    public IReadOnlyList<string> MatchedTerms { get; init; } = [];
    public double? Score { get; init; }
}

/// <summary>
/// Represents a set of search results with pagination info.
/// </summary>
public sealed record SearchResultSet
{
    public IReadOnlyList<SearchResult> Results { get; init; } = [];
    public int TotalCount { get; init; }
    public int Skip { get; init; }
    public int Take { get; init; }
    public TimeSpan QueryTime { get; init; }

    public bool HasMore => Skip + Results.Count < TotalCount;
}

namespace MyEmailSearch.Data;

public sealed record SqlStatement(string Text, IReadOnlyList<(string Name, object? Value)> Parameters);

public static class SearchSql
{
    public static readonly string[] Columns =
    [
        "id", "message_id", "file_path", "from_address", "from_name", "to_addresses", "cc_addresses",
        "bcc_addresses", "subject", "date_sent_unix", "date_received_unix", "folder", "account",
        "has_attachments", "attachment_names", "body_preview", "body_text", "indexed_at_unix",
        "last_modified_ticks"
    ];

    private static readonly string SelectList = string.Join(", ", Columns.Select(column => $"emails.{column}"));

    public static SqlStatement Select(SearchQuery query)
    {
        var (source, parameters, ranked) = Filter(query);
        parameters.Add(("@limit", query.Take));
        parameters.Add(("@offset", query.Skip));

        var order = ranked ? "bm25(emails_fts)" : "emails.date_sent_unix DESC";
        return new SqlStatement(
            $"SELECT {SelectList} {source} ORDER BY {order} LIMIT @limit OFFSET @offset;", parameters);
    }

    public static SqlStatement Count(SearchQuery query)
    {
        var (source, parameters, _) = Filter(query);
        return new SqlStatement($"SELECT COUNT(*) {source};", parameters);
    }

    public static string? FtsMatch(string? terms)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(terms))
        {
            return null;
        }

        var phrase = terms.Trim();
        var isPrefix = phrase.EndsWith('*');
        if (isPrefix)
        {
            phrase = phrase[..^1].TrimEnd();
        }

        if (phrase.Length == 0)
        {
            return null;
        }

        var quoted = $"\"{phrase.Replace("\"", "\"\"")}\"";
        return isPrefix ? quoted + "*" : quoted;
    }

    private static (string Source, List<(string Name, object? Value)> Parameters, bool Ranked) Filter(SearchQuery query)
    {
        List<string> conditions = [];
        List<(string Name, object? Value)> parameters = [];
        var source = "FROM emails";

        var match = FtsMatch(query.ContentTerms);
        if (match is not null)
        {
            source = "FROM emails INNER JOIN emails_fts ON emails.id = emails_fts.rowid";
            conditions.Add("emails_fts MATCH @ftsQuery");
            parameters.Add(("@ftsQuery", match));
        }

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(query.FromAddress))
        {
            if (query.FromAddress.Contains('*'))
            {
                conditions.Add("emails.from_address LIKE @fromAddress");
                parameters.Add(("@fromAddress", query.FromAddress.Replace('*', '%')));
            }
            else
            {
                conditions.Add("emails.from_address = @fromAddress COLLATE NOCASE");
                parameters.Add(("@fromAddress", query.FromAddress));
            }
        }

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(query.ToAddress))
        {
            conditions.Add("emails.to_addresses LIKE @toAddress");
            parameters.Add(("@toAddress", $"%{query.ToAddress}%"));
        }

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(query.Subject))
        {
            conditions.Add("emails.subject LIKE @subject");
            parameters.Add(("@subject", $"%{query.Subject}%"));
        }

        if (query.DateFrom is { } dateFrom)
        {
            conditions.Add("emails.date_sent_unix >= @dateFrom");
            parameters.Add(("@dateFrom", dateFrom.ToUnixTimeSeconds()));
        }

        if (query.DateTo is { } dateTo)
        {
            conditions.Add("emails.date_sent_unix <= @dateTo");
            parameters.Add(("@dateTo", dateTo.ToUnixTimeSeconds()));
        }

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(query.Account))
        {
            conditions.Add("emails.account = @account");
            parameters.Add(("@account", query.Account));
        }

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(query.Folder))
        {
            conditions.Add("emails.folder = @folder");
            parameters.Add(("@folder", query.Folder));
        }

        if (conditions.Count > 0)
        {
            source += " WHERE " + string.Join(" AND ", conditions);
        }

        return (source, parameters, match is not null);
    }
}

namespace MyEmailSearch.Indexing;

public static class ArchiveScanner
{
    private static readonly EnumerationOptions Options = new()
    {
        RecurseSubdirectories = true,
        IgnoreInaccessible = true,
        MatchCasing = MatchCasing.CaseInsensitive
    };

    public static IEnumerable<string> FindEmails(string archivePath) =>
        Directory.Exists(archivePath) ? Directory.EnumerateFiles(archivePath, "*.eml", Options) : [];

    public static string? AccountOf(string filePath, string archivePath) =>
        Segments(filePath, archivePath) is { Length: >= 2 } parts ? parts[0] : null;

    public static string? FolderOf(string filePath, string archivePath) =>
        Segments(filePath, archivePath) is { Length: >= 3 } parts ? parts[1] : null;

    private static string[] Segments(string filePath, string archivePath) =>
        Path.GetRelativePath(archivePath, filePath).Split(Path.DirectorySeparatorChar);
}

using System.Net;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;

using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

using MimeKit;

using MyEmailSearch.Data;

namespace MyEmailSearch.Indexing;

public sealed partial class EmailParser(ILogger<EmailParser> logger, TimeProvider time)
{
    private const int BodyPreviewLength = 500;
    private const int MaxHeaderLength = 1024 * 1024;

    private static readonly ParserOptions Options = new() { MaxHeaderLength = MaxHeaderLength };

    public async Task<EmailDocument?> ParseAsync(
        string filePath,
        string archivePath,
        bool includeFullBody,
        CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        try
        {
            using var message = await MimeMessage.LoadAsync(Options, filePath, ct);

            var sender = message.From.Mailboxes.FirstOrDefault();
            var body = BodyText(message);
            var attachments = message.Attachments
                .OfType<MimePart>()
                .Select(part => part.FileName)
                .OfType<string>()
                .ToList();

            return new EmailDocument
            {
                MessageId = message.MessageId ?? Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(filePath),
                FilePath = filePath,
                FromAddress = sender?.Address,
                FromName = sender?.Name,
                ToAddressesJson = EmailDocument.ToJsonArray(message.To.Mailboxes.Select(m => m.Address)),
                CcAddressesJson = EmailDocument.ToJsonArray(message.Cc.Mailboxes.Select(m => m.Address)),
                BccAddressesJson = EmailDocument.ToJsonArray(message.Bcc.Mailboxes.Select(m => m.Address)),
                Subject = message.Subject,
                DateSentUnix = message.Date != DateTimeOffset.MinValue ? message.Date.ToUnixTimeSeconds() : null,
                Folder = ArchiveScanner.FolderOf(filePath, archivePath),
                Account = ArchiveScanner.AccountOf(filePath, archivePath),
                HasAttachments = attachments.Count > 0,
                AttachmentNamesJson = attachments.Count > 0 ? EmailDocument.ToJsonArray(attachments) : null,
                BodyPreview = body is null ? null : Truncate(body, BodyPreviewLength),
                BodyText = includeFullBody ? body : null,
                IndexedAtUnix = time.GetUtcNow().ToUnixTimeSeconds(),
                LastModifiedTicks = File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc(filePath).Ticks
            };
        }
        catch (Exception exception) when (exception is not OperationCanceledException)
        {
            logger.LogWarning(exception, "Failed to parse email: {Path}", filePath);
            return null;
        }
    }

    public static string HtmlToText(string html) =>
        WebUtility.HtmlDecode(Tags().Replace(InvisibleElements().Replace(html, " "), " "));

    private static string? BodyText(MimeMessage message)
    {
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(message.TextBody))
        {
            return CollapseWhitespace(message.TextBody);
        }

        return string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(message.HtmlBody) ? null : CollapseWhitespace(HtmlToText(message.HtmlBody));
    }

    private static string CollapseWhitespace(string text) => Whitespace().Replace(text, " ").Trim();

    private static string Truncate(string text, int maxLength) =>
        text.Length <= maxLength ? text : text[..maxLength] + "...";

    [GeneratedRegex(@"<(script|style)\b[^>]*>.*?</\1\s*>", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Singleline)]
    private static partial Regex InvisibleElements();

    [GeneratedRegex("<[^>]+>")]
    private static partial Regex Tags();

    [GeneratedRegex(@"\s+")]
    private static partial Regex Whitespace();
}

using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Globalization;

using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

using MyEmailSearch.Data;

namespace MyEmailSearch.Indexing;

public sealed record IndexingResult(int Indexed, int Skipped, int Errors, TimeSpan Duration);

public sealed record IndexingProgress(int Processed, int Total, string? CurrentFile = null)
{
    public double Percentage => Total > 0 ? (double)Processed / Total * 100 : 0;
}

public sealed class IndexManager(
    SearchDatabase database,
    EmailParser parser,
    ILogger<IndexManager> logger,
    TimeProvider time)
{
    private const int BatchSize = 100;

    public async Task<IndexingResult> IndexAsync(
        string archivePath,
        bool includeContent,
        IProgress<IndexingProgress>? progress = null,
        CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var started = Stopwatch.GetTimestamp();
        logger.LogInformation("Starting incremental index of {Path}", archivePath);

        if (!Directory.Exists(archivePath))
        {
            logger.LogWarning("Archive path does not exist: {Path}", archivePath);
        }

        var known = await database.GetKnownFilesAsync(ct);
        var files = ArchiveScanner.FindEmails(archivePath).ToList();
        logger.LogInformation("Found {Files} emails; {Known} already indexed", files.Count, known.Count);

        List<EmailDocument> batch = [with(capacity: BatchSize)];
        var (indexed, skipped, errors, processed) = (0, 0, 0, 0);

        foreach (var file in files)
        {
            ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();

            if (IsUnchanged(file, known))
            {
                skipped++;
            }
            else if (await parser.ParseAsync(file, archivePath, includeContent, ct) is { } document)
            {
                batch.Add(document);
                indexed++;
            }
            else
            {
                errors++;
            }

            if (batch.Count >= BatchSize)
            {
                await database.UpsertAsync(batch, ct);
                batch.Clear();
            }

            progress?.Report(new IndexingProgress(++processed, files.Count, file));
        }

        await database.UpsertAsync(batch, ct);
        await database.SetMetadataAsync(
            SearchDatabase.LastIndexedKey,
            time.GetUtcNow().ToUnixTimeSeconds().ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
            ct);

        var result = new IndexingResult(indexed, skipped, errors, Stopwatch.GetElapsedTime(started));
        logger.LogInformation(
            "Indexing complete: {Indexed} indexed, {Skipped} skipped, {Errors} errors in {Duration}",
            result.Indexed, result.Skipped, result.Errors, result.Duration);
        return result;
    }

    public async Task<IndexingResult> RebuildAsync(
        string archivePath,
        bool includeContent,
        IProgress<IndexingProgress>? progress = null,
        CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        logger.LogWarning("Starting full index rebuild; all indexed data is discarded first");
        await database.ResetAsync(ct);
        return await IndexAsync(archivePath, includeContent, progress, ct);
    }

    private static bool IsUnchanged(string file, Dictionary<string, long> known) =>
        known.TryGetValue(file, out var ticks) && ticks == File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc(file).Ticks;
}

using System.Globalization;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;

using MyEmailSearch.Data;

namespace MyEmailSearch.Search;

public static partial class QueryParser
{
    public static SearchQuery Parse(string? input)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(input))
        {
            return new SearchQuery();
        }

        var query = new SearchQuery();
        HashSet<string> seen = [];

        var remaining = Term().Replace(input, match =>
        {
            var key = match.Groups["key"].Value.ToLowerInvariant();
            if (seen.Contains(key) || Apply(query, key, Unquote(match.Groups["value"].Value)) is not { } updated)
            {
                return match.Value;
            }

            seen.Add(key);
            query = updated;
            return "";
        });

        var terms = remaining.Trim();
        return query with { ContentTerms = terms.Length == 0 ? null : terms };
    }

    private static SearchQuery? Apply(SearchQuery query, string key, string value) => key switch
    {
        "from" => query with { FromAddress = value },
        "to" => query with { ToAddress = value },
        "subject" => query with { Subject = value },
        "account" => query with { Account = value },
        "folder" => query with { Folder = value },
        "after" when ParseDay(value) is { } day => query with { DateFrom = day },
        "before" when ParseDay(value) is { } day => query with { DateTo = EndOfDay(day) },
        "date" when ParseRange(value) is { } range => query with { DateFrom = range.From, DateTo = range.To ?? query.DateTo },
        _ => null
    };

    private static (DateTimeOffset From, DateTimeOffset? To)? ParseRange(string value)
    {
        var parts = value.Split("..");
        if (parts.Length > 2 || ParseDay(parts[0]) is not { } start)
        {
            return null;
        }

        if (parts.Length == 1)
        {
            return (start, null);
        }

        return ParseDay(parts[1]) is { } end ? (start, EndOfDay(end)) : null;
    }

    private static DateTimeOffset? ParseDay(string value) =>
        DateOnly.TryParseExact(value, "yyyy-MM-dd", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, DateTimeStyles.None, out var day)
            ? new DateTimeOffset(day.ToDateTime(TimeOnly.MinValue, DateTimeKind.Local))
            : null;

    private static DateTimeOffset EndOfDay(DateTimeOffset day) => day.AddDays(1).AddTicks(-1);

    private static string Unquote(string value) =>
        value.Length > 2 && value[0] == '"' && value[^1] == '"' ? value[1..^1] : value;

    [GeneratedRegex("""(?<!\S)(?<key>from|to|subject|account|folder|after|before|date):(?<value>"[^"]+"|\S+)""", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase)]
    private static partial Regex Term();
}

using System.Diagnostics;

using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

using MyEmailSearch.Data;

namespace MyEmailSearch.Search;

public sealed class SearchEngine(SearchDatabase database, ILogger<SearchEngine> logger)
{
    public async Task<SearchResultSet> SearchAsync(
        string queryText,
        int limit = 100,
        int offset = 0,
        CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(queryText))
        {
            return new SearchResultSet { Skip = offset, Take = limit };
        }

        var started = Stopwatch.GetTimestamp();
        var query = QueryParser.Parse(queryText) with { Take = limit, Skip = offset };
        logger.LogDebug("Executing search: {Query}", query);

        var emails = await database.QueryAsync(query, ct);
        var totalCount = await database.CountAsync(query, ct);

        IReadOnlyList<string> terms = query.ContentTerms?.Split(' ', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries) ?? [];
        var results = emails
            .Select(email => new SearchResult
            {
                Email = email,
                Snippet = terms.Count > 0
                    ? SnippetGenerator.Generate(email.BodyText ?? email.BodyPreview, query.ContentTerms)
                    : email.BodyPreview,
                MatchedTerms = terms
            })
            .ToList();

        var elapsed = Stopwatch.GetElapsedTime(started);
        logger.LogDebug(
            "Search completed: {ResultCount} results returned, {TotalCount} total matches in {ElapsedMs}ms",
            results.Count, totalCount, (long)elapsed.TotalMilliseconds);

        return new SearchResultSet
        {
            Results = results,
            TotalCount = totalCount,
            Skip = query.Skip,
            Take = query.Take,
            QueryTime = elapsed
        };
    }
}

namespace MyEmailSearch.Search;

public static class SnippetGenerator
{
    private const int SnippetLength = 200;
    private const int ContextPadding = 50;
    private const string Ellipsis = "...";

    public static string? Generate(string? bodyText, string? searchTerms)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(bodyText))
        {
            return null;
        }

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(searchTerms))
        {
            return Truncate(bodyText);
        }

        var firstMatch = searchTerms
            .Split(' ', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries)
            .Select(term => bodyText.IndexOf(term, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            .Where(index => index >= 0)
            .DefaultIfEmpty(-1)
            .Min();

        if (firstMatch < 0)
        {
            return Truncate(bodyText);
        }

        var start = Math.Max(0, firstMatch - ContextPadding);
        var end = Math.Min(bodyText.Length, start + SnippetLength);

        if (start > 0 && bodyText.LastIndexOf(' ', start) is > 0 and var wordStart)
        {
            start = wordStart + 1;
        }

        if (end < bodyText.Length && bodyText.IndexOf(' ', end) is > 0 and var wordEnd)
        {
            end = wordEnd;
        }

        return string.Concat(
            start > 0 ? Ellipsis : "",
            bodyText.AsSpan(start, end - start),
            end < bodyText.Length ? Ellipsis : "");
    }

    private static string Truncate(string text)
    {
        if (text.Length <= SnippetLength)
        {
            return text;
        }

        var truncated = text[..SnippetLength];
        var lastSpace = truncated.LastIndexOf(' ');
        return (lastSpace > SnippetLength / 2 ? truncated[..lastSpace] : truncated) + Ellipsis;
    }
}

using System.CommandLine;

using MyEmailSearch.Commands;

namespace MyEmailSearch;

public static class SearchCli
{
    public static RootCommand Create(TextReader? input = null, Action<string>? open = null)
    {
        input ??= Console.In;
        open ??= SearchCommand.OpenWithDefaultApplication;

        var global = new GlobalOptions();
        var root = new RootCommand("MyEmailSearch - Search your email archive")
        {
            SearchCommand.Create(global, input, open),
            IndexCommand.Create(global),
            StatusCommand.Create(global),
            RebuildCommand.Create(global, input)
        };
        global.AddTo(root);
        return root;
    }
}

using System.Diagnostics;

using MyImapDownloader.Core.Telemetry;

namespace MyImapDownloader.Core.Tests;

public class ActivityExtensionsTests
{
    [Test]
    public async Task RecordError_SetsErrorStatusAndExceptionEvent()
    {
        using var activity = new Activity("test").Start();

        activity.RecordError(new InvalidOperationException("boom"));

        var recorded = activity.Events.Single();
        await Assert.That(activity.Status).IsEqualTo(ActivityStatusCode.Error);
        await Assert.That(activity.StatusDescription).IsEqualTo("boom");
        await Assert.That(recorded.Name).IsEqualTo("exception");
        await Assert.That(recorded.Tags.Any(tag => tag.Key == "exception.message" && (string?)tag.Value == "boom")).IsTrue();
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task RecordError_IgnoresMissingActivity()
    {
        Activity? activity = null;

        activity.RecordError(new InvalidOperationException("boom"));

        await Assert.That(activity).IsNull();
    }
}

using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Diagnostics.Metrics;

using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

using MyImapDownloader.Core.Telemetry;

namespace MyImapDownloader.Core.Tests;

public class JsonFileTelemetryTests : IDisposable
{
    private readonly TempDirectory _temp = new();
    private readonly string _sourceName = $"telemetry.test.{Guid.NewGuid():N}";

    public void Dispose() => _temp.Dispose();

    private string ReadAll(string kind)
    {
        var directory = Path.Combine(_temp.Path, kind);
        return Directory.Exists(directory)
            ? string.Concat(Directory.GetFiles(directory, "*.jsonl").Select(File.ReadAllText))
            : "";
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task Start_WithoutDirectoryDisablesEverything()
    {
        using var telemetry = JsonFileTelemetry.Start(new TelemetryOptions(), _sourceName, directory: null);
        using var loggers = LoggerFactory.Create(telemetry.ConfigureLogging);

        loggers.CreateLogger("test").LogInformation("ignored");

        await Assert.That(telemetry.OutputDirectory).IsNull();
        await Assert.That(Directory.GetFileSystemEntries(_temp.Path).Length).IsEqualTo(0);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task Dispose_FlushesSpansMetricsAndLogsToJsonLines()
    {
        using var source = new ActivitySource(_sourceName);
        using var meter = new Meter(_sourceName);
        var counter = meter.CreateCounter<long>("test.events");

        using (var telemetry = JsonFileTelemetry.Start(new TelemetryOptions(), _sourceName, _temp.Path))
        {
            using (var loggers = LoggerFactory.Create(telemetry.ConfigureLogging))
            {
                using (var activity = source.StartActivity("FlushTest"))
                {
                    counter.Add(7);
                    loggers.CreateLogger("test.category").LogInformation("hello {Name}", "telemetry");
                }
            }
        }

        await Assert.That(ReadAll("traces")).Contains("\"OperationName\":\"FlushTest\"");
        await Assert.That(ReadAll("metrics")).Contains("\"MetricName\":\"test.events\"");
        await Assert.That(ReadAll("logs")).Contains("\"FormattedMessage\":\"hello telemetry\"");
        await Assert.That(ReadAll("logs")).Contains("\"CategoryName\":\"test.category\"");
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task Start_HonoursDisabledSignals()
    {
        var options = new TelemetryOptions { EnableTracing = false, EnableMetrics = false, EnableLogging = false };
        using var source = new ActivitySource(_sourceName);

        using (var telemetry = JsonFileTelemetry.Start(options, _sourceName, _temp.Path))
        {
            using var loggers = LoggerFactory.Create(telemetry.ConfigureLogging);
            using var activity = source.StartActivity("Ignored");
            loggers.CreateLogger("test").LogInformation("ignored");
        }

        await Assert.That(ReadAll("traces")).IsEqualTo("");
        await Assert.That(ReadAll("metrics")).IsEqualTo("");
        await Assert.That(ReadAll("logs")).IsEqualTo("");
    }
}

using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Diagnostics.Metrics;

using MyImapDownloader.Core.Telemetry;

using OpenTelemetry;
using OpenTelemetry.Metrics;

namespace MyImapDownloader.Core.Tests;

public class JsonLinesExporterTests : IDisposable
{
    private readonly TempDirectory _temp = new();

    public void Dispose() => _temp.Dispose();

    private JsonLinesFileWriter CreateWriter(string kind) =>
        new(Path.Combine(_temp.Path, kind), kind, 1024 * 1024, TimeProvider.System);

    private async Task<string> ReadAllAsync(string kind)
    {
        var parts = new List<string>();
        foreach (var file in Directory.GetFiles(Path.Combine(_temp.Path, kind), "*.jsonl"))
        {
            parts.Add(await File.ReadAllTextAsync(file));
        }

        return string.Concat(parts);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task TraceExporter_EmptyBatchWritesNothing()
    {
        var exporter = new JsonLinesTraceExporter(CreateWriter("traces"));

        var result = exporter.Export(new Batch<Activity>([], 0));

        await Assert.That(result).IsEqualTo(ExportResult.Success);
        await Assert.That(await ReadAllAsync("traces")).IsEqualTo("");
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task TraceExporter_WritesOneJsonLinePerSpanWithStringTags()
    {
        var exporter = new JsonLinesTraceExporter(CreateWriter("traces"));
        var sourceName = $"trace.test.{Guid.NewGuid():N}";
        using var source = new ActivitySource(sourceName);
        using var listener = new ActivityListener
        {
            ShouldListenTo = candidate => candidate.Name == sourceName,
            Sample = (ref ActivityCreationOptions<ActivityContext> _) => ActivitySamplingResult.AllDataAndRecorded
        };
        ActivitySource.AddActivityListener(listener);

        var activity = source.StartActivity("ExportTest");
        await Assert.That(activity).IsNotNull();
        activity!.SetTag("text.key", "text.value");
        activity.SetTag("number.key", 42);
        activity.Stop();

        var result = exporter.Export(new Batch<Activity>([activity], 1));
        activity.Dispose();
        var content = await ReadAllAsync("traces");

        await Assert.That(result).IsEqualTo(ExportResult.Success);
        await Assert.That(content.EndsWith('\n')).IsTrue();
        await Assert.That(content.Split('\n', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries).Length).IsEqualTo(1);
        await Assert.That(content).Contains("\"Type\":\"trace\"");
        await Assert.That(content).Contains("\"OperationName\":\"ExportTest\"");
        await Assert.That(content).Contains("\"text.key\":\"text.value\"");
        await Assert.That(content).Contains("\"number.key\":\"42\"");
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task MetricExporter_WritesCountersAndHistograms()
    {
        var meterName = $"metrics.test.{Guid.NewGuid():N}";
        using var meter = new Meter(meterName);
        var histogram = meter.CreateHistogram<double>("test.latency");
        var counter = meter.CreateCounter<long>("test.count");

        using (var provider = Sdk.CreateMeterProviderBuilder()
            .AddMeter(meterName)
            .AddReader(new BaseExportingMetricReader(new JsonLinesMetricExporter(CreateWriter("metrics"))))
            .Build())
        {
            histogram.Record(5);
            histogram.Record(15);
            counter.Add(3);
            provider.ForceFlush();
        }

        var content = await ReadAllAsync("metrics");

        await Assert.That(content).Contains("\"Type\":\"metric\"");
        await Assert.That(content).Contains("\"MetricName\":\"test.latency\"");
        await Assert.That(content).Contains("\"Count\":2");
        await Assert.That(content).Contains("\"Min\":5");
        await Assert.That(content).Contains("\"Max\":15");
        await Assert.That(content).Contains("\"MetricName\":\"test.count\"");
        await Assert.That(content).Contains("\"Value\":3");
    }
}

using System.Text;

using MyImapDownloader.Core.Telemetry;

namespace MyImapDownloader.Core.Tests;

public class JsonLinesFileWriterTests : IDisposable
{
    private readonly TempDirectory _temp = new();
    private readonly ManualTimeProvider _time = new(new DateTimeOffset(2026, 1, 15, 12, 0, 0, TimeSpan.Zero));

    public void Dispose() => _temp.Dispose();

    private JsonLinesFileWriter CreateWriter(long maxBytes = 1024) => new(_temp.Path, "traces", maxBytes, _time);

    private string PathOf(string date, int sequence) => Path.Combine(_temp.Path, $"traces_{date}_{sequence:D4}.jsonl");

    private static byte[] Line(string text) => Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(text + "\n");

    [Test]
    public async Task Append_WritesToDatedFile()
    {
        var writer = CreateWriter();

        writer.Append(Line("{\"a\":1}"));
        writer.Append(Line("{\"a\":2}"));

        await Assert.That(await File.ReadAllTextAsync(PathOf("20260115", 0))).IsEqualTo("{\"a\":1}\n{\"a\":2}\n");
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task Append_EmptyPayloadCreatesNoFile()
    {
        var writer = CreateWriter();

        writer.Append([]);

        await Assert.That(Directory.GetFiles(_temp.Path).Length).IsEqualTo(0);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task Append_RotatesWhenSizeLimitWouldBeExceeded()
    {
        var writer = CreateWriter(maxBytes: 20);

        writer.Append(Line("0123456789"));
        writer.Append(Line("abcdefghij"));

        await Assert.That(await File.ReadAllTextAsync(PathOf("20260115", 0))).IsEqualTo("0123456789\n");
        await Assert.That(await File.ReadAllTextAsync(PathOf("20260115", 1))).IsEqualTo("abcdefghij\n");
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task Append_OversizedPayloadStillGoesToAnEmptyFile()
    {
        var writer = CreateWriter(maxBytes: 4);

        writer.Append(Line("0123456789"));

        await Assert.That(File.Exists(PathOf("20260115", 0))).IsTrue();
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task Append_RotatesDailyAndRestartsSequence()
    {
        var writer = CreateWriter(maxBytes: 12);
        writer.Append(Line("0123456789"));
        writer.Append(Line("0123456789"));

        _time.Now = _time.Now.AddDays(1);
        writer.Append(Line("next"));

        await Assert.That(File.Exists(PathOf("20260115", 1))).IsTrue();
        await Assert.That(await File.ReadAllTextAsync(PathOf("20260116", 0))).IsEqualTo("next\n");
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task Append_ContinuesAfterFilesLeftByEarlierRuns()
    {
        await File.WriteAllTextAsync(PathOf("20260115", 0), new string('x', 30));
        await File.WriteAllTextAsync(PathOf("20260115", 1), "old\n");
        var writer = CreateWriter(maxBytes: 20);

        writer.Append(Line("new"));

        await Assert.That(await File.ReadAllTextAsync(PathOf("20260115", 0))).IsEqualTo(new string('x', 30));
        await Assert.That(await File.ReadAllTextAsync(PathOf("20260115", 1))).IsEqualTo("old\nnew\n");
    }
}

using Microsoft.Data.Sqlite;

using MyImapDownloader.Core.Storage;

namespace MyImapDownloader.Core.Tests;

public class SqliteDatabaseTests : IDisposable
{
    private readonly TempDirectory _temp = new();

    public void Dispose() => _temp.Dispose();

    private string DatabasePath => Path.Combine(_temp.Path, "test.db");

    [Test]
    public async Task OpenAsync_CreatesDatabaseInWalMode()
    {
        await using var connection = await SqliteDatabase.OpenAsync(DatabasePath, CancellationToken.None);

        var mode = await connection.ScalarAsync("PRAGMA journal_mode;", CancellationToken.None);

        await Assert.That(File.Exists(DatabasePath)).IsTrue();
        await Assert.That(mode as string).IsEqualTo("wal");
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task ExecuteAndScalar_BindNamedParameters()
    {
        await using var connection = await SqliteDatabase.OpenAsync(DatabasePath, CancellationToken.None);
        await connection.ExecuteAsync("CREATE TABLE items (name TEXT, note TEXT);", CancellationToken.None);

        var inserted = await connection.ExecuteAsync(
            "INSERT INTO items (name, note) VALUES (@name, @note);",
            CancellationToken.None,
            [("@name", "first"), ("@note", null)]);
        var name = await connection.ScalarAsync(
            "SELECT name FROM items WHERE note IS NULL;", CancellationToken.None);
        var missing = await connection.ScalarAsync(
            "SELECT note FROM items WHERE name = @name;", CancellationToken.None, [("@name", "first")]);

        await Assert.That(inserted).IsEqualTo(1);
        await Assert.That(name as string).IsEqualTo("first");
        await Assert.That(missing).IsNull();
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task OpenAsync_ReleasesTheFileWhenDisposed()
    {
        var connection = await SqliteDatabase.OpenAsync(DatabasePath, CancellationToken.None);
        await connection.DisposeAsync();

        File.Move(DatabasePath, DatabasePath + ".moved");

        await Assert.That(File.Exists(DatabasePath + ".moved")).IsTrue();
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task OpenAsync_ReportsGarbageFileAsCorruption()
    {
        await File.WriteAllTextAsync(DatabasePath, new string('x', 4096));

        var exception = await Assert.ThrowsAsync<SqliteException>(
            async () => await SqliteDatabase.OpenAsync(DatabasePath, CancellationToken.None));

        await Assert.That(SqliteDatabase.IsCorruption(exception!)).IsTrue();
    }
}

using MyImapDownloader.Core.Paths;
using MyImapDownloader.Core.Telemetry;

namespace MyImapDownloader.Core.Tests;

public class TelemetryDirectoriesTests
{
    [Test]
    public async Task Candidates_PreferStateThenDataOverrides()
    {
        var xdg = new XdgDirectories(
            name => name switch { "XDG_STATE_HOME" => "/state", "XDG_DATA_HOME" => "/data", _ => null },
            "/home/test");

        var candidates = TelemetryDirectories.Candidates("MyApp", xdg).ToList();

        await Assert.That(candidates[0]).IsEqualTo(Path.Combine("/state", "myapp", "telemetry"));
        await Assert.That(candidates[1]).IsEqualTo(Path.Combine("/data", "myapp", "telemetry"));
        await Assert.That(candidates[^1]).IsEqualTo(Path.Combine(Environment.CurrentDirectory, "telemetry"));
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task FirstWritable_SkipsUnusableCandidates()
    {
        using var temp = new TempDirectory();
        var blocker = Path.Combine(temp.Path, "file");
        await File.WriteAllTextAsync(blocker, "x");
        var usable = Path.Combine(temp.Path, "usable", "telemetry");

        var chosen = TelemetryDirectories.FirstWritable([Path.Combine(blocker, "telemetry"), usable]);

        await Assert.That(chosen).IsEqualTo(usable);
        await Assert.That(Directory.Exists(usable)).IsTrue();
        await Assert.That(Directory.GetFiles(usable).Length).IsEqualTo(0);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task FirstWritable_ReturnsNullWhenNothingIsWritable()
    {
        using var temp = new TempDirectory();
        var blocker = Path.Combine(temp.Path, "file");
        await File.WriteAllTextAsync(blocker, "x");

        var chosen = TelemetryDirectories.FirstWritable([Path.Combine(blocker, "telemetry")]);

        await Assert.That(chosen).IsNull();
    }
}

using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;

using MyImapDownloader.Core.Telemetry;

namespace MyImapDownloader.Core.Tests;

public class TelemetryOptionsTests
{
    [Test]
    public async Task From_UsesDefaultsWhenSectionIsMissing()
    {
        var options = TelemetryOptions.From(new ConfigurationBuilder().Build(), "Service", "2.0.0");

        await Assert.That(options.ServiceName).IsEqualTo("Service");
        await Assert.That(options.ServiceVersion).IsEqualTo("2.0.0");
        await Assert.That(options.MaxFileSizeMB).IsEqualTo(25);
        await Assert.That(options.MaxFileSizeBytes).IsEqualTo(25L * 1024 * 1024);
        await Assert.That(options.EnableTracing).IsTrue();
        await Assert.That(options.EnableMetrics).IsTrue();
        await Assert.That(options.EnableLogging).IsTrue();
        await Assert.That(options.FlushIntervalSeconds).IsEqualTo(5);
        await Assert.That(options.MetricsExportIntervalSeconds).IsEqualTo(15);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task From_BindsTelemetrySection()
    {
        var configuration = new ConfigurationBuilder()
            .AddInMemoryCollection(new Dictionary<string, string?>
            {
                ["Telemetry:ServiceName"] = "Custom",
                ["Telemetry:MaxFileSizeMB"] = "3",
                ["Telemetry:EnableMetrics"] = "false",
                ["Telemetry:FlushIntervalSeconds"] = "9"
            })
            .Build();

        var options = TelemetryOptions.From(configuration, "Service", "2.0.0");

        await Assert.That(options.ServiceName).IsEqualTo("Custom");
        await Assert.That(options.ServiceVersion).IsEqualTo("2.0.0");
        await Assert.That(options.MaxFileSizeMB).IsEqualTo(3);
        await Assert.That(options.EnableMetrics).IsFalse();
        await Assert.That(options.FlushIntervalSeconds).IsEqualTo(9);
    }
}

namespace MyImapDownloader.Core.Tests;

public sealed class TempDirectory : IDisposable
{
    public TempDirectory()
    {
        Path = System.IO.Path.Combine(System.IO.Path.GetTempPath(), $"core_tests_{Guid.NewGuid():N}");
        Directory.CreateDirectory(Path);
    }

    public string Path { get; }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        try
        {
            Directory.Delete(Path, recursive: true);
        }
        catch (Exception exception) when (exception is IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException)
        {
        }
    }
}

{
    public DateTimeOffset Now { get; set; } = now;

    public override DateTimeOffset GetUtcNow() => Now;
}

using MyImapDownloader.Core.Paths;

namespace MyImapDownloader.Core.Tests;

public class XdgDirectoriesTests
{
    private static XdgDirectories Create(params (string Name, string Value)[] variables) =>
        new(name => variables.FirstOrDefault(v => v.Name == name).Value, "/home/test");

    [Test]
    public async Task Defaults_FollowXdgSpecification()
    {
        var xdg = Create();

        await Assert.That(xdg.DataHome).IsEqualTo(Path.Combine("/home/test", ".local", "share"));
        await Assert.That(xdg.StateHome).IsEqualTo(Path.Combine("/home/test", ".local", "state"));
        await Assert.That(xdg.DataHomeOverride).IsNull();
        await Assert.That(xdg.StateHomeOverride).IsNull();
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task EnvironmentVariables_OverrideDefaults()
    {
        var xdg = Create(("XDG_DATA_HOME", "/data"), ("XDG_STATE_HOME", "/state"));

        await Assert.That(xdg.DataHome).IsEqualTo("/data");
        await Assert.That(xdg.StateHome).IsEqualTo("/state");
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task BlankVariables_AreIgnored()
    {
        var xdg = Create(("XDG_DATA_HOME", "  "));

        await Assert.That(xdg.DataHomeOverride).IsNull();
        await Assert.That(xdg.Variable("MISSING")).IsNull();
    }
}

namespace MyImapDownloader.Core.Paths;

public sealed class XdgDirectories(Func<string, string?> environment, string home)
{
    public static XdgDirectories Current { get; } = new(
        Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable,
        Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.UserProfile));

    public string Home => home;

    public string? DataHomeOverride => Variable("XDG_DATA_HOME");

    public string? StateHomeOverride => Variable("XDG_STATE_HOME");

    public string DataHome => DataHomeOverride ?? Path.Combine(home, ".local", "share");

    public string StateHome => StateHomeOverride ?? Path.Combine(home, ".local", "state");

    public string? Variable(string name) =>
        environment(name) is { } value && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value) ? value : null;
}

using Microsoft.Data.Sqlite;

namespace MyImapDownloader.Core.Storage;

public static class SqliteDatabase
{
    private const int CorruptErrorCode = 11;
    private const int NotADatabaseErrorCode = 26;

    public static async Task<SqliteConnection> OpenAsync(string path, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var connectionString = new SqliteConnectionStringBuilder { DataSource = path, Pooling = false }.ToString();
        var connection = new SqliteConnection(connectionString);
        try
        {
            await connection.OpenAsync(ct);
            await connection.ExecuteAsync("PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL; PRAGMA synchronous = NORMAL;", ct);
            return connection;
        }
        catch
        {
            await connection.DisposeAsync();
            throw;
        }
    }

    public static bool IsCorruption(SqliteException exception) =>
        exception.SqliteErrorCode is CorruptErrorCode or NotADatabaseErrorCode;

    extension(SqliteConnection connection)
    {
        public SqliteCommand Prepare(string sql, IEnumerable<(string Name, object? Value)>? parameters = null)
        {
            var command = connection.CreateCommand();
            command.CommandText = sql;
            foreach (var (name, value) in parameters ?? [])
            {
                command.Parameters.AddWithValue(name, value ?? DBNull.Value);
            }

            return command;
        }

        public async Task<int> ExecuteAsync(
            string sql,
            CancellationToken ct,
            IEnumerable<(string Name, object? Value)>? parameters = null)
        {
            await using var command = connection.Prepare(sql, parameters);
            return await command.ExecuteNonQueryAsync(ct);
        }

        public async Task<object?> ScalarAsync(
            string sql,
            CancellationToken ct,
            IEnumerable<(string Name, object? Value)>? parameters = null)
        {
            await using var command = connection.Prepare(sql, parameters);
            var value = await command.ExecuteScalarAsync(ct);
            return value is DBNull ? null : value;
        }
    }
}

using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

using MyImapDownloader.Core.Paths;

using OpenTelemetry;
using OpenTelemetry.Logs;
using OpenTelemetry.Metrics;
using OpenTelemetry.Resources;
using OpenTelemetry.Trace;

namespace MyImapDownloader.Core.Telemetry;

public sealed class JsonFileTelemetry : IDisposable
{
    private const int MaxQueueSize = 2048;
    private const string RuntimeMeterName = "System.Runtime";

    private readonly TracerProvider? _tracerProvider;
    private readonly MeterProvider? _meterProvider;
    private readonly JsonLinesFileWriter? _logWriter;
    private readonly ResourceBuilder _resource;
    private readonly int _flushIntervalMilliseconds;

    private JsonFileTelemetry(TelemetryOptions options, string sourceName, string? directory, TimeProvider time)
    {
        OutputDirectory = directory;
        _flushIntervalMilliseconds = options.FlushIntervalSeconds * 1000;
        _resource = ResourceBuilder.CreateDefault()
            .AddService(serviceName: options.ServiceName, serviceVersion: options.ServiceVersion);

        if (directory is null)
        {
            return;
        }

        if (options.EnableTracing && CreateWriter(directory, "traces", options, time) is { } traceWriter)
        {
            _tracerProvider = Sdk.CreateTracerProviderBuilder()
                .SetResourceBuilder(_resource)
                .AddSource(sourceName)
                .AddProcessor(new BatchActivityExportProcessor(
                    new JsonLinesTraceExporter(traceWriter),
                    maxQueueSize: MaxQueueSize,
                    scheduledDelayMilliseconds: _flushIntervalMilliseconds))
                .Build();
        }

        if (options.EnableMetrics && CreateWriter(directory, "metrics", options, time) is { } metricWriter)
        {
            _meterProvider = Sdk.CreateMeterProviderBuilder()
                .SetResourceBuilder(_resource)
                .AddMeter(sourceName)
                .AddMeter(RuntimeMeterName)
                .AddReader(new PeriodicExportingMetricReader(
                    new JsonLinesMetricExporter(metricWriter),
                    exportIntervalMilliseconds: options.MetricsExportIntervalSeconds * 1000))
                .Build();
        }

        if (options.EnableLogging)
        {
            _logWriter = CreateWriter(directory, "logs", options, time);
        }
    }

    public string? OutputDirectory { get; }

    public static JsonFileTelemetry Start(
        TelemetryOptions options,
        string sourceName,
        XdgDirectories xdg,
        TimeProvider? time = null) =>
        Start(
            options,
            sourceName,
            TelemetryDirectories.FirstWritable(TelemetryDirectories.Candidates(options.ServiceName, xdg)),
            time);

    public static JsonFileTelemetry Start(
        TelemetryOptions options,
        string sourceName,
        string? directory,
        TimeProvider? time = null) =>
        new(options, sourceName, directory, time ?? TimeProvider.System);

    public void ConfigureLogging(ILoggingBuilder logging)
    {
        if (_logWriter is not { } writer)
        {
            return;
        }

        logging.AddOpenTelemetry(options =>
        {
            options.SetResourceBuilder(_resource);
            options.IncludeFormattedMessage = true;
            options.IncludeScopes = true;
            options.ParseStateValues = true;
            options.AddProcessor(new BatchLogRecordExportProcessor(
                new JsonLinesLogExporter(writer),
                maxQueueSize: MaxQueueSize,
                scheduledDelayMilliseconds: _flushIntervalMilliseconds));
        });
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        _tracerProvider?.Dispose();
        _meterProvider?.Dispose();
    }

    private static JsonLinesFileWriter? CreateWriter(
        string directory,
        string kind,
        TelemetryOptions options,
        TimeProvider time)
    {
        try
        {
            return new JsonLinesFileWriter(Path.Combine(directory, kind), kind, options.MaxFileSizeBytes, time);
        }
        catch (Exception)
        {
            return null;
        }
    }
}

using System.Buffers;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.Json.Serialization.Metadata;

namespace MyImapDownloader.Core.Telemetry;

public sealed class JsonLinesBuffer
{
    private readonly ArrayBufferWriter<byte> _bytes = new();

    public ReadOnlySpan<byte> WrittenSpan => _bytes.WrittenSpan;

    public void Add<T>(T record, JsonTypeInfo<T> typeInfo)
    {
        using (var writer = new Utf8JsonWriter(_bytes))
        {
            JsonSerializer.Serialize(writer, record, typeInfo);
        }

        _bytes.Write("\n"u8);
    }
}

using OpenTelemetry;

namespace MyImapDownloader.Core.Telemetry;

public abstract class JsonLinesExporter<T>(JsonLinesFileWriter writer) : BaseExporter<T>
    where T : class
{
    public sealed override ExportResult Export(in Batch<T> batch)
    {
        try
        {
            var buffer = new JsonLinesBuffer();
            foreach (var item in batch)
            {
                Append(item, buffer);
            }

            writer.Append(buffer.WrittenSpan);
            return ExportResult.Success;
        }
        catch (Exception)
        {
            return ExportResult.Failure;
        }
    }

    protected abstract void Append(T item, JsonLinesBuffer buffer);
}
