using System.Globalization;

namespace MyImapDownloader.Core.Telemetry;

public sealed class JsonLinesFileWriter
{
    private readonly Lock _gate = new();
    private readonly string _directory;
    private readonly string _prefix;
    private readonly long _maxFileSizeBytes;
    private readonly TimeProvider _time;
    private string _date = "";
    private int _sequence;

    public JsonLinesFileWriter(string directory, string prefix, long maxFileSizeBytes, TimeProvider time)
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(directory);
        _directory = directory;
        _prefix = prefix;
        _maxFileSizeBytes = maxFileSizeBytes;
        _time = time;
    }

    public void Append(ReadOnlySpan<byte> lines)
    {
        if (lines.IsEmpty)
        {
            return;
        }

        lock (_gate)
        {
            using var stream = new FileStream(
                SelectFile(lines.Length), FileMode.Append, FileAccess.Write, FileShare.Read);
            stream.Write(lines);
        }
    }

    private string SelectFile(int incomingBytes)
    {
        var today = _time.GetUtcNow().ToString("yyyyMMdd", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        if (today != _date)
        {
            _date = today;
            _sequence = 0;
        }

        while (true)
        {
            var path = Path.Combine(
                _directory, string.Create(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, $"{_prefix}_{_date}_{_sequence:D4}.jsonl"));
            var file = new FileInfo(path);
            var size = file.Exists ? file.Length : 0;
            if (size == 0 || size + incomingBytes <= _maxFileSizeBytes)
            {
                return path;
            }

            _sequence++;
        }
    }
}

using OpenTelemetry.Logs;

namespace MyImapDownloader.Core.Telemetry;

public sealed class JsonLinesLogExporter(JsonLinesFileWriter writer) : JsonLinesExporter<LogRecord>(writer)
{
    protected override void Append(LogRecord log, JsonLinesBuffer buffer) =>
        buffer.Add(
            new LogRecordData
            {
                Timestamp = log.Timestamp != default ? log.Timestamp : DateTime.UtcNow,
                TraceId = log.TraceId != default ? log.TraceId.ToString() : null,
                SpanId = log.SpanId != default ? log.SpanId.ToString() : null,
                LogLevel = log.LogLevel.ToString(),
                CategoryName = log.CategoryName,
                EventId = log.EventId.Id != 0 ? log.EventId.Id : null,
                EventName = log.EventId.Name,
                FormattedMessage = log.FormattedMessage,
                Body = log.Body,
                Attributes = log.Attributes is { Count: > 0 } attributes ? TelemetryTags.ToStrings(attributes) : null,
                Exception = ExceptionInfo.From(log.Exception)
            },
            TelemetryJsonContext.Default.LogRecordData);
}

using OpenTelemetry.Metrics;

namespace MyImapDownloader.Core.Telemetry;

public sealed class JsonLinesMetricExporter(JsonLinesFileWriter writer) : JsonLinesExporter<Metric>(writer)
{
    protected override void Append(Metric metric, JsonLinesBuffer buffer)
    {
        foreach (ref readonly var point in metric.GetMetricPoints())
        {
            buffer.Add(
                new MetricRecord
                {
                    Timestamp = point.EndTime.UtcDateTime,
                    MetricName = metric.Name,
                    MetricDescription = metric.Description,
                    MetricUnit = metric.Unit,
                    MetricType = metric.MetricType.ToString(),
                    MeterName = metric.MeterName,
                    StartTime = point.StartTime.UtcDateTime,
                    EndTime = point.EndTime.UtcDateTime,
                    Tags = ExtractTags(in point),
                    Value = ExtractValue(metric.MetricType, in point)
                },
                TelemetryJsonContext.Default.MetricRecord);
        }
    }

    private static Dictionary<string, string?>? ExtractTags(in MetricPoint point)
    {
        var tags = new Dictionary<string, string?>();
        foreach (var tag in point.Tags)
        {
            tags[tag.Key] = tag.Value?.ToString();
        }

        return tags.Count > 0 ? tags : null;
    }

    private static object? ExtractValue(MetricType metricType, in MetricPoint point) => metricType switch
    {
        MetricType.LongSum or MetricType.LongSumNonMonotonic => point.GetSumLong(),
        MetricType.DoubleSum or MetricType.DoubleSumNonMonotonic => point.GetSumDouble(),
        MetricType.LongGauge => point.GetGaugeLastValueLong(),
        MetricType.DoubleGauge => point.GetGaugeLastValueDouble(),
        MetricType.Histogram or MetricType.ExponentialHistogram => ExtractHistogram(in point),
        _ => null
    };

    private static HistogramValue ExtractHistogram(in MetricPoint point)
    {
        var hasMinMax = point.TryGetHistogramMinMaxValues(out var min, out var max);
        return new HistogramValue
        {
            Count = point.GetHistogramCount(),
            Sum = point.GetHistogramSum(),
            Min = hasMinMax ? min : null,
            Max = hasMinMax ? max : null
        };
    }
}

using System.Diagnostics;

namespace MyImapDownloader.Core.Telemetry;

public sealed class JsonLinesTraceExporter(JsonLinesFileWriter writer) : JsonLinesExporter<Activity>(writer)
{
    protected override void Append(Activity activity, JsonLinesBuffer buffer) =>
        buffer.Add(
            new TraceRecord
            {
                Timestamp = activity.StartTimeUtc,
                TraceId = activity.TraceId.ToString(),
                SpanId = activity.SpanId.ToString(),
                ParentSpanId = activity.ParentSpanId.ToString(),
                OperationName = activity.OperationName,
                DisplayName = activity.DisplayName,
                Kind = activity.Kind.ToString(),
                Status = activity.Status.ToString(),
                StatusDescription = activity.StatusDescription,
                Duration = activity.Duration,
                DurationMs = activity.Duration.TotalMilliseconds,
                Source = new SourceInfo { Name = activity.Source.Name, Version = activity.Source.Version },
                Tags = TelemetryTags.ToStrings(activity.TagObjects),
                Events = activity.Events
                    .Select(e => new SpanEvent
                    {
                        Name = e.Name,
                        Timestamp = e.Timestamp.UtcDateTime,
                        Attributes = TelemetryTags.ToStrings(e.Tags)
                    })
                    .ToList()
            },
            TelemetryJsonContext.Default.TraceRecord);
}

using MyImapDownloader.Core.Paths;

namespace MyImapDownloader.Core.Telemetry;

public static class TelemetryDirectories
{
    private const string Leaf = "telemetry";

    public static IEnumerable<string> Candidates(string appName, XdgDirectories xdg)
    {
        var name = appName.ToLowerInvariant();

        if (xdg.StateHomeOverride is { } stateHome)
        {
            yield return Path.Combine(stateHome, name, Leaf);
        }

        if (xdg.DataHomeOverride is { } dataHome)
        {
            yield return Path.Combine(dataHome, name, Leaf);
        }

        if (OperatingSystem.IsWindows())
        {
            yield return Path.Combine(
                Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData), appName, Leaf);
        }
        else
        {
            yield return Path.Combine(xdg.Home, ".local", "state", name, Leaf);
            yield return Path.Combine(xdg.Home, ".local", "share", name, Leaf);
        }

        yield return Path.Combine(Environment.CurrentDirectory, Leaf);
    }

    public static string? FirstWritable(IEnumerable<string> candidates) => candidates.FirstOrDefault(IsWritable);

    private static bool IsWritable(string directory)
    {
        try
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(directory);
            var probe = Path.Combine(directory, $".write-test-{Guid.NewGuid():N}");
            File.WriteAllText(probe, "test");
            File.Delete(probe);
            return true;
        }
        catch (Exception)
        {
            return false;
        }
    }
}

using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;

namespace MyImapDownloader.Core.Telemetry;

public sealed class TelemetryOptions
{
    public const string SectionName = "Telemetry";

    public string ServiceName { get; set; } = "MyImapDownloader";
    public string ServiceVersion { get; set; } = "1.0.0";
    public int MaxFileSizeMB { get; set; } = 25;
    public bool EnableTracing { get; set; } = true;
    public bool EnableMetrics { get; set; } = true;
    public bool EnableLogging { get; set; } = true;
    public int FlushIntervalSeconds { get; set; } = 5;
    public int MetricsExportIntervalSeconds { get; set; } = 15;

    public long MaxFileSizeBytes => MaxFileSizeMB * 1024L * 1024L;

    public static TelemetryOptions From(IConfiguration configuration, string serviceName, string serviceVersion)
    {
        var options = new TelemetryOptions { ServiceName = serviceName, ServiceVersion = serviceVersion };
        configuration.GetSection(SectionName).Bind(options);
        return options;
    }
}

using System.Globalization;
using System.Text.Json.Serialization;

namespace MyImapDownloader.Core.Telemetry;

public sealed record TraceRecord
{
    public string Type => "trace";
    public DateTime Timestamp { get; init; }
    public string? TraceId { get; init; }
    public string? SpanId { get; init; }
    public string? ParentSpanId { get; init; }
    public string? OperationName { get; init; }
    public string? DisplayName { get; init; }
    public string? Kind { get; init; }
    public string? Status { get; init; }
    public string? StatusDescription { get; init; }
    public TimeSpan Duration { get; init; }
    public double DurationMs { get; init; }
    public SourceInfo? Source { get; init; }
    public Dictionary<string, string?>? Tags { get; init; }
    public List<SpanEvent>? Events { get; init; }
}

public sealed record SourceInfo
{
    public string? Name { get; init; }
    public string? Version { get; init; }
}

public sealed record SpanEvent
{
    public string? Name { get; init; }
    public DateTime Timestamp { get; init; }
    public Dictionary<string, string?>? Attributes { get; init; }
}

public sealed record MetricRecord
{
    public string Type => "metric";
    public DateTime Timestamp { get; init; }
    public string? MetricName { get; init; }
    public string? MetricDescription { get; init; }
    public string? MetricUnit { get; init; }
    public string? MetricType { get; init; }
    public string? MeterName { get; init; }
    public DateTime StartTime { get; init; }
    public DateTime EndTime { get; init; }
    public Dictionary<string, string?>? Tags { get; init; }
    public object? Value { get; init; }
}

public sealed record HistogramValue
{
    public long Count { get; init; }
    public double Sum { get; init; }
    public double? Min { get; init; }
    public double? Max { get; init; }
}

public sealed record LogRecordData
{
    public string Type => "log";
    public DateTime Timestamp { get; init; }
    public string? TraceId { get; init; }
    public string? SpanId { get; init; }
    public string? LogLevel { get; init; }
    public string? CategoryName { get; init; }
    public int? EventId { get; init; }
    public string? EventName { get; init; }
    public string? FormattedMessage { get; init; }
    public string? Body { get; init; }
    public Dictionary<string, string?>? Attributes { get; init; }
    public ExceptionInfo? Exception { get; init; }
}

public sealed record ExceptionInfo
{
    public string? Type { get; init; }
    public string? Message { get; init; }
    public string? StackTrace { get; init; }
    public ExceptionInfo? InnerException { get; init; }

    public static ExceptionInfo? From(Exception? exception) => exception is null
        ? null
        : new ExceptionInfo
        {
            Type = exception.GetType().FullName,
            Message = exception.Message,
            StackTrace = exception.StackTrace,
            InnerException = From(exception.InnerException)
        };
}

public static class TelemetryTags
{
    public static Dictionary<string, string?> ToStrings(IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<string, object?>> tags)
    {
        var result = new Dictionary<string, string?>();
        foreach (var (key, value) in tags)
        {
            result[key] = Convert.ToString(value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        }

        return result;
    }
}

[JsonSourceGenerationOptions(DefaultIgnoreCondition = JsonIgnoreCondition.WhenWritingNull)]
[JsonSerializable(typeof(TraceRecord))]
[JsonSerializable(typeof(MetricRecord))]
[JsonSerializable(typeof(LogRecordData))]
[JsonSerializable(typeof(HistogramValue))]
[JsonSerializable(typeof(long))]
[JsonSerializable(typeof(double))]
internal partial class TelemetryJsonContext : JsonSerializerContext
{
}

using Microsoft.Data.Sqlite;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;

using MyImapDownloader.Archive;

namespace MyImapDownloader.Tests;

public class ArchiveIndexTests : IDisposable
{
    private const string LegacySchema = """
        PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL;
        PRAGMA synchronous = NORMAL;

        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS Messages (
            MessageId TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            Folder TEXT NOT NULL,
            ImportedAt TEXT NOT NULL
        );

        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS SyncState (
            Folder TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            LastUid INTEGER NOT NULL,
            UidValidity INTEGER NOT NULL
        );

        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS IX_Messages_Folder ON Messages(Folder);

        INSERT INTO Messages (MessageId, Folder, ImportedAt) VALUES ('legacy@example.com', 'INBOX', '2025-01-01T00:00:00.0000000Z');
        INSERT INTO SyncState (Folder, LastUid, UidValidity) VALUES ('INBOX', 41, 7);
        """;

    private readonly TempDirectory _temp = new();
    private readonly ManualTimeProvider _time = new(new DateTimeOffset(2025, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, TimeSpan.Zero));

    public void Dispose() => _temp.Dispose();

    private string DatabasePath => Path.Combine(_temp.Path, ArchiveIndex.FileName);

    private Task<ArchiveIndex> OpenAsync() =>
        ArchiveIndex.OpenAsync(_temp.Path, NullLogger<ArchiveIndex>.Instance, _time, CancellationToken.None);

    private void WriteSidecar(string folder, string name, string json)
    {
        var directory = Path.Combine(_temp.Path, folder, "cur");
        Directory.CreateDirectory(directory);
        File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(directory, name + ".eml.meta.json"), json);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task OpenAsync_CreatesIndexFile()
    {
        await using var index = await OpenAsync();

        await Assert.That(File.Exists(DatabasePath)).IsTrue();
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task RecordAsync_MakesMessageKnown()
    {
        await using var index = await OpenAsync();

        await index.RecordAsync("a@example.com", "INBOX", CancellationToken.None);
        await index.RecordAsync("a@example.com", "Archive", CancellationToken.None);

        await Assert.That(await index.ContainsAsync("a@example.com", CancellationToken.None)).IsTrue();
        await Assert.That(await index.ContainsAsync("b@example.com", CancellationToken.None)).IsFalse();
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task LastUid_IsZeroForUnknownFolder()
    {
        await using var index = await OpenAsync();

        await Assert.That(await index.GetLastUidAsync("INBOX", 1, CancellationToken.None)).IsEqualTo(0L);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task LastUid_RoundTripsAndSurvivesReopen()
    {
        await using (var index = await OpenAsync())
        {
            await index.SetLastUidAsync("INBOX", 42, 7, CancellationToken.None);
        }

        await using var reopened = await OpenAsync();

        await Assert.That(await reopened.GetLastUidAsync("INBOX", 7, CancellationToken.None)).IsEqualTo(42L);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task LastUid_NeverMovesBackwardsForSameValidity()
    {
        await using var index = await OpenAsync();

        await index.SetLastUidAsync("INBOX", 42, 7, CancellationToken.None);
        await index.SetLastUidAsync("INBOX", 10, 7, CancellationToken.None);

        await Assert.That(await index.GetLastUidAsync("INBOX", 7, CancellationToken.None)).IsEqualTo(42L);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task LastUid_ResetsWhenUidValidityChanges()
    {
        await using var index = await OpenAsync();
        await index.SetLastUidAsync("INBOX", 42, 7, CancellationToken.None);

        var afterChange = await index.GetLastUidAsync("INBOX", 8, CancellationToken.None);
        await index.SetLastUidAsync("INBOX", 3, 8, CancellationToken.None);

        await Assert.That(afterChange).IsEqualTo(0L);
        await Assert.That(await index.GetLastUidAsync("INBOX", 8, CancellationToken.None)).IsEqualTo(3L);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task OpenAsync_KeepsDataWrittenByEarlierVersions()
    {
        await using (var connection = new SqliteConnection($"Data Source={DatabasePath};Pooling=False"))
        {
            await connection.OpenAsync();
            await using var command = connection.CreateCommand();
            command.CommandText = LegacySchema;
            await command.ExecuteNonQueryAsync();
        }

        await using var index = await OpenAsync();

        await Assert.That(await index.ContainsAsync("legacy@example.com", CancellationToken.None)).IsTrue();
        await Assert.That(await index.GetLastUidAsync("INBOX", 7, CancellationToken.None)).IsEqualTo(41L);
        await Assert.That(Directory.GetFiles(_temp.Path, "*.corrupt.*").Length).IsEqualTo(0);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task OpenAsync_QuarantinesCorruptIndexAndRebuildsFromSidecars()
    {
        await File.WriteAllTextAsync(DatabasePath, new string('x', 8192));
        WriteSidecar("INBOX", "1", """
            {
              "MessageId": "one@example.com",
              "Subject": "One",
              "From": "a@example.com",
              "To": "b@example.com",
              "Date": "2025-12-24T10:30:00Z",
              "Folder": "INBOX",
              "ArchivedAt": "2025-12-24T15:45:32Z",
              "HasAttachments": false
            }
            """);
        WriteSidecar("Archive", "2", """{ "MessageId": "two@example.com", "Folder": "Archive" }""");
        WriteSidecar("Archive", "3", "not json");
        WriteSidecar("Archive", "4", """{ "Subject": "missing required members" }""");

        await using var index = await OpenAsync();

        await Assert.That(Directory.GetFiles(_temp.Path, ArchiveIndex.FileName + ".corrupt.*").Length).IsEqualTo(1);
        await Assert.That(await index.ContainsAsync("one@example.com", CancellationToken.None)).IsTrue();
        await Assert.That(await index.ContainsAsync("two@example.com", CancellationToken.None)).IsTrue();
        await Assert.That(await index.GetLastUidAsync("INBOX", 1, CancellationToken.None)).IsEqualTo(0L);
    }
}

using MyImapDownloader.Archive;

namespace MyImapDownloader.Tests;

public class ArchiveNamingTests
{
    [Test]
    [Arguments("abc@example.com", "abc@example.com")]
    [Arguments("<abc@example.com>", "_abc@example.com_")]
    [Arguments("<A.B-C_d@Mail.Example.COM>", "_a.b-c_d@mail.example.com_")]
    [Arguments("INBOX/Sub Folder", "inbox_sub folder")]
    [Arguments("a:b|c?d*e\"f\\g", "a_b_c_d_e_f_g")]
    [Arguments("  spaced  ", "  spaced  ")]
    [Arguments("<>", "__")]
    [Arguments("", "unknown")]
    public async Task NormalizeMessageId_MatchesExistingArchives(string input, string expected)
    {
        await Assert.That(ArchiveNaming.NormalizeMessageId(input)).IsEqualTo(expected);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task NormalizeMessageId_KeepsIdsOfExactlyOneHundredCharacters()
    {
        var id = new string('x', 100);

        await Assert.That(ArchiveNaming.NormalizeMessageId(id)).IsEqualTo(id);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task NormalizeMessageId_ShortensLongIdsWithStableHashSuffix()
    {
        var normalized = ArchiveNaming.NormalizeMessageId(new string('x', 101));

        await Assert.That(normalized).IsEqualTo(new string('x', 91) + "_c675a2e6");
        await Assert.That(normalized.Length).IsEqualTo(100);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task NormalizeMessageId_ReplacesControlCharacters()
    {
        await Assert.That(ArchiveNaming.NormalizeMessageId("a\tb\u0001c")).IsEqualTo("a_b_c");
    }

    [Test]
    [Arguments("INBOX", "INBOX")]
    [Arguments("INBOX/Sub Folder", "INBOX_Sub_Folder")]
    [Arguments("[Gmail]/All Mail", "Gmail_All_Mail")]
    [Arguments("Entwürfe", "Entwürfe")]
    [Arguments("###", "")]
    public async Task FolderDirectory_MatchesExistingArchives(string folder, string expected)
    {
        await Assert.That(ArchiveNaming.FolderDirectory(folder)).IsEqualTo(expected);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task Sanitize_TruncatesToMaximumLength()
    {
        await Assert.That(ArchiveNaming.Sanitize("a really long host name with spaces", 20))
            .IsEqualTo("a_really_long_host_n");
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task SafeFileId_TrimsTrailingDotsAndSpaces()
    {
        await Assert.That(ArchiveNaming.SafeFileId("abc@example.com. .")).IsEqualTo("abc@example.com");
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task FileName_CombinesUnixTimeIdAndHost()
    {
        var date = DateTimeOffset.FromUnixTimeSeconds(1702900000);

        var name = ArchiveNaming.FileName(date, "abc123@mail.example.com", "my host");

        await Assert.That(name).IsEqualTo("1702900000.abc123@mail.example.com.my_host.eml");
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task Hash_IsLowercaseSha256()
    {
        await Assert.That(ArchiveNaming.Hash("abc"))
            .IsEqualTo("ba7816bf8f01cfea414140de5dae2223b00361a396177a9cb410ff61f20015ad");
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task HashFileAsync_MatchesHashOfContent()
    {
        using var temp = new TempDirectory();
        var path = Path.Combine(temp.Path, "file.txt");
        await File.WriteAllTextAsync(path, "abc");

        await Assert.That(await ArchiveNaming.HashFileAsync(path, CancellationToken.None))
            .IsEqualTo(ArchiveNaming.Hash("abc"));
    }
}

using System.CommandLine;

namespace MyImapDownloader.Tests;

public class DownloadCommandTests
{
    private static async Task<(int ExitCode, DownloadOptions? Options)> InvokeAsync(
        int actionExitCode,
        string? passwordVariable,
        params string[] args)
    {
        DownloadOptions? captured = null;
        var command = DownloadCommand.Create(
            (options, _) =>
            {
                captured = options;
                return Task.FromResult(actionExitCode);
            },
            name => name == DownloadCommand.PasswordVariable ? passwordVariable : null);

        var invocation = new InvocationConfiguration
        {
            Output = TextWriter.Null,
            Error = TextWriter.Null,
            ProcessTerminationTimeout = null
        };

        var exitCode = await DownloadCommand.Parse(command, args).InvokeAsync(invocation);
        return (exitCode, captured);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task LongOptions_PopulateDownloadOptions()
    {
        var (exitCode, options) = await InvokeAsync(0, null,
            "--server", "imap.example.com",
            "--username", "user@example.com",
            "--password", "secret",
            "--port", "143",
            "--output", "/tmp/archive",
            "--start-date", "2024-01-15",
            "--end-date", "2024-02-01",
            "--all-folders",
            "--verbose");

        await Assert.That(exitCode).IsEqualTo(0);
        await Assert.That(options).IsNotNull();
        await Assert.That(options!.Server).IsEqualTo("imap.example.com");
        await Assert.That(options.Username).IsEqualTo("user@example.com");
        await Assert.That(options.Password).IsEqualTo("secret");
        await Assert.That(options.Port).IsEqualTo(143);
        await Assert.That(options.OutputDirectory).IsEqualTo("/tmp/archive");
        await Assert.That(options.StartDate).IsEqualTo(new DateTime(2024, 1, 15));
        await Assert.That(options.EndDate).IsEqualTo(new DateTime(2024, 2, 1));
        await Assert.That(options.AllFolders).IsTrue();
        await Assert.That(options.Verbose).IsTrue();
        await Assert.That(options.HasDateWindow).IsTrue();
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task ShortAliases_PopulateDownloadOptions()
    {
        var (exitCode, options) = await InvokeAsync(0, null,
            "-s", "imap.example.com", "-u", "me", "-p", "pw", "-r", "1143", "-o", "out", "-a", "-v");

        await Assert.That(exitCode).IsEqualTo(0);
        await Assert.That(options).IsNotNull();
        await Assert.That(options!.Port).IsEqualTo(1143);
        await Assert.That(options.OutputDirectory).IsEqualTo("out");
        await Assert.That(options.AllFolders).IsTrue();
        await Assert.That(options.Verbose).IsTrue();
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task OptionalValues_UseDefaults()
    {
        var (_, options) = await InvokeAsync(0, null, "-s", "imap.example.com", "-u", "me", "-p", "pw");

        await Assert.That(options).IsNotNull();
        await Assert.That(options!.Port).IsEqualTo(993);
        await Assert.That(options.OutputDirectory).IsEqualTo("EmailArchive");
        await Assert.That(options.StartDate).IsNull();
        await Assert.That(options.EndDate).IsNull();
        await Assert.That(options.AllFolders).IsFalse();
        await Assert.That(options.Verbose).IsFalse();
        await Assert.That(options.HasDateWindow).IsFalse();
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task MissingPassword_FailsWithoutInvokingAction()
    {
        var (exitCode, options) = await InvokeAsync(0, null, "-s", "imap.example.com", "-u", "me");

        await Assert.That(exitCode).IsNotEqualTo(0);
        await Assert.That(options).IsNull();
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task MissingServer_FailsWithoutInvokingAction()
    {
        var (exitCode, options) = await InvokeAsync(0, null, "-u", "me", "-p", "pw");

        await Assert.That(exitCode).IsNotEqualTo(0);
        await Assert.That(options).IsNull();
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task MissingPassword_FallsBackToEnvironmentVariable()
    {
        var (exitCode, options) = await InvokeAsync(0, "from-environment", "-s", "imap.example.com", "-u", "me");

        await Assert.That(exitCode).IsEqualTo(0);
        await Assert.That(options).IsNotNull();
        await Assert.That(options!.Password).IsEqualTo("from-environment");
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task PasswordOption_WinsOverEnvironmentVariable()
    {
        var (_, options) = await InvokeAsync(0, "from-environment", "-s", "imap.example.com", "-u", "me", "-p", "pw");

        await Assert.That(options).IsNotNull();
        await Assert.That(options!.Password).IsEqualTo("pw");
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task PasswordStartingWithAt_IsNotTreatedAsResponseFile()
    {
        var (_, options) = await InvokeAsync(0, null, "-s", "imap.example.com", "-u", "me", "-p", "@secret");

        await Assert.That(options).IsNotNull();
        await Assert.That(options!.Password).IsEqualTo("@secret");
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task ActionExitCode_IsPropagated()
    {
        var (exitCode, _) = await InvokeAsync(7, null, "-s", "imap.example.com", "-u", "me", "-p", "pw");

        await Assert.That(exitCode).IsEqualTo(7);
    }
}

using System.Text;

using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;

using MyImapDownloader.Archive;

namespace MyImapDownloader.Tests;

public class EmailArchiveTests : IDisposable
{
    private static readonly DateTimeOffset InternalDate = new(2024, 12, 24, 10, 30, 0, TimeSpan.Zero);

    private readonly TempDirectory _temp = new();
    private readonly ManualTimeProvider _time = new(new DateTimeOffset(2025, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, TimeSpan.Zero));

    public void Dispose() => _temp.Dispose();

    private string Current => Path.Combine(_temp.Path, "INBOX", "cur");

    private Task<EmailArchive> OpenAsync() =>
        EmailArchive.OpenAsync(_temp.Path, NullLoggerFactory.Instance, _time, "testhost", CancellationToken.None);

    private static Task<StoreOutcome> StoreAsync(EmailArchive archive, byte[] content, string? messageId) =>
        archive.StoreAsync(new MemoryStream(content), messageId, InternalDate, "INBOX", CancellationToken.None);

    private string[] Emails() => Directory.GetFiles(Current, "*.eml");

    private void DeleteIndex()
    {
        foreach (var file in Directory.GetFiles(_temp.Path, ArchiveIndex.FileName + "*"))
        {
            File.Delete(file);
        }
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task StoreAsync_WritesMessageIntoMaildirLayout()
    {
        var content = Eml.Create("abc@example.com");
        await using var archive = await OpenAsync();

        var outcome = await StoreAsync(archive, content, "abc@example.com");

        var expected = Path.Combine(Current, $"{InternalDate.ToUnixTimeSeconds()}.abc@example.com.testhost.eml");
        await Assert.That(outcome is Stored).IsTrue();
        await Assert.That(File.Exists(expected)).IsTrue();
        await Assert.That(Convert.ToBase64String(await File.ReadAllBytesAsync(expected)))
            .IsEqualTo(Convert.ToBase64String(content));
        await Assert.That(Directory.Exists(Path.Combine(_temp.Path, "INBOX", "new"))).IsTrue();
        await Assert.That(Directory.GetFiles(Path.Combine(_temp.Path, "INBOX", "tmp")).Length).IsEqualTo(0);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task StoreAsync_WritesSidecarInEstablishedFormat()
    {
        await using var archive = await OpenAsync();

        await StoreAsync(archive, Eml.Create("abc@example.com", "Project Update"), "abc@example.com");

        var sidecar = await File.ReadAllTextAsync(Emails().Single() + ".meta.json");
        await Assert.That(sidecar.ReplaceLineEndings("\n")).IsEqualTo("""
            {
              "MessageId": "abc@example.com",
              "Subject": "Project Update",
              "From": "Sender \u003Csender@example.com\u003E",
              "To": "Receiver \u003Creceiver@example.com\u003E",
              "Date": "2024-12-24T10:30:00Z",
              "Folder": "INBOX",
              "ArchivedAt": "2025-01-02T03:04:05Z",
              "HasAttachments": false
            }
            """);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task StoreAsync_SanitizesFolderNames()
    {
        await using var archive = await OpenAsync();

        await archive.StoreAsync(
            new MemoryStream(Eml.Create("abc@example.com")),
            "abc@example.com",
            InternalDate,
            "INBOX/Sub Folder",
            CancellationToken.None);

        await Assert.That(Directory.GetFiles(Path.Combine(_temp.Path, "INBOX_Sub_Folder", "cur"), "*.eml").Length)
            .IsEqualTo(1);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task StoreAsync_SameMessageTwice_KeepsOneFile()
    {
        await using var archive = await OpenAsync();

        var first = await StoreAsync(archive, Eml.Create("abc@example.com"), "abc@example.com");
        var second = await StoreAsync(archive, Eml.Create("abc@example.com", body: "Different"), "abc@example.com");

        await Assert.That(first is Stored).IsTrue();
        await Assert.That(second is Duplicate).IsTrue();
        await Assert.That(Emails().Length).IsEqualTo(1);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task StoreAsync_WithoutEnvelopeId_UsesMessageIdHeader()
    {
        await using var archive = await OpenAsync();

        await StoreAsync(archive, Eml.Create("Header@Example.com"), messageId: null);
        var again = await StoreAsync(archive, Eml.Create("header@example.com"), messageId: null);

        await Assert.That(Path.GetFileName(Emails().Single()))
            .IsEqualTo($"{InternalDate.ToUnixTimeSeconds()}._header@example.com_.testhost.eml");
        await Assert.That(again is Duplicate).IsTrue();
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task StoreAsync_WithoutAnyMessageId_UsesContentHash()
    {
        var content = Eml.Create(messageId: null);
        await using var archive = await OpenAsync();

        var first = await StoreAsync(archive, content, messageId: null);
        var second = await StoreAsync(archive, content, messageId: "  ");

        var hash = Convert.ToHexStringLower(System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256.HashData(content));
        await Assert.That(first is Stored).IsTrue();
        await Assert.That(second is Duplicate).IsTrue();
        await Assert.That(Path.GetFileName(Emails().Single()))
            .IsEqualTo($"{InternalDate.ToUnixTimeSeconds()}.{hash}.testhost.eml");
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task StoreAsync_AfterIndexLoss_AdoptsExistingFileAndRestoresSidecar()
    {
        var content = Eml.Create("abc@example.com");
        await using (var archive = await OpenAsync())
        {
            await StoreAsync(archive, content, "abc@example.com");
        }

        DeleteIndex();
        File.Delete(Emails().Single() + ".meta.json");

        await using var reopened = await OpenAsync();
        var outcome = await StoreAsync(reopened, content, "abc@example.com");

        await Assert.That(outcome is Duplicate).IsTrue();
        await Assert.That(Emails().Length).IsEqualTo(1);
        await Assert.That(File.Exists(Emails().Single() + ".meta.json")).IsTrue();
        await Assert.That(await reopened.ContainsAsync("abc@example.com", CancellationToken.None)).IsTrue();
        await Assert.That(Directory.GetFiles(Path.Combine(_temp.Path, "INBOX", "tmp")).Length).IsEqualTo(0);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task StoreAsync_NameCollisionWithDifferentContent_KeepsBothFiles()
    {
        var original = Eml.Create("abc@example.com", body: "Original");
        await using (var archive = await OpenAsync())
        {
            await StoreAsync(archive, original, "abc@example.com");
        }

        DeleteIndex();

        await using var reopened = await OpenAsync();
        var outcome = await StoreAsync(reopened, Eml.Create("abc@example.com", body: "Changed"), "abc@example.com");

        var prefix = $"{InternalDate.ToUnixTimeSeconds()}.abc@example.com";
        await Assert.That(outcome is Stored).IsTrue();
        await Assert.That(Emails().Length).IsEqualTo(2);
        await Assert.That(File.Exists(Path.Combine(Current, prefix + "_1.testhost.eml"))).IsTrue();
        await Assert.That(Convert.ToBase64String(await File.ReadAllBytesAsync(Path.Combine(Current, prefix + ".testhost.eml"))))
            .IsEqualTo(Convert.ToBase64String(original));
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task StoreAsync_OversizedHeader_StillArchivesMessage()
    {
        var content = Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes(
            $"X-Padding: {new string('a', 2 * 1024 * 1024)}\r\nSubject: Too big\r\n\r\nBody\r\n");
        await using var archive = await OpenAsync();

        var outcome = await StoreAsync(archive, content, "big@example.com");

        var sidecar = await File.ReadAllTextAsync(Emails().Single() + ".meta.json");
        await Assert.That(outcome is Stored).IsTrue();
        await Assert.That(new FileInfo(Emails().Single()).Length).IsEqualTo((long)content.Length);
        await Assert.That(sidecar).Contains("\"MessageId\": \"big@example.com\"");
        await Assert.That(sidecar).Contains("\"Subject\": null");
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task StoreAsync_FailedRead_LeavesNoTemporaryFile()
    {
        await using var archive = await OpenAsync();

        var act = async () => await archive.StoreAsync(
            new FailingStream(), "abc@example.com", InternalDate, "INBOX", CancellationToken.None);

        await Assert.ThrowsAsync<IOException>(act);
        await Assert.That(Directory.GetFiles(Path.Combine(_temp.Path, "INBOX", "tmp")).Length).IsEqualTo(0);
        await Assert.That(Emails().Length).IsEqualTo(0);
        await Assert.That(await archive.ContainsAsync("abc@example.com", CancellationToken.None)).IsFalse();
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task ContainsAsync_NormalizesMessageIds()
    {
        await using var archive = await OpenAsync();
        await StoreAsync(archive, Eml.Create("abc@example.com"), "ABC@Example.com");

        await Assert.That(await archive.ContainsAsync("abc@EXAMPLE.com", CancellationToken.None)).IsTrue();
        await Assert.That(await archive.ContainsAsync("other@example.com", CancellationToken.None)).IsFalse();
    }

    private sealed class FailingStream : MemoryStream
    {
        public override int Read(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count) => throw new IOException("Connection reset");

        public override int Read(Span<byte> buffer) => throw new IOException("Connection reset");

        public override ValueTask<int> ReadAsync(Memory<byte> buffer, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) =>
            ValueTask.FromException<int>(new IOException("Connection reset"));

        public override Task<int> ReadAsync(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count, CancellationToken cancellationToken) =>
            Task.FromException<int>(new IOException("Connection reset"));

        public override Task CopyToAsync(Stream destination, int bufferSize, CancellationToken cancellationToken) =>
            Task.FromException(new IOException("Connection reset"));
    }
}

using MyImapDownloader.Sync;

namespace MyImapDownloader.Tests;

public class FolderCheckpointTrackerTests
{
    [Test]
    public async Task NoFailures_AdvancesToHighestProcessedUid()
    {
        var tracker = new FolderCheckpointTracker();

        tracker.MarkProcessed(1);
        tracker.MarkProcessed(2);
        tracker.MarkProcessed(5);

        await Assert.That(tracker.SafeCheckpoint).IsEqualTo(5L);
        await Assert.That(tracker.LowestFailedUid).IsNull();
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task FailureInMiddle_HoldsCheckpointBeforeFailure()
    {
        var tracker = new FolderCheckpointTracker();

        tracker.MarkProcessed(1);
        tracker.MarkProcessed(2);
        tracker.MarkFailed(3);
        tracker.MarkProcessed(4);

        await Assert.That(tracker.SafeCheckpoint).IsEqualTo(2L);
        await Assert.That(tracker.LowestFailedUid).IsEqualTo(3L);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task FailureInEarlierBatch_IsNotSkippedByLaterBatches()
    {
        var tracker = new FolderCheckpointTracker();

        tracker.MarkProcessed(10);
        tracker.MarkFailed(11);

        for (uint uid = 12; uid <= 200; uid++)
        {
            tracker.MarkProcessed(uid);
        }

        await Assert.That(tracker.SafeCheckpoint).IsEqualTo(10L);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task FirstUidFails_CheckpointStaysAtZero()
    {
        var tracker = new FolderCheckpointTracker();

        tracker.MarkFailed(7);
        tracker.MarkProcessed(8);

        await Assert.That(tracker.SafeCheckpoint).IsEqualTo(0L);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task LowerFailureAfterHigherFailure_LowersCheckpoint()
    {
        var tracker = new FolderCheckpointTracker();

        tracker.MarkProcessed(1);
        tracker.MarkProcessed(2);
        tracker.MarkProcessed(3);
        tracker.MarkFailed(5);
        tracker.MarkFailed(2);

        await Assert.That(tracker.SafeCheckpoint).IsEqualTo(1L);
        await Assert.That(tracker.LowestFailedUid).IsEqualTo(2L);
    }
}

using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;

using MyImapDownloader.Archive;
using MyImapDownloader.Sync;

namespace MyImapDownloader.Tests;

public class FolderSynchronizerTests : IAsyncDisposable
{
    private readonly TempDirectory _temp = new();
    private readonly FakeMailServer _server = new();
    private readonly FakeFolder _inbox = new("INBOX");
    private EmailArchive? _archive;

    public async ValueTask DisposeAsync()
    {
        if (_archive is not null)
        {
            await _archive.DisposeAsync();
        }

        _temp.Dispose();
    }

    private static DownloadOptions Options(DateTime? startDate = null) => new()
    {
        Server = "imap.example.com",
        Username = "user",
        Password = "secret",
        OutputDirectory = "unused",
        StartDate = startDate
    };

    private async Task<FolderSynchronizer> CreateAsync()
    {
        _archive ??= await EmailArchive.OpenAsync(
            _temp.Path, NullLoggerFactory.Instance, TimeProvider.System, "testhost", CancellationToken.None);
        return new FolderSynchronizer(
            _archive, _server, NullLogger<FolderSynchronizer>.Instance, TimeProvider.System);
    }

    private int ArchivedCount() =>
        Directory.GetFiles(Path.Combine(_temp.Path, "INBOX", "cur"), "*.eml").Length;

    private Task<long> CursorAsync() => _archive!.GetLastUidAsync("INBOX", _inbox.UidValidity, CancellationToken.None);

    [Test]
    public async Task SyncAsync_DownloadsNewMessagesAndAdvancesCursor()
    {
        _inbox.Add(1, "one@example.com").Add(2, "two@example.com").Add(3, "three@example.com");
        var synchronizer = await CreateAsync();

        await synchronizer.SyncAsync(_inbox, Options(), CancellationToken.None);

        await Assert.That(ArchivedCount()).IsEqualTo(3);
        await Assert.That(await CursorAsync()).IsEqualTo(3L);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task SyncAsync_SecondRunOnlyAsksForNewerMessages()
    {
        _inbox.Add(1, "one@example.com").Add(2, "two@example.com");
        var synchronizer = await CreateAsync();
        await synchronizer.SyncAsync(_inbox, Options(), CancellationToken.None);

        _inbox.Add(3, "three@example.com");
        await synchronizer.SyncAsync(_inbox, Options(), CancellationToken.None);

        await Assert.That(_inbox.Searches[1].AfterUid).IsEqualTo(2u);
        await Assert.That(_inbox.Reads.Count).IsEqualTo(3);
        await Assert.That(ArchivedCount()).IsEqualTo(3);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task SyncAsync_ProcessesMoreThanOneBatch()
    {
        for (uint uid = 1; uid <= 120; uid++)
        {
            _inbox.Add(uid, $"message{uid}@example.com");
        }

        var synchronizer = await CreateAsync();

        await synchronizer.SyncAsync(_inbox, Options(), CancellationToken.None);

        await Assert.That(ArchivedCount()).IsEqualTo(120);
        await Assert.That(await CursorAsync()).IsEqualTo(120L);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task SyncAsync_FailedMessageHoldsCursorAndIsRetriedNextRun()
    {
        _inbox.Add(1, "one@example.com").Add(2, "two@example.com").Add(3, "three@example.com");
        _inbox.ReadFailures[2] = new InvalidOperationException("Message is gone");
        var synchronizer = await CreateAsync();

        await synchronizer.SyncAsync(_inbox, Options(), CancellationToken.None);
        var heldCursor = await CursorAsync();
        var archivedAfterFirstRun = ArchivedCount();

        _inbox.Reads.Clear();
        await synchronizer.SyncAsync(_inbox, Options(), CancellationToken.None);

        await Assert.That(heldCursor).IsEqualTo(1L);
        await Assert.That(archivedAfterFirstRun).IsEqualTo(2);
        await Assert.That(_inbox.Reads.Count).IsEqualTo(1);
        await Assert.That(_inbox.Reads[0]).IsEqualTo(2u);
        await Assert.That(ArchivedCount()).IsEqualTo(3);
        await Assert.That(await CursorAsync()).IsEqualTo(3L);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task SyncAsync_LostConnectionEndsTheAttempt()
    {
        _inbox.Add(1, "one@example.com").Add(2, "two@example.com");
        _inbox.ReadFailures[1] = new IOException("Connection reset");
        var synchronizer = await CreateAsync();

        var act = async () => await synchronizer.SyncAsync(_inbox, Options(), CancellationToken.None);

        await Assert.ThrowsAsync<IOException>(act);
        await Assert.That(_inbox.Reads.Count).IsEqualTo(1);
        await Assert.That(await CursorAsync()).IsEqualTo(0L);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task SyncAsync_SkipsMessagesAlreadyInTheArchive()
    {
        _inbox.Add(5, "known@example.com");
        var synchronizer = await CreateAsync();
        await _archive!.StoreAsync(
            new MemoryStream(Eml.Create("known@example.com")),
            "known@example.com",
            FakeFolder.InternalDate,
            "INBOX",
            CancellationToken.None);

        await synchronizer.SyncAsync(_inbox, Options(), CancellationToken.None);

        await Assert.That(_inbox.Reads.Count).IsEqualTo(0);
        await Assert.That(ArchivedCount()).IsEqualTo(1);
        await Assert.That(await CursorAsync()).IsEqualTo(5L);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task SyncAsync_ChangedUidValidityRescansWithoutDuplicating()
    {
        _inbox.Add(1, "one@example.com").Add(2, "two@example.com");
        var synchronizer = await CreateAsync();
        await synchronizer.SyncAsync(_inbox, Options(), CancellationToken.None);

        _inbox.UidValidity = 2;
        _inbox.Reads.Clear();
        await synchronizer.SyncAsync(_inbox, Options(), CancellationToken.None);

        await Assert.That(_inbox.Searches[1].AfterUid).IsEqualTo(0u);
        await Assert.That(_inbox.Reads.Count).IsEqualTo(0);
        await Assert.That(ArchivedCount()).IsEqualTo(2);
        await Assert.That(await CursorAsync()).IsEqualTo(2L);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task SyncAsync_DateWindowNeitherUsesNorAdvancesCursor()
    {
        _inbox.Add(1, "one@example.com").Add(2, "two@example.com");
        var synchronizer = await CreateAsync();
        await _archive!.SetLastUidAsync("INBOX", 1, _inbox.UidValidity, CancellationToken.None);

        await synchronizer.SyncAsync(_inbox, Options(new DateTime(2024, 1, 1)), CancellationToken.None);

        await Assert.That(_inbox.Searches[0].AfterUid).IsEqualTo(0u);
        await Assert.That(_inbox.Searches[0].DeliveredAfter).IsEqualTo(new DateTime(2024, 1, 1));
        await Assert.That(ArchivedCount()).IsEqualTo(2);
        await Assert.That(await CursorAsync()).IsEqualTo(1L);
    }
}

using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;

using MyImapDownloader.Archive;
using MyImapDownloader.Sync;

namespace MyImapDownloader.Tests;

public class MailboxSynchronizerTests : IAsyncDisposable
{
    private readonly TempDirectory _temp = new();
    private readonly FakeMailServer _server = new();
    private EmailArchive? _archive;

    public async ValueTask DisposeAsync()
    {
        if (_archive is not null)
        {
            await _archive.DisposeAsync();
        }

        _temp.Dispose();
    }

    private static DownloadOptions Options(bool allFolders = false) => new()
    {
        Server = "imap.example.com",
        Username = "user",
        Password = "secret",
        OutputDirectory = "unused",
        AllFolders = allFolders
    };

    private async Task<MailboxSynchronizer> CreateAsync()
    {
        _archive = await EmailArchive.OpenAsync(
            _temp.Path, NullLoggerFactory.Instance, TimeProvider.System, "testhost", CancellationToken.None);
        var folders = new FolderSynchronizer(
            _archive, _server, NullLogger<FolderSynchronizer>.Instance, TimeProvider.System);
        return new MailboxSynchronizer(
            _server, folders, NullLogger<MailboxSynchronizer>.Instance, _ => TimeSpan.Zero);
    }

    private int ArchivedCount(string folder) =>
        Directory.Exists(Path.Combine(_temp.Path, folder, "cur"))
            ? Directory.GetFiles(Path.Combine(_temp.Path, folder, "cur"), "*.eml").Length
            : 0;

    [Test]
    public async Task RunAsync_SyncsOnlyInboxByDefault()
    {
        _server.Folders.Add(new FakeFolder("INBOX").Add(1, "one@example.com"));
        _server.Folders.Add(new FakeFolder("Archive").Add(1, "two@example.com"));
        var mailbox = await CreateAsync();

        await mailbox.RunAsync(Options(), CancellationToken.None);

        await Assert.That(ArchivedCount("INBOX")).IsEqualTo(1);
        await Assert.That(ArchivedCount("Archive")).IsEqualTo(0);
        await Assert.That(_server.Disconnections).IsEqualTo(1);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task RunAsync_SyncsEveryFolderWhenRequested()
    {
        _server.Folders.Add(new FakeFolder("INBOX").Add(1, "one@example.com"));
        _server.Folders.Add(new FakeFolder("Archive").Add(1, "two@example.com"));
        var mailbox = await CreateAsync();

        await mailbox.RunAsync(Options(allFolders: true), CancellationToken.None);

        await Assert.That(ArchivedCount("INBOX")).IsEqualTo(1);
        await Assert.That(ArchivedCount("Archive")).IsEqualTo(1);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task RunAsync_ReconnectsAfterLostConnectionAndResumes()
    {
        var inbox = new FakeFolder("INBOX").Add(1, "one@example.com").Add(2, "two@example.com");
        inbox.ReadFailures[2] = new IOException("Connection reset");
        _server.Folders.Add(inbox);
        _server.ConnectFailures.Enqueue(new IOException("Host unreachable"));
        var mailbox = await CreateAsync();

        await mailbox.RunAsync(Options(), CancellationToken.None);

        await Assert.That(_server.Connections).IsEqualTo(3);
        await Assert.That(_server.Disconnections).IsEqualTo(2);
        await Assert.That(ArchivedCount("INBOX")).IsEqualTo(2);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task RunAsync_DoesNotRetryAuthenticationFailures()
    {
        _server.ConnectFailures.Enqueue(new FakeAuthenticationException());
        var mailbox = await CreateAsync();

        var act = async () => await mailbox.RunAsync(Options(), CancellationToken.None);

        await Assert.ThrowsAsync<FakeAuthenticationException>(act);
        await Assert.That(_server.Connections).IsEqualTo(1);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task RunAsync_DoesNotRetryCancellation()
    {
        _server.ConnectFailures.Enqueue(new OperationCanceledException());
        var mailbox = await CreateAsync();

        var act = async () => await mailbox.RunAsync(Options(), CancellationToken.None);

        await Assert.ThrowsAsync<OperationCanceledException>(act);
        await Assert.That(_server.Connections).IsEqualTo(1);
    }

    [Test]
    [Arguments(0, 2)]
    [Arguments(1, 4)]
    [Arguments(7, 256)]
    [Arguments(8, 300)]
    [Arguments(5000, 300)]
    public async Task Backoff_DoublesUpToFiveMinutes(int attempt, int expectedSeconds)
    {
        await Assert.That(MailboxSynchronizer.Backoff(attempt)).IsEqualTo(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(expectedSeconds));
    }
}

using System.Text;

using MyImapDownloader.Imap;

namespace MyImapDownloader.Tests;

public sealed class TempDirectory : IDisposable
{
    public TempDirectory()
    {
        Path = System.IO.Path.Combine(System.IO.Path.GetTempPath(), $"downloader_tests_{Guid.NewGuid():N}");
        Directory.CreateDirectory(Path);
    }

    public string Path { get; }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        try
        {
            Directory.Delete(Path, recursive: true);
        }
        catch (Exception exception) when (exception is IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException)
        {
        }
    }
}

public sealed class ManualTimeProvider(DateTimeOffset now) : TimeProvider
{
    public DateTimeOffset Now { get; set; } = now;

    public override DateTimeOffset GetUtcNow() => Now;
}

public static class Eml
{
    public static byte[] Create(string? messageId, string subject = "Test subject", string body = "Hello world")
    {
        var builder = new StringBuilder();
        if (messageId is not null)
        {
            builder.Append($"Message-ID: <{messageId}>\r\n");
        }

        builder.Append("From: Sender <sender@example.com>\r\n");
        builder.Append("To: Receiver <receiver@example.com>\r\n");
        builder.Append($"Subject: {subject}\r\n");
        builder.Append("Date: Tue, 24 Dec 2024 10:30:00 +0000\r\n");
        builder.Append("MIME-Version: 1.0\r\n");
        builder.Append("Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8\r\n");
        builder.Append("\r\n");
        builder.Append(body).Append("\r\n");
        return Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes(builder.ToString());
    }
}

public sealed class FakeAuthenticationException() : Exception("Invalid credentials");

public sealed record FakeMessage(string? MessageId, string Subject, byte[] Content);

public sealed class FakeFolder(string fullName, uint uidValidity = 1) : IRemoteFolder
{
    public static readonly DateTimeOffset InternalDate = new(2024, 12, 24, 10, 30, 0, TimeSpan.Zero);

    public SortedDictionary<uint, FakeMessage> Messages { get; } = [];

    public Dictionary<uint, Exception> ReadFailures { get; } = [];

    public List<MessageWindow> Searches { get; } = [];

    public List<uint> Reads { get; } = [];

    public uint UidValidity { get; set; } = uidValidity;

    public string FullName => fullName;

    public FakeFolder Add(uint uid, string? messageId, string body = "Hello world")
    {
        var subject = $"Subject {uid}";
        Messages[uid] = new FakeMessage(messageId, subject, Eml.Create(messageId, subject, body));
        return this;
    }

    public Task<uint> OpenAsync(CancellationToken ct) => Task.FromResult(UidValidity);

    public Task<IReadOnlyList<uint>> FindAsync(MessageWindow window, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        Searches.Add(window);
        return Task.FromResult<IReadOnlyList<uint>>(Messages.Keys.Where(uid => uid > window.AfterUid).ToList());
    }

    public Task<IReadOnlyList<RemoteMessage>> DescribeAsync(IReadOnlyList<uint> uids, CancellationToken ct) =>
        Task.FromResult<IReadOnlyList<RemoteMessage>>(uids
            .Where(Messages.ContainsKey)
            .Select(uid => new RemoteMessage(uid, Messages[uid].MessageId, Messages[uid].Subject, InternalDate))
            .ToList());

    public Task<Stream> ReadAsync(uint uid, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        Reads.Add(uid);
        return ReadFailures.Remove(uid, out var failure)
            ? Task.FromException<Stream>(failure)
            : Task.FromResult<Stream>(new MemoryStream(Messages[uid].Content));
    }
}

public sealed class FakeMailServer : IMailServer, IMailSession
{
    public List<FakeFolder> Folders { get; } = [];

    public Queue<Exception> ConnectFailures { get; } = new();

    public int Connections { get; private set; }

    public int Disconnections { get; private set; }

    public Task<IMailSession> ConnectAsync(CancellationToken ct)
    {
        Connections++;
        return ConnectFailures.TryDequeue(out var failure)
            ? Task.FromException<IMailSession>(failure)
            : Task.FromResult<IMailSession>(this);
    }

    public MailFailure Classify(Exception exception) => exception switch
    {
        FakeAuthenticationException => MailFailure.Authentication,
        IOException => MailFailure.Connection,
        _ => MailFailure.Message
    };

    public Task<IReadOnlyList<IRemoteFolder>> GetFoldersAsync(bool allFolders, CancellationToken ct) =>
        Task.FromResult<IReadOnlyList<IRemoteFolder>>(allFolders ? [.. Folders] : [.. Folders.Take(1)]);

    public ValueTask DisposeAsync()
    {
        Disconnections++;
        return ValueTask.CompletedTask;
    }
}

using System.Text.Json;

using Microsoft.Data.Sqlite;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

using MyImapDownloader.Core.Storage;

namespace MyImapDownloader.Archive;

public sealed class ArchiveIndex : IAsyncDisposable
{
    public const string FileName = "index.v1.db";

    private const string Schema = """
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS Messages (
            MessageId TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            Folder TEXT NOT NULL,
            ImportedAt TEXT NOT NULL
        );

        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS SyncState (
            Folder TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            LastUid INTEGER NOT NULL,
            UidValidity INTEGER NOT NULL
        );

        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS IX_Messages_Folder ON Messages(Folder);
        """;

    private readonly SqliteConnection _connection;
    private readonly ILogger<ArchiveIndex> _logger;
    private readonly TimeProvider _time;

    private ArchiveIndex(SqliteConnection connection, ILogger<ArchiveIndex> logger, TimeProvider time)
    {
        _connection = connection;
        _logger = logger;
        _time = time;
    }

    public static async Task<ArchiveIndex> OpenAsync(
        string archiveRoot,
        ILogger<ArchiveIndex> logger,
        TimeProvider time,
        CancellationToken ct)
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(archiveRoot);
        var path = Path.Combine(archiveRoot, FileName);

        try
        {
            return new ArchiveIndex(await ConnectAsync(path, ct), logger, time);
        }
        catch (SqliteException exception) when (SqliteDatabase.IsCorruption(exception))
        {
            logger.LogError(exception, "Index database is corrupt. Rebuilding it from sidecar metadata.");
        }

        Quarantine(path, logger, time);
        var index = new ArchiveIndex(await ConnectAsync(path, ct), logger, time);
        try
        {
            await index.RebuildFromSidecarsAsync(archiveRoot, ct);
            return index;
        }
        catch
        {
            await index.DisposeAsync();
            throw;
        }
    }

    public async Task<bool> ContainsAsync(string messageId, CancellationToken ct) =>
        await _connection.ScalarAsync(
            "SELECT 1 FROM Messages WHERE MessageId = @id LIMIT 1", ct, [("@id", messageId)]) is not null;

    public Task RecordAsync(string messageId, string folder, CancellationToken ct) =>
        _connection.ExecuteAsync(
            "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO Messages (MessageId, Folder, ImportedAt) VALUES (@id, @folder, @date)",
            ct,
            [("@id", messageId), ("@folder", folder), ("@date", _time.GetUtcNow().UtcDateTime.ToString("O"))]);

    public async Task<long> GetLastUidAsync(string folder, long uidValidity, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        await using var command = _connection.Prepare(
            "SELECT LastUid, UidValidity FROM SyncState WHERE Folder = @folder", [("@folder", folder)]);
        await using var reader = await command.ExecuteReaderAsync(ct);

        if (!await reader.ReadAsync(ct))
        {
            return 0;
        }

        if (reader.GetInt64(1) == uidValidity)
        {
            return reader.GetInt64(0);
        }

        _logger.LogWarning("UIDVALIDITY changed for {Folder}. Resetting cursor.", folder);
        return 0;
    }

    public Task SetLastUidAsync(string folder, long lastUid, long uidValidity, CancellationToken ct) =>
        _connection.ExecuteAsync(
            """
            INSERT INTO SyncState (Folder, LastUid, UidValidity)
            VALUES (@folder, @uid, @validity)
            ON CONFLICT(Folder) DO UPDATE SET
                LastUid = @uid,
                UidValidity = @validity
            WHERE LastUid < @uid OR UidValidity != @validity;
            """,
            ct,
            [("@folder", folder), ("@uid", lastUid), ("@validity", uidValidity)]);

    public ValueTask DisposeAsync() => _connection.DisposeAsync();

    private static async Task<SqliteConnection> ConnectAsync(string path, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var connection = await SqliteDatabase.OpenAsync(path, ct);
        try
        {
            await connection.ExecuteAsync(Schema, ct);
            return connection;
        }
        catch
        {
            await connection.DisposeAsync();
            throw;
        }
    }

    private static void Quarantine(string path, ILogger logger, TimeProvider time)
    {
        var suffix = $".corrupt.{time.GetUtcNow().UtcTicks}";
        foreach (var file in (ReadOnlySpan<string>)[path, path + "-wal", path + "-shm"])
        {
            if (File.Exists(file))
            {
                File.Move(file, file + suffix);
                logger.LogWarning("Moved corrupt database file to {Path}", file + suffix);
            }
        }
    }

    private async Task RebuildFromSidecarsAsync(string archiveRoot, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        _logger.LogInformation("Rebuilding index from disk...");
        var count = 0;

        await using var transaction = await _connection.BeginTransactionAsync(ct);
        foreach (var sidecar in Directory.EnumerateFiles(
            archiveRoot, "*" + MaildirStore.SidecarSuffix, SearchOption.AllDirectories))
        {
            ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
            try
            {
                await using var stream = File.OpenRead(sidecar);
                var metadata = await JsonSerializer.DeserializeAsync(
                    stream, EmailMetadataJsonContext.Default.EmailMetadata, ct);

                if (metadata is { MessageId.Length: > 0, Folder.Length: > 0 })
                {
                    await RecordAsync(metadata.MessageId, metadata.Folder, ct);
                    count++;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception exception) when (exception is JsonException or IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("Skipping malformed meta file {File}: {Error}", sidecar, exception.Message);
            }
        }

        await transaction.CommitAsync(ct);
        _logger.LogInformation("Recovery complete. Re-indexed {Count} emails.", count);
    }
}

using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;

namespace MyImapDownloader.Archive;

public static partial class ArchiveNaming
{
    private const int MaxMessageIdLength = 100;
    private const int MaxFolderLength = 100;
    private const int MaxHostLength = 20;

    public static string NormalizeMessageId(string messageId)
    {
        var cleaned = UnsafeMessageIdCharacters().Replace(messageId, "_").ToLowerInvariant();

        if (cleaned.Length > MaxMessageIdLength)
        {
            cleaned = $"{cleaned[..91]}_{Hash(cleaned)[..8]}";
        }

        return cleaned.Length == 0 ? "unknown" : cleaned;
    }

    public static string SafeFileId(string normalizedMessageId)
    {
        var invalid = Path.GetInvalidFileNameChars();
        var builder = new StringBuilder(normalizedMessageId.Length);
        foreach (var c in normalizedMessageId)
        {
            builder.Append(invalid.Contains(c) ? '_' : c);
        }

        return builder.ToString().TrimEnd('.', ' ');
    }

    public static string FolderDirectory(string folderName) => Sanitize(folderName, MaxFolderLength);

    public static string FileName(DateTimeOffset internalDate, string safeFileId, string hostName) =>
        $"{internalDate.ToUnixTimeSeconds()}.{safeFileId}.{Sanitize(hostName, MaxHostLength)}.eml";

    public static string Sanitize(string input, int maxLength)
    {
        var builder = new StringBuilder(maxLength);
        foreach (var c in input)
        {
            if (char.IsLetterOrDigit(c) || c is '-' or '_' or '.')
            {
                builder.Append(c);
            }
            else if (builder.Length > 0 && builder[^1] != '_')
            {
                builder.Append('_');
            }

            if (builder.Length >= maxLength)
            {
                break;
            }
        }

        return builder.ToString().Trim('_');
    }

    public static string Hash(string input) =>
        Convert.ToHexStringLower(SHA256.HashData(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(input)));

    public static async Task<string> HashFileAsync(string path, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        await using var stream = File.OpenRead(path);
        return Convert.ToHexStringLower(await SHA256.HashDataAsync(stream, ct));
    }

    [GeneratedRegex("""[<>:"/\\|?*\x00-\x1F]""")]
    private static partial Regex UnsafeMessageIdCharacters();
}

using System.Diagnostics;

using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

using MimeKit;
using MimeKit.Utils;

using MyImapDownloader.Telemetry;

namespace MyImapDownloader.Archive;

public sealed class EmailArchive(
    ArchiveIndex index,
    MaildirStore store,
    ILogger<EmailArchive> logger,
    TimeProvider time) : IAsyncDisposable
{
    private const int MaxHeaderLength = 1024 * 1024;
    private static readonly ParserOptions HeaderParserOptions = new() { MaxHeaderLength = MaxHeaderLength };

    public static async Task<EmailArchive> OpenAsync(
        string root,
        ILoggerFactory loggers,
        TimeProvider time,
        string hostName,
        CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var index = await ArchiveIndex.OpenAsync(root, loggers.CreateLogger<ArchiveIndex>(), time, ct);
        return new EmailArchive(index, new MaildirStore(root, hostName), loggers.CreateLogger<EmailArchive>(), time);
    }

    public Task<long> GetLastUidAsync(string folder, long uidValidity, CancellationToken ct) =>
        index.GetLastUidAsync(folder, uidValidity, ct);

    public Task SetLastUidAsync(string folder, long lastUid, long uidValidity, CancellationToken ct) =>
        index.SetLastUidAsync(folder, lastUid, uidValidity, ct);

    public Task<bool> ContainsAsync(string messageId, CancellationToken ct) =>
        index.ContainsAsync(ArchiveNaming.NormalizeMessageId(messageId), ct);

    public async Task<StoreOutcome> StoreAsync(
        Stream content,
        string? messageId,
        DateTimeOffset internalDate,
        string folderName,
        CancellationToken ct)
    {
        using var activity = DownloaderTelemetry.ActivitySource.StartActivity("SaveStream");
        var started = Stopwatch.GetTimestamp();

        var id = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(messageId) ? null : ArchiveNaming.NormalizeMessageId(messageId);
        if (id is not null && await index.ContainsAsync(id, ct))
        {
            return new Duplicate(id);
        }

        var staged = await store.StageAsync(content, folderName, internalDate, ct);
        try
        {
            var headers = await ReadHeadersAsync(staged.Path, ct);

            if (id is null)
            {
                id = headers?[HeaderId.MessageId] is { } header && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(header)
                    ? ArchiveNaming.NormalizeMessageId(header)
                    : await ArchiveNaming.HashFileAsync(staged.Path, ct);

                if (await index.ContainsAsync(id, ct))
                {
                    store.Discard(staged);
                    return new Duplicate(id);
                }
            }

            var metadata = new EmailMetadata
            {
                MessageId = id,
                Subject = headers?[HeaderId.Subject],
                From = headers?[HeaderId.From],
                To = headers?[HeaderId.To],
                Date = DateUtils.TryParse(headers?[HeaderId.Date], out var sent)
                    ? sent.UtcDateTime
                    : internalDate.UtcDateTime,
                Folder = folderName,
                ArchivedAt = time.GetUtcNow().UtcDateTime,
                HasAttachments = false
            };

            var committed = await store.CommitAsync(staged, id, metadata);
            await index.RecordAsync(id, folderName, CancellationToken.None);

            if (!committed.IsNew)
            {
                return new Duplicate(id);
            }

            DownloaderTelemetry.FilesWritten.Add(1);
            DownloaderTelemetry.BytesWritten.Add(staged.Length);
            DownloaderTelemetry.WriteLatency.Record(Stopwatch.GetElapsedTime(started).TotalMilliseconds);

            return new Stored(id, committed.Path, staged.Length);
        }
        catch
        {
            store.Discard(staged);
            throw;
        }
    }

    public ValueTask DisposeAsync() => index.DisposeAsync();

    private async Task<HeaderList?> ReadHeadersAsync(string path, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        try
        {
            await using var stream = File.OpenRead(path);
            return await new MimeParser(HeaderParserOptions, stream, MimeFormat.Entity).ParseHeadersAsync(ct);
        }
        catch (FormatException exception)
        {
            logger.LogWarning(exception, "Could not parse headers of {Path}; archiving without header metadata", path);
            return null;
        }
    }
}

using System.Text.Json;

namespace MyImapDownloader.Archive;

public sealed record StagedMessage(string Path, string FolderPath, long Length, DateTimeOffset InternalDate);

public sealed record CommittedMessage(string Path, bool IsNew);

public sealed class MaildirStore(string root, string hostName)
{
    public const string SidecarSuffix = ".meta.json";

    private const int MaxNameAttempts = 1000;
    private static readonly string[] Subdirectories = ["cur", "new", "tmp"];

    public async Task<StagedMessage> StageAsync(
        Stream content,
        string folderName,
        DateTimeOffset internalDate,
        CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var folderPath = Path.Combine(root, ArchiveNaming.FolderDirectory(folderName));
        foreach (var subdirectory in Subdirectories)
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.Combine(folderPath, subdirectory));
        }

        var path = Path.Combine(folderPath, "tmp", $"{internalDate.ToUnixTimeSeconds()}.{Guid.NewGuid()}.tmp");
        try
        {
            await using var file = new FileStream(
                path, FileMode.CreateNew, FileAccess.Write, FileShare.None, 81920, FileOptions.Asynchronous);
            await content.CopyToAsync(file, ct);
            await file.FlushAsync(ct);
            file.Flush(flushToDisk: true);
            return new StagedMessage(path, folderPath, file.Length, internalDate);
        }
        catch
        {
            Discard(path);
            throw;
        }
    }

    public async Task<CommittedMessage> CommitAsync(StagedMessage staged, string messageId, EmailMetadata metadata)
    {
        var safeId = ArchiveNaming.SafeFileId(messageId);
        var directory = Path.Combine(staged.FolderPath, "cur");

        for (var attempt = 0; attempt < MaxNameAttempts; attempt++)
        {
            var fileId = attempt == 0 ? safeId : $"{safeId}_{attempt}";
            var path = Path.Combine(directory, ArchiveNaming.FileName(staged.InternalDate, fileId, hostName));

            if (TryMove(staged.Path, path))
            {
                await WriteSidecarAsync(path, staged.FolderPath, metadata);
                return new CommittedMessage(path, IsNew: true);
            }

            if (await HaveSameContentAsync(staged.Path, path))
            {
                await WriteSidecarAsync(path, staged.FolderPath, metadata);
                Discard(staged.Path);
                return new CommittedMessage(path, IsNew: false);
            }
        }

        throw new IOException($"No free file name for message '{messageId}' in '{directory}'.");
    }

    public void Discard(StagedMessage staged) => Discard(staged.Path);

    private static void Discard(string path)
    {
        try
        {
            File.Delete(path);
        }
        catch (Exception exception) when (exception is IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException)
        {
        }
    }

    private static bool TryMove(string source, string destination)
    {
        try
        {
            File.Move(source, destination, overwrite: false);
            return true;
        }
        catch (IOException) when (File.Exists(destination))
        {
            return false;
        }
    }

    private static async Task<bool> HaveSameContentAsync(string first, string second)
    {
        if (new FileInfo(first).Length != new FileInfo(second).Length)
        {
            return false;
        }

        return await ArchiveNaming.HashFileAsync(first, CancellationToken.None)
            == await ArchiveNaming.HashFileAsync(second, CancellationToken.None);
    }

    private static async Task WriteSidecarAsync(string emailPath, string folderPath, EmailMetadata metadata)
    {
        var sidecarPath = emailPath + SidecarSuffix;
        if (File.Exists(sidecarPath))
        {
            return;
        }

        var staging = Path.Combine(folderPath, "tmp", $"{Guid.NewGuid()}.meta.tmp");
        try
        {
            await using (var file = new FileStream(staging, FileMode.CreateNew, FileAccess.Write, FileShare.None))
            {
                await JsonSerializer.SerializeAsync(file, metadata, EmailMetadataJsonContext.Default.EmailMetadata);
                file.Flush(flushToDisk: true);
            }

            TryMove(staging, sidecarPath);
        }
        finally
        {
            Discard(staging);
        }
    }
}

using System.CommandLine;

namespace MyImapDownloader;

public static class DownloadCommand
{
    public const string PasswordVariable = "MYIMAPDOWNLOADER_PASSWORD";

    public static RootCommand Create(
        Func<DownloadOptions, CancellationToken, Task<int>> run,
        Func<string, string?>? environment = null)
    {
        Func<string, string?> variable = environment ?? Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable;

        var server = new Option<string>("--server", "-s") { Description = "IMAP server address", Required = true };
        var username = new Option<string>("--username", "-u") { Description = "Email username", Required = true };
        var password = new Option<string?>("--password", "-p")
        {
            Description = $"Email password (defaults to the {PasswordVariable} environment variable)"
        };
        var port = new Option<int>("--port", "-r") { Description = "IMAP port", DefaultValueFactory = _ => 993 };
        var output = new Option<string>("--output", "-o")
        {
            Description = "Output directory for archived emails",
            DefaultValueFactory = _ => "EmailArchive"
        };
        var startDate = new Option<DateTime?>("--start-date")
        {
            Description = "Download emails from this date (yyyy-MM-dd)"
        };
        var endDate = new Option<DateTime?>("--end-date")
        {
            Description = "Download emails until this date (yyyy-MM-dd)"
        };
        var allFolders = new Option<bool>("--all-folders", "-a")
        {
            Description = "Download from all folders, not just INBOX"
        };
        var verbose = new Option<bool>("--verbose", "-v") { Description = "Enable verbose logging" };

        var command = new RootCommand("Archive emails from an IMAP server to local .eml files")
        {
            server, username, password, port, output, startDate, endDate, allFolders, verbose
        };

        string? ResolvePassword(string? value) =>
            !string.IsNullOrEmpty(value) ? value
            : variable(PasswordVariable) is { Length: > 0 } fallback ? fallback
            : null;

        command.Validators.Add(result =>
        {
            if (ResolvePassword(result.GetValue(password)) is null)
            {
                result.AddError($"Option '--password' is required unless {PasswordVariable} is set.");
            }
        });

        command.SetAction((parseResult, ct) => run(
            new DownloadOptions
            {
                Server = parseResult.GetRequiredValue(server),
                Username = parseResult.GetRequiredValue(username),
                Password = ResolvePassword(parseResult.GetValue(password))!,
                Port = parseResult.GetValue(port),
                OutputDirectory = parseResult.GetRequiredValue(output),
                StartDate = parseResult.GetValue(startDate),
                EndDate = parseResult.GetValue(endDate),
                AllFolders = parseResult.GetValue(allFolders),
                Verbose = parseResult.GetValue(verbose)
            },
            ct));

        return command;
    }

    public static ParseResult Parse(RootCommand command, IReadOnlyList<string> args) =>
        command.Parse(args, new ParserConfiguration { ResponseFileTokenReplacer = null });
}

namespace MyImapDownloader;

public sealed record DownloadOptions
{
    public required string Server { get; init; }
    public required string Username { get; init; }
    public required string Password { get; init; }
    public int Port { get; init; } = 993;

    public DateTime? EndDate { get; init; }

    public bool HasDateWindow => StartDate is not null || EndDate is not null;
